chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 21. Amagciwane | 21.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 21. Viruses | 21.0 Introduction
chapterContent:
Wake waba nesimungumungwane? Njengezinye izifo eziningi, uqala ngomkhuhlane, ikhala eligobhozayo, kanye nomphimbo obuhlungu. Ngokushesha ngemva kwalokho, ukuqubuka kuqala ukumboza umzimba. Cishe kuma-30% ezimo zesimungumungwane kuvela ezinye izinkinga, njenge-pneumonia, i-encephalitis (ukuvuvukala kobuchopho), ngisho nokufa. Nakuba ukulandisa kokuqala okuqoshiwe kwesimungumungwane kwakungekhulu lesi-9, kwaze kwaba ngo-1912 lapho abahlinzeki bezempilo e-United States baqala ukubika amacala. Phakathi kuka-1912 no-1922, kwakunabantu abangaphezu kuka-6,000 abafa ngenxa yesimungumungwane. Lo mkhuba waqhubeka kwaze kwaba ngu-1963, lapho umuthi wokuqala wokugomela isimungumungwane waqala ukutholakala. Isimungumungwane samenyezelwa ukuthi sisusiwe e-United States ngo-2000 ngenxa yokuthi iningi lezingane lalithola imithamo emibili yomjovo. NgoJanuwari 23, 2015, i-Center for Disease Control yakhipha iseluleko sezempilo mayelana nokuqubuka kwesimungumungwane ezifundazweni eziningana. Ukuqubuka kwaqala epaki yetimu edumile eCalifornia ngoDisemba 2014 lapho isivakashi esinegciwane esivela kwelinye izwe sivakashela ipaki yetimungwane. Abantu abaningi abangenwe yileli gciwane abazange bagonywe noma abazange bathole umthamo wesibili wokugonywa.

 Akekho owaziyo ukuthi amagciwane avele nini noma avelaphi, njengoba amagciwane engashiyi izinyathelo zomlando njengezinsalela. Amagciwane anamuhla kucatshangwa ukuthi ayinhlanganisela yezingcezu nezingcezu zama-nucleic acid athathwe emithonjeni eyahlukene ngezindlela zawo zokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Amagciwane ayizinto eziphila ngamangqamuzana, ezingasasebenzi kahle ezingahlukaniswanga kunoma yimuphi umbuso. Ngokungafani nezinto eziphilayo eziningi, amagciwane awawona amangqamuzana futhi awakwazi ukwahlukana. Esikhundleni salokho, athelela iseli lomnikazi futhi asebenzisa izinqubo zokuphindaphinda zomnikazi ukukhiqiza izinhlayiya zegciwane ezifanayo. Amagciwane athelela izinto eziphilayo ezahlukahlukene njengebhaktheriya, izitshalo, nezilwane. Akhona ezweni elingaphansi komhlaba phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo nezinto ezingaphili. Izinto eziphilayo ziyakhula, zigaywe, futhi zizalane. Amagciwane ayaphindaphindeka, kodwa ukuze enze kanjalo, ancike ngokuphelele kumaseli azo. Awenzi ugay noma akhule, kodwa ahlanganiswa ngesimo sawo esivuthiwe.
question1: Kungani amagciwane engahlukaniswa kunoma yimuphi umbuso wokuphila?
answer1: Ngoba ziyi-acellular futhi azikwazi ukuzala ngokuzimela ngaphandle kweseli eliyibambayo
question2: Amagciwane azalana kanjani?
answer2: Zithelela iseli eliyibambayo futhi zisebenzisa imishini yokuphindaphinda yabayibambayo ukukhiqiza izinhlayiya ezintsha zamagciwane.
question3: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono amagciwane?
answer3: Zikhona phakathi kokuphila nokungaphili ngoba zingaphindaphinda kuphela ngaphakathi kwamaseli omuntu ophethe.
question4: Kungani kwamenyezelwa ukuthi isimungumungwane siqediwe e-United States ngo-2000?
answer4: Ngoba iningi lezingane lathola imithamo emibili yomjovo wesimungumungwane
distractor4a: Ngoba igciwane ngokwemvelo laguquka laba uhlobo olungenangozi
question5: Iyini inkolelo-mbono yamanje ngemvelaphi yamagciwane anamuhla?
answer5: Ziyi-mosaic yama-nucleic acid atholakala emithonjeni ehlukahlukene ngesikhathi sokuziphendukela kwemvelo
question6: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezingatheleleka ngamagciwane?
answer6: Amabhaktheriya, izitshalo, nezilwane

chapterContent:
Izinto eziphilayo zokuqala ezavela eminyakeni eyizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-3.5 eyedlule kwakuyi-prokaryotes ezazinezakhiwo kanye nezinqubo ze-metabolic ezihlobene namaseli (bheka isahluko se-Cell Structure). Njengoba kuxoxwe ngaso esahlukweni ngesakhiwo seseli, amaseli e-prokaryotic mancane kakhulu kunamaseli e-eukaryotic futhi ahlala cishe kuwo wonke amasentimitha-skwele eplanethi yethu, kusukela ezindaweni ezingamukeleki kahle kuya ebusweni besikhumba. Ama-virus mancane kakhulu kunama-prokaryotes futhi alula kakhulu ngesakhiwo. Kumelwe azale ngaphakathi kweseli eliyibamba. Imvelaphi yawo iseyimfihlakalo kithi, kodwa siyazi ukuthi angasenza sigule kakhulu.

 Ama-virus anesakhiwo esiyisisekelo: i-DNA noma i-RNA core ezungezwe yi-capsid yangaphandle yamaprotheni. Amanye ama-virus ane-phospholipid yangaphandle. Njengoba sizohlola ngokuningiliziwe, ama-virus amaningi asebenzisa uhlobo oluthile lwe-glycoprotein ukunamathela kumaseli awo ayibamba. Ama-virus athelela zonke izinhlobo zamaseli ezaziwayo futhi asebenzisa amaprotheni okuphindaphinda eseli eliyibamba kanye nemishini ye-metabolic ukuze aphindaphinde. Ukuhlukaniswa kwama-virus kuyinselele, kodwa enye indlela iwahlukanisa ngokwendlela akhiqiza ngayo i-mRNA yawo. Ama-retrovirus (abizwa nangokuthi ama-RNA virus) asebenzisa i-enzyme reverse transcriptase ukuze abhale i-DNA kusuka ku-RNA. (Esahlukweni se-Genes and Proteins sifunde ukuthi ukugeleza okuvamile kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo kusuka ku-DNA kuya ku-RNA kuya kuphrotheni.) Ama-virus avamile afaka i-bacteriophage T4, i-adenovirus, kanye ne-HIV retrovirus.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yohlaka lwe-AP® Biology Curriculum. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuhlaka lwe-Curriculum zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 3
Izinhlelo zokuphila zigcina, zibuyise, zidlulise futhi ziphendule ulwazi olubalulekile ezinqubweni zokuphila.

question1: Kungani amagciwane ebhekwa njengezinto ezibangela ukungezwani kwamangqamuzana?
answer1: Ngoba kumele zikhiqize ngaphakathi kweseli lomgcini kusetshenziswa imishini ye-metabolic yomgcini
question2: Yiziphi izingxenye eziyisisekelo zesakhiwo segciwane?
answer2: I-DNA noma i-RNA core ezungezwe yi-capsid yeprotheni, kanti amanye amagciwane nawo ane-phospholipid envelope.
question3: Uyini umsebenzi wama-glycoprotein amagciwane?
answer3: Zisiza amagciwane ukuthi anamathele kumaseli abambe iqhaza
question4: Amagciwane amaningi ahlukaniswa kanjani?
answer4: Ngendlela abayisebenzisayo ukukhiqiza i-mRNA yabo
question5: Yimaphi ama-enzyme asetshenziswa ama-retrovirus ukukhiqiza i-DNA evela kwi-RNA?
answer5: I-transcriptase ebuyela emuva
question6: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo se-retrovirus?
answer6: I-HIV

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 21. Amagciwane | 21.1 Ukuvela Kwamagciwane, Ukwakheka Kwawo, Nokuhlukaniswa | Ukutholwa Nokutholwa

chapterContent:
Amagciwane aqala ukutholakala ngemuva kokuthuthukiswa kwesihlungi se-porcelain, esibizwa ngokuthi isihlungi se-Chamberland-Pasteur, esingasusa wonke amabhaktheriya abonakalayo kumakroskopu kunoma iyiphi isampula yoketshezi. Ngo-1886, u-Adolph Meyer wabonisa ukuthi isifo sezitshalo zikagwayi, isifo se-mosaic kagwayi, singadluliselwa kusuka esitshalweni esinesifo siye kwesiphilile ngokusebenzisa izithasiselo zezitshalo eziwuketshezi. Ngo-1892, uDmitri Ivanowski wabonisa ukuthi lesi sifo singadluliselwa ngale ndlela ngisho nangemva kokuba isihlungi se-Chamberland-Pasteur sesisuse wonke amabhaktheriya asebenzayo kulesi sithasiselo. Noma kunjalo, kwathatha iminyaka eminingi ngaphambi kokuba kufakazelwe ukuthi la ma-"agent"athelelanayo ahlungiwe ayengewona nje amabhaktheriya amancane kakhulu kodwa ayewuhlobo olusha lwezinhlayiya ezincane kakhulu, ezibangela izifo.

 Ama-Virion, izinhlayiya zegciwane elilodwa, zincane kakhulu, cishe zingama-nano angu-20-250 amamitha ububanzi. Lezi zinhlayiya zegciwane ngazinye ziwuhlobo oluthelelanayo lwegciwane elingaphandle kweseli eliphethe. Ngokungafani namabhaktheriya (amakhulu ngokuphindwe kayi-100), asikwazi ukubona amagciwane nge-microscope ekhanyayo, ngaphandle kwamanye ama-virion amakhulu omndeni we-poxvirus. Kwaze kwaba yilapho kuthuthukiswa i-microscope ye-electron ngasekupheleni kwawo-1930 lapho ososayensi bathola khona umbono wabo wokuqala omuhle ngesakhiwo segciwane le-tobacco mosaic (TMV) (Isithombe 21.1) kanye namanye amagciwane (Isithombe 21.2). Isakhiwo sobuso bama-virion singabonwa ngokuskena kanye ne-transmission electron microscopy, kanti izakhiwo zangaphakathi zegciwane zingabonwa kuphela ezithombeni ezivela ku-transmission electron microscope. Ukusetshenziswa kwalawa ma-technologies kuvumele ukutholakala kwamagciwane amaningi awo wonke izinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo. Ekuqaleni zahlukaniswa ngokwesimo esabiwe. Kamuva, amaqembu amagciwane ahlukaniswa ngohlobo lwe-nucleic acid ayenayo, i-DNA noma i-RNA, nokuthi ngabe i-nucleic acid yawo yayinezintambo eyodwa noma ezimbili. Muva nje, ukuhlaziywa kwama-molecule emijikelezweni yokuphindaphinda kwamagciwane kuye kwathuthukisa kakhulu ukuhlukaniswa kwawo.
question1: Yikuphi ukusungulwa okwaqala kwavumela ososayensi ukuthola amagciwane?
answer1: Isihlungi se-porcelain se-Chamberland-Pasteur
question2: Yini uDmitri Ivanowski ayibonisa ngo-1892?
answer2: Isifo se-mosaic sikagwayi sisengadluliselwa ngemva kokuba amabhaktheriya esusiwe ngesihlungi se-Chamberland-Pasteur
question3: Kuyini i-virion?
answer3: Inhlayiya eyodwa yegciwane elithelelanayo ngaphandle kweseli eliyibambayo
question4: Kungani amagciwane amaningi engabonakali nge-microscope ekhanyayo?
answer4: Ngoba zincane kakhulu kunamabhaktheriya futhi zingaphansi kwesisombululo se-microscope ekhanyayo
distractor4b: Ngoba amagciwane akhona ngaphakathi kwamaseli kuphela
distractor4c: Ngoba amagciwane amunca konke ukukhanya okubonakalayo
question5: Yisiphi isibonakhulu esivumela ososayensi ukuthi babone izakhiwo zangaphakathi zamagciwane?
answer5: I-microscope ye-electron yokudlulisa
question6: Amagciwane ahlukaniswa kanjani ekuqaleni?
answer6: Ngokwesimo sabo esihlanganyelwe
question7: Yiziphi izici ezengeziwe ezasetshenziswa kamuva ukuhlukanisa amagciwane?
answer7: Uhlobo lwe-nucleic acid (i-DNA noma i-RNA) nokuthi ngabe yayinezintambo eyodwa noma ezimbili

chapterContent:
Nakuba izazi zezinto eziphilayo ziqoqe ulwazi oluningi mayelana nendlela amagciwane anamuhla ashintsha ngayo, kuncane kakhulu okwaziwayo mayelana nendlela amagciwane aqala ngayo kwasekuqaleni. Lapho behlola umlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo kwezinto eziningi eziphilayo, ososayensi bangabheka amarekhodi ezinsalela kanye nobufakazi obufanayo bomlando. Kodwa-ke, amagciwane awaguquli izinsalela, ngakho abacwaningi kumele baqagele ngokuphenya ukuthi amagciwane anamuhla ashintsha kanjani nangokusebenzisa ulwazi lwe-biochemical kanye nolwezakhi zofuzo ukudala imilando yamagciwane okuqagela.

 Nakuba okutholakele okuningi kuvuma ukuthi amagciwane awanakhokho oyedwa ofanayo, izazi azikatholi umbono owodwa mayelana nemvelaphi yamagciwane owamukelwa ngokugcwele emkhakheni. Omunye umbono onjalo, obizwa ngokuthi i-devolution noma i-regressive hypothesis, uphakamisa ukuchaza imvelaphi yamagciwane ngokusikisela ukuthi amagciwane ashintsha kusuka kumaseli aphilayo akhululekile. Kodwa-ke, izingxenye eziningi zendlela le nqubo engenzeka ngayo iyimfihlakalo. Umbono wesibili (obizwa ngokuthi i-escapist noma i-progressive hypothesis) ulandisa ngamagciwane ane-RNA noma i-genome ye-DNA futhi uphakamisa ukuthi amagciwane avela kuma-molecule e-RNA ne-DNA aphunyuke esitokisini esiphethe. Umbono wesithathu uveza uhlelo lokuziphindaphinda olufana nolwamanye ama-molecule aziphindaphinda, okungenzeka aguquke eceleni kwamaseli athembele kuwo njengabasingathi; izifundo zezinye izifo ezibangelwa yizitshalo zisekela lo mbono.

 Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buthuthuka, ososayensi bangase bathuthukise futhi bathuthukise eminye imibono ukuze bachaze imvelaphi yamagciwane. Insimu evelayo ebizwa ngokuthi i-virus molecular systematics izama ukwenza lokho kanye ngokuqhathanisa izinto zofuzo ezilandelanayo. Laba bacwaningi banethemba lokuthi ngelinye ilanga bazoqonda kangcono imvelaphi yamagciwane, okutholakalayo okungaholela ekuthuthukisweni kokwelashwa kwezifo ezizikhiqizayo.
question1: Kungani kunzima kososayensi ukuthola umsuka wamagciwane?
answer1: Ngenxa yokuthi amagciwane awaguquki abe yizinsalela, ngakho-ke abacwaningi kumele bathembele ebufakazini bezakhi zofuzo kanye namakhemikhali
distractor1a: Ngoba amagciwane ashintsha kancane kakhulu ukuba angafundwa
distractor1c: Ngoba amagciwane awakwazi ukulandelelaniswa ngokwezakhi zofuzo
question2: Yisiphi isitatimende mayelana nomsuka wamagciwane esisekelwa ososayensi njengamanje?
answer2: Akukho mbono owodwa owamukelwa emhlabeni wonke ngemvelaphi yamagciwane
distractor2c: Amagciwane wonke abelana ngokhokho oyedwa ofanayo
question3: Iyini i-hypothesis ye-devolution (regressive)?
answer3: Amagciwane aqala kusuka kumaseli aphilayo akhululekile alahlekelwa kancane kancane izakhiwo zamaseli
distractor3b: Amagciwane avele ngaphambi kokuba yonke impilo yamaseli iphele
question4: Iyini inkolelo-mbono yokubalekela (inqubekela phambili)?
answer4: Amagciwane avela kuma-molecule e-RNA noma e-DNA aphunyuka kumaseli abanjwe yi-host
distractor4c: Amagciwane avela kumaseli aguqulwe abe yizinsalela
question5: Iyini inkolelo-mbono yesithathu yemvelaphi yegciwane?
answer5: Amagciwane avele eceleni kwamaseli avela kuma-molecule aziphindaphindayo
distractor5a: Amagciwane avele ngemva kokuvela kwezinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi
question6: Iyini inhloso ye-virus molecular systematics?
answer6: Ukuqonda kangcono imvelaphi kanye nokuvela kwamagciwane ngokuqhathanisa ukulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo
distractor6c: Ukubuka amagciwane kusetshenziswa ama-microscope alula kuphela

chapterContent:
Ama-virus ayi-acellular, okusho ukuthi ayizinto eziphilayo ezingenaso isakhiwo seseli. Ngakho-ke azinazo izingxenye eziningi zamaseli, njenge-organelles, i-ribosomes, kanye ne-plasma membrane. I-virion iqukethe umongo we-nucleic acid, i-external protein coating noma i-capsid, futhi ngezinye izikhathi i-external envelope eyenziwe nge-protein kanye ne-phospholipid membranes etholakala kuseli eliyi-host. Ama-virus angase aqukathe amaprotheni engeziwe, njenge-enzymes. Umehluko osobala kakhulu phakathi kwamalungu emindeni yama-virusi yi-morphology yawo, ehlukahlukene kakhulu. Isici esithakazelisayo sobunzima be-virus ukuthi ubunzima be-host abuhambisani nobunzima be-virion. Ezinye zezakhiwo ze-virion eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu zibonakala kuma-bacteriophages, ama-virus athelela izinto eziphilayo ezilula kakhulu, amabhaktheriya.

 I-Morphology
Ama-virusi eza ngezimo eziningi nobukhulu, kodwa lokhu kuyavumelana futhi kuhlukile emndenini ngamunye wama-virusi. Wonke ama-virion ane-genome ye-nucleic acid embozwe ungqimba oluvikelayo lwama-protein, olubizwa ngokuthi i-capsid. I-capsid yakhiwe ngama-subunit amaprotheni abizwa ngokuthi ama-capsomeres. Amanye ama-capsid egciwane ayizindilinga ezilula ze-polyhedral,” kanti amanye ayinkimbinkimbi kakhulu ngesakhiwo.

 Ngokuvamile, izimo zamagciwane zihlukaniswa ngamaqembu amane: i-filamentous, i-isometric (noma i-icosahedral), embozwe, kanye nekhanda nomsila. Amagciwane e-filamentous amade futhi ayindilinga. Amagciwane amaningi ezitshalo ane-filamentous, kufaka phakathi i-TMV. Amagciwane e-Isometric anezimo ezicishe zibe yindilinga, njenge-poliovirus noma ama-herpesvirus. Amagciwane ambozwe anezimbobo ezizungeze ama-capsid. Amagciwane ezilwane, njenge-HIV, avame ukumbozwa. Amagciwane ekhanda nomsila athelela amabhaktheriya futhi anekhanda elifana namagciwane e-icosahedral kanye nesimo somsila esifana namagciwane e-filamentous.

 Amagciwane amaningi asebenzisa uhlobo oluthile lwe-glycoprotein ukunamathisela kumaseli awo aphethe ngama-molecule esiseleni abizwa ngokuthi ama-receptor egciwane (Isithombe 21.3). Kula ma-virus, ukunamathisela kuyimfuneko yokungena kamuva kwe-membrane yeseli, ukuze akwazi ukuqedela ukuphindaphindwa kwawo ngaphakathi kweseli. Ama-receptor asetshenziswa yi-virus angama-molecule avame ukutholakala ezindaweni zeseli futhi zinemisebenzi yazo yomzimba. Amagciwane avele ashintsha ukuze asebenzise la ma-molecule ukuze aziphindaphinde. Isibonelo, i-HIV isebenzisa i-molecule ye-CD4 kuma-T lymphocyte njengenye yama-receptor ayo. I-CD4 uhlobo lwe-molecule ebizwa ngokuthi i-cell adhesion molecule, esebenza ukugcina izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli omzimba ziseduze komunye nomunye ngesikhathi sokukhiqizwa kwempendulo yomzimba ye-T lymphocyte.

 Phakathi kwama-virion ayinkimbinkimbi kakhulu aziwayo, i-T4 bacteriophage, ethelela i-Escherichia coli bacterium, inesakhiwo somsila esisetshenziswa yileli gciwane ukunamathela kumaseli abambe iqhaza kanye nesakhiwo sekhanda esigcina i-DNA yalo.

 I-Adenovirus, igciwane lesilwane elingamboziwe elibangela izifo zokuphefumula kubantu, isebenzisa ama-glycoprotein spikes avela kuma-capsomeres alo ukuze anamathele kumaseli abambe iqhaza. Amagciwane angamboziwe afaka phakathi lawo abangela i-poliovirus (poliovirus), ama-plantar warts (papillomavirus), kanye ne-hepatitis A (hepatitis A virus).

 Ama-virion ambozwe njenge-HIV, i-agent ebangela i-AIDS, aqukethe i-nucleic acid (i-RNA uma kwenzeka i-HIV) kanye namaprotheni e-capsid azungezwe i-phospholipid bilayer envelope kanye namaprotheni ahlobene nayo. Ama-Glycoprotein afakwe ku-viral envelope asetshenziselwa ukunamathela kumaseli omgcini. Amanye amaprotheni e-envelope angama-protein e-matrix azinzisa i-envelope futhi avame ukudlala indima ekuhlanganisweni kwama-virion enzalo. I-Chicken pox, i-influenza, kanye ne-mumps ziyizibonelo zezifo ezibangelwa amagciwane ane-envelope. Ngenxa yobuthakathaka be-envelope, amagciwane angamboziwe amelana kakhulu nezinguquko zokushisa, i-pH, kanye nezinye izibulala-magciwane kunamagciwane ambozwe.

 Sekukonke, ukuma kwe-virion kanye nokuba khona noma ukungabikho kwe-envelope kusitshela okuncane ngesifo esingabangelwa yigciwane noma ukuthi yiluphi uhlobo olungasithelela, kodwa kuseyindlela ewusizo yokuqala ukuhlukaniswa kwamagciwane (Isithombe 21.4)
question1: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono igciwane?
answer1: Izinto eziphilayo ezingenazo i-organelles, i-ribosomes, kanye ne-plasma membrane
question2: Yiziphi izingxenye eziyisisekelo ze-virion?
answer2: Ingqikithi ye-nucleic acid ezungezwe yi-capsid yephrotheni, futhi ngezinye izikhathi i-envelope yangaphandle
question3: Ayini ama-capsome?
answer3: Ama-subunit amaprotheni akha i-capsid yegciwane
question4: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungeyona enye yezimo ezine ezivamile zegciwane?
answer4: I-Spiral
question5: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wama-glycoprotein amagciwane?
answer5: Ukuxhuma igciwane kuma-receptor athile kumaseli abambe iqhaza
question6: Yisiphi i-receptor esetshenziswa yi-HIV ukunamathela kuma-T lymphocyte?
answer6: I-CD4
question7: Kungani amagciwane angamboziwe ngokuvamile emelana kangcono namagciwane amboziwe?
answer7: Azinawo amafutha aqinile, okwenza zikwazi ukumelana nokushisa, izinguquko ze-pH, kanye nezinye izibulali-magciwane
question8: Yisiphi isitatimende mayelana nokwakheka kwegciwane esinembile?
answer8: Ukuma kwe-virion kanye nokuba khona kwe-envelope kuyasiza ekuhlukaniseni igciwane kodwa akubikezeli ngokuthembekile isifo elisibangelayo.
distractor8a: Isimo se-Virion sinquma njalo isifo esibangelwayo
distractor8c: Wonke amagciwane anesimo esifanayo athelela uhlobo olufanayo lomnikazi wawo
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 21.4. Yisiphi isitatimende esilandelayo mayelana nesakhiwo segciwane esiyiqiniso?
answer9: Ama-glycoprotein asiza igciwane ukuthi linamathele esitokisini somsingathi
distractor9b: I-capsomere yakhiwe ngama-subunit amancane amaprotheni abizwa ngokuthi ama-capsid
distractor9c: I-DNA iyizinto zofuzo kuzo zonke izinhlobo zamagciwane

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 21. Amagciwane | 21.1 Ukuvela Kwamagciwane, Ukwakheka Kwawo, Nokuhlukaniswa | Ukwakheka Kwawo | Izinhlobo Ze-Nucleic Acid
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 21. Viruses | 21.1 Viral Evolution, Morphology, and Classification | Viral Morphology | Types of Nucleic Acid
chapterContent:
Ama-virus ayi-acellular, okusho ukuthi ayizinto eziphilayo ezingenaso isakhiwo seseli. Ngakho-ke azinazo izingxenye eziningi zamaseli, njenge-organelles, i-ribosomes, kanye ne-plasma membrane. I-virion iqukethe umongo we-nucleic acid, i-external protein coating noma i-capsid, futhi ngezinye izikhathi i-external envelope eyenziwe nge-protein kanye ne-phospholipid membranes etholakala kuseli eliyibambayo. Ama-virus angase aqukathe amaprotheni engeziwe, njenge-enzymes. Umehluko osobala kakhulu phakathi kwamalungu emindeni yama-virusi ukwakheka kwawo, okuhlukahlukene kakhulu. Isici esithakazelisayo sobunzima be-virus ukuthi ubunzima be-host abuhambisani nobunzima be-virion. Ezinye zezakhiwo ze-virion eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu zibonakala kuma-bacteriophages, ama-virus athelela izinto eziphilayo ezilula kakhulu, amabhaktheriya.

 Izinhlobo ze-Nucleic Acid
Ngokungafani cishe nazo zonke izinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisa i-DNA njengezinto zazo zofuzo, ama-virus angasebenzisa i-DNA noma i-RNA njengezawo. Umongo we-virus uqukethe i-genome noma okuqukethwe okuphelele kwezakhi zofuzo zegciwane. Ama-genome egciwane avame ukuba mancane, aqukethe kuphela lawo ma-gene afaka amaprotheni igciwane elingakwazi ukuwathola esitokisini somsingathi. Lokhu okuphathelene nofuzo kungaba yi-single-or-double-strands. Kungase futhi kube yi-linear noma yindilinga. Ngenkathi ama-virus amaningi aqukethe i-nucleic acid eyodwa, amanye ane-genome enama-genome amaningana, abizwa ngokuthi izingxenye.

 Kuma-virus e-DNA, i-DNA yegciwane iqondisa amaprotheni okuphindaphinda eseli lomsingathi ukuthi ahlanganise amakhophi amasha e-genome yegciwane futhi abhale futhi ahumushe lelo genome libe amaprotheni egciwane. Ama-virus e-DNA abangela izifo zabantu njenge-chickenpox kanye ne-hepatitis B.

 Ama-virus e-RNA aqukethe i-RNA kuphela njengezinto zawo zofuzo. Ukuze aphindaphinde ama-genome awo esitokisini somsingathi, ama-virus e-RNA afaka ama-enzyme angaphinda i-RNA ibe yi-DNA, okungenakukwenziwa yiseli lomsingathi. Lawa ma-enzyme e-RNA polymerase cishe enza amaphutha okukopisha kune-DNA polymerases, ngakho-ke avame ukwenza amaphutha ngesikhathi sokubhala. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, izinguquko kuma-virus e-RNA zenzeka kaningi kunakuma-virus e-DNA. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi zishintshe futhi zivumelane ngokushesha nomnikazi wazo. Izifo zabantu ezibangelwa amagciwane e-RNA zifaka phakathi i-hepatitis C, i-measles, kanye ne-rabies

answer3: Ngokuvamile ziqukethe izakhi zofuzo kuphela zamaprotheni igciwane elingenakuwathola esitokisini esiphethe.

distractor3b: Ngoba amagciwane aqukethe i-gene eyodwa kuphela

answer4: Zingaba zodwa noma ezimbili futhi zibe yimigqa noma ziyindilinga

answer5: Basebenzisa amaprotheni okuphindaphindwa kwamaseli e-host ukukopisha i-DNA yegciwane futhi bakhiqize amaprotheni egciwane
distractor5b: Ziguqula i-DNA ibe amaprotheni ngqo ngaphandle kokubhalwa
question6: Kungani ama-virus e-RNA ebhala ama-enzyme e-RNA polymerase?
answer6: Ngoba amangqamuzana ombungazi awakwazi ukuphindaphinda ama-genome e-RNA abe yizinto ezintsha zofuzo zegciwane

distractor6b: Ngoba amagciwane e-RNA adinga ama-enzyme ukwakha ama-capsid kuphela
distractor6c: Ngoba i-RNA polymerase ivikela amagciwane kuma-antibodies
question7: Kungani ama-virus e-RNA eshintshashintsha kaningi kunama-virus e-DNA?
answer7: Ama-polymerase abo e-RNA enza amaphutha amaningi okukopisha kune-DNA polymerases
question8: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okubangelwa yigciwane le-RNA?
answer8: Amarabi

Ukuze uqonde izici ezabelwana ngazo phakathi kwamaqembu ahlukene amagciwane, kudingeka uhlelo lokuhlukanisa. Njengoba amagciwane amaningi kungacatshangwa ukuthi avele kukhokho ofanayo, nokho, izindlela ososayensi abazisebenzisayo ukuhlukanisa izinto eziphilayo azisizi kakhulu. Izazi zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzise izinhlelo eziningana zokuhlukanisa esikhathini esidlule, ngokusekelwe ku-morphology kanye nezakhi zofuzo zamagciwane ahlukene. Kodwa-ke, lezi zindlela zokuhlukanisa zangaphambili zahlanganisa amagciwane ngendlela ehlukile, ngokusekelwe kuzimpawu zegciwane ezazizisebenzisa ukuwahlukanisa. Indlela yokuhlukanisa esetshenziswa kakhulu namuhla ibizwa ngokuthi uhlelo lokuhlukanisa iBaltimore futhi isekelwe endleleni i-RNA yesithunywa (mRNA) ekhiqizwa ngayo kuhlobo ngalunye lwegciwane.

 Izinhlelo Zokuhlukanisa Ezidlule
Amagciwane ahlukaniswa ngezindlela eziningana: ngezici ezifana nokuqukethwe kwawo okuyinhloko (bheka ithebula elingezansi kanye noMfanekiso 21.3), isakhiwo sama-capsid awo, nokuthi ngabe ane-envelope yangaphandle. Uhlobo lwezinto zofuzo (i-DNA noma i-RNA) kanye nesakhiwo sayo (eyodwa noma ephindwe kabili, eqondile noma eyindilinga, futhi ehlukaniswe noma engahlukaniswanga) isetshenziselwa ukuhlukanisa izakhiwo eziyinhloko zegciwane.

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 21. Amagciwane | 21.1 Ukuvela Kwamagciwane, Ukwakheka Kwawo, Nokuhlukaniswa | Ukuhlukaniswa Kwamagciwane | Ukuhlukaniswa Kwamagciwane eBaltimore
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 21. Viruses | 21.1 Viral Evolution, Morphology, and Classification | Virus Classification | Baltimore Classification
chapterContent:
Uhlelo olusetshenziswa kakhulu lokuhlukaniswa kwamagciwane lwasungulwa yisazi sezinto eziphilayo esawina umklomelo weNobel uDavid Baltimore ekuqaleni kwawo-1970. Ngaphezu komehluko wesimo kanye nofuzo okukhulunywe ngalo ngenhla, uhlelo lokuhlukaniswa kweBaltimore luhlukanisa amagciwane ngokwendlela i-mRNA ekhiqizwa ngayo ngesikhathi somjikelezo wokuphindaphindeka kwegciwane.

 Amagciwane eQembu I aqukethe i-DNA enezintambo ezimbili (dsDNA) njenge-genome yawo. I-mRNA yawo ikhiqizwa ngokubhalwa ngendlela efanayo ne-DNA yeselula. Amagciwane eQembu II ane-DNA enezintambo eyodwa (ssDNA) njenge-genome yawo. Aguqula ama-genome awo anezintambo eyodwa abe yi-dsDNA ephakathi ngaphambi kokuba ukubhalwe kube yi-mRNA kwenzeke. Amagciwane eQembu III asebenzisa i-dsRNA njenge-genome yawo. Izintambo ziyahlukana, futhi enye yazo isetshenziswa njengethempulethi yokukhiqizwa kwe-mRNA kusetshenziswa i-RNA polymerase encike kwi-RNA efakwe yigciwane. Amagciwane eQembu IV ane-ssRNA njenge-genome yawo ene-polarity enhle. I-polarity enhle isho ukuthi i-RNA ye-genomic ingasebenza ngqo njenge-mRNA. Ama-intermediate e-dsRNA, abizwa ngokuthi ama-replicative intermediates, enziwa ngenqubo yokukopisha i-genomic RNA. Izintambo eziningi ze-RNA ezinde ezigcwele ze-negative polarity (ezihambisana ne-positive-stranded genomic RNA) zakhiwa kusuka kula ma-intermediate, angase asebenze njengamathempulethi okukhiqizwa kwe-RNA ene-polarity enhle, okuhlanganisa i-RNA egcwele kanye nama-mRNA amafushane egciwane. Amagciwane e-Group V aqukethe ama-genome e-ssRNA ane-polarity embi, okusho ukuthi ukulandelana kwawo kuhambisana ne-mRNA. Njengamagciwane e-Group IV, ama-intermediate e-dsRNA asetshenziselwa ukwenza amakhophi e-genome futhi akhiqize i-mRNA. Kulesi simo, i-genome ene-negative-stranded ingaguqulwa ngqo ibe yi-mRNA. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izintambo ze-RNA ezinde eziphelele zenzelwe ukusebenza njengamathempulethi okukhiqizwa kwe-genome ene-negative-stranded. Amagciwane e-Group VI anama-genome e-diploid (amakhophi amabili) e-ssRNA okumele aguqulwe, kusetshenziswa i-enzyme reverse transcriptase, abe yi-dsDNA; I-dsDNA ibe isithuthwa iye ku-nucleus yeseli lomnikazi bese ifakwa ku-genome yomnikazi. Ngemuva kwalokho, i-mRNA ingakhiqizwa ngokuqoshwa kwe-DNA yegciwane eyahlanganiswa ku-genome yomnikazi. Amagciwane eqembu le-VII anama-genome e-dsDNA angaphelele futhi enza ama-intermediate e-ssRNA asebenza njenge-mRNA, kodwa futhi aguqulwa abe ama-genome e-dsDNA nge-reverse transcriptase, edingekayo ekuphindaphindweni kwe-genome. Izici zeqembu ngalinye kuhlelo lwe-Baltimore zifingqiwe kuthebula elingezansi ngezibonelo zeqembu ngalinye.

 Ukuhlukaniswa kwe-Baltimore
Iqembu
Izici_____Indlela Yokukhiqizwa kwe-mRNA_____Isibonelo

 I
I-DNA enezintambo ezimbili_____mRNA iqoshwa ngqo kusuka kuthempulethi ye-DNA_____I-Herpes simplex (i-herpesvirus)

 II
I-DNA enezintambo ezimbili_____I-DNA iguqulwa ibe yifomu enezintambo ezimbili ngaphambi kokuba i-RNA ibhalwe_____I-parvovirus yenja (i-parvovirus)

 III
I-RNA enezintambo ezimbili_____mRNA ibhalwe kusukela ku-genome ye-RNA_____I-Childhood gastroenteritis (i-rotavirus)

 IV
I-RNA enezintambo ezimbili (+)_____I-Genome isebenza njenge-mRNA_____Umkhuhlane ovamile (i-pircornavirus)

 V
I-RNA enezintambo eyodwa (-)_____mRNA ibhalwe kusukela ku-genome ye-RNA_____AmaRabi (i-rhabdovirus)

 VI
Ama-virus e-RNA anezintambo ezimbili ane-reverse transcriptase_____I-Reverse transcriptase yenza i-DNA kusukela ku-genome ye-RNA; I-DNA ibe isifakwa ku-genome yomnikazi; i-mRNA ibhalwe kusukela ku-DNA ehlanganisiwe_____Igciwane le-immunodeficiency lomuntu (i-HIV)

 VII
Amagciwane e-DNA ahlukaniswe kabili ane-reverse transcriptase_____I-genome yegciwane iyi-DNA ehlukaniswe kabili, kodwa i-DNA yegciwane iphindaphindwa nge-RNA intermediate; i-RNA ingasebenza ngqo njenge-mRNA noma njengethempulethi yokwenza i-mRNA_____Igciwane le-Hepatitis B (i-hepadnavirus)

chapterContent:
Amagciwane ahlukile kwezinye izinto eziphilayo ngendlela yawo yokuzalanisa. Amagciwane ayazalana ngaphakathi kweseli eliphilayo, akhiqiza izinguquko esitokisini ezivame ukuholela ekufeni kweseli elithelelekile. Ngakho-ke, amagciwane abhekwa njengezinambuzane zangaphakathi kweseli. Ukuzalanisa ngegciwane kuhilela izinyathelo eziningana: ukunamathela, ukungena, ukuzalanisa, ukuhlangana, nokukhululwa. Amagciwane aqondene nomnikazi ngoba anganamathela futhi athelele kuphela amaseli ezinto eziphilayo ezithile. Amaseli igciwane elingawasebenzisa ukuzalanisa abizwa ngokuthi avumelekile. Igciwane lihlasela iseli elihlala ngokuqala linamathele endaweni ethile ye-receptor kulwelwesi lweseli elihlala. Okulandelayo, i-viral nucleic acid, kungaba yi-DNA noma i-RNA, ingena esitokisini elihlala, noma ingenalutho, ishiya i-protein capsid ngemuva, noma ne-capsid. Uma i-capsid ingena esitokisini, kudingeka isinyathelo esengeziwe sokuvula ulwelwesi. I-viral nucleic acid ibe isitholakala ukuze iphindaphindwe futhi ibhalwe phansi. Isigaba sokugcina sokuzalanisa ngegciwane ukukhululwa kwama-virion amasha akhiqizwa ngumnikazi akwazi ukuthelela amanye amaseli. Kuye ngohlobo lwegciwane, umjikelezo wokuphindaphinda usiza ekudlulisweni kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo ngemijikelezo ye-lytic kanye ne-lysogenic.

 Ama-bacteriophages, njenge-T4 amagciwane athelela amangqamuzana ebhaktheriya, angangena kokubili imijikelezo ye-lytic kanye ne-lysogenic. Amagciwane ezilwane abangela izifo ezahlukahlukene, isibonelo, i-hepatitis C, i-herpes, i-HPV, umkhuhlane, kanye nomkhuhlane. Ngezinye izikhathi, amagciwane angacasha futhi ahlale ecashile (engalali) emaseli afana namaseli ezinzwa noma esibindi izinyanga, noma ngisho neminyaka; isibonelo, igciwane le-varicella-zoster elibangela i-chickenpox ezinganeni lingaphinde lisebenze kubantu abadala ukuze libangele isimo esibuhlungu esaziwa ngokuthi ama-shingles.” Amagciwane e-Oncogenic ezilwaneni angabangela umdlavuza ngokuphazamisa ukulawulwa komjikelezo weseli lomnikazi. Amagciwane ezitshalo angabangela umonakalo omkhulu kwezomnotho obangelwa ikhwalithi yesitshalo esibi kanye nobuningi emhlabeni jikelele.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 3 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlelo Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 3

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 21. Amagciwane | 21.2 Ukutheleleka Kwamagciwane kanye Nabasingathi | Izinyathelo Zokutheleleka Kwamagciwane: Ukunamathela, Ukungena, Ukuphindaphindwa Nokuhlanganiswa, Ukuphuma
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 21. Viruses | 21.2 Virus Infection and Hosts | Steps of Virus Infections: Attachment, Entry, Replication and Assembly, Egress
chapterContent:
Igciwane kumele lisebenzise izinqubo zamaseli ukuze liphindaphindeke. Umjikelezo wokuphindaphinda kwegciwane ungadala izinguquko ezinkulu ze-biochemical kanye nesakhiwo kuseli eliphethe, okungase kubangele umonakalo weseli. Lezi zinguquko, ezibizwa ngokuthi imiphumela ye-cytopathic (ebangela umonakalo weseli), zingashintsha imisebenzi yamaseli noma zibhubhise iseli. Amanye amaseli athelelekile, njengalawo athelelekile yigciwane lomkhuhlane elivamile elaziwa ngokuthi i-rhinovirus, afa nge-lysis (ukuqhuma) noma i-apoptosis (ukufa kweseli okuhleliwe), okukhulula wonke ama-virion enzalo ngesikhathi esisodwa. Izimpawu zezifo zegciwane zivela ekuphenduleni komzimba egciwaneni, okuzama ukulawula nokususa igciwane emzimbeni, kanye nomonakalo weseli obangelwa yigciwane. Ama-virus amaningi ezilwane ashiya amaseli athelelekile ohlelweni lokuzivikela komzimba ngenqubo eyaziwa ngokuthi i-budding, lapho ama-virion eshiya iseli ngawodwana. Ngesikhathi senqubo yokukhula, iseli alidluli i-lysis futhi alibulawa ngokushesha. Kodwa-ke, umonakalo kumaseli athelelekile yigciwane ungenza kube nzima ngamaseli ukusebenza ngendlela evamile, noma amaseli ehlala ephila isikhathi esithile. Ukutheleleka okuningi kwegciwane okukhiqizayo kulandela izinyathelo ezifanayo emjikelezweni wokuphindaphinda kwegciwane: ukunamathela, ukungena, ukukhulula, ukuphindaphinda, ukuhlanganisa, nokukhulula (Isithombe 21.8).

 Ukunamathela
Igciwane linamathela endaweni ethile ye-receptor kulwelwesi lweseli lomsingathi ngamaprotheni okunamathisela ku-capsid noma ngama-glycoprotein afakwe kulwelwesi lwegciwane. Ukucaciswa kwalokhu kusebenzisana kunquma umsingathi—kanye namaseli angaphakathi komsingathi—angatheleleka yigciwane elithile. Lokhu kungabonakaliswa ngokucabanga ngezihluthulelo eziningana kanye nezihluthulelo eziningana, lapho ukhiye ngamunye uzongena khona ukukhiya okukodwa kuphela.

 Ukungena
I-nucleic acid yama-bacteriophages ingena kulwelwesi lomsingathi inqunu, ishiya i-capsid ngaphandle kweseli. Amagciwane ezitshalo nezilwane angangena nge-endocytosis, lapho ulwelwesi lweseli luzungeza futhi lugubungele lonke igciwane. Amanye amagciwane amboziwe angena kulwelwesi lapho ilwelwesi lwegciwane luhlangana ngqo nolwelwesi lweseli. Uma isingaphakathi kweseli, i-capsid yegciwane iyawohloka, bese i-nucleic acid yegciwane iyakhishwa, bese itholakala ukuze iphindaphindwe futhi ibhalwe phansi.

 Ukuphindaphinda Nokuhlanganisa
Indlela yokuphindaphinda incike ku-genome yegciwane. Amagciwane e-DNA avame ukusebenzisa amaprotheni eseli lomnikazi kanye nama-enzyme ukwenza i-DNA eyengeziwe eguqulelwa ku-RNA ye-messenger (mRNA), esetshenziswa ukuqondisa ukwakheka kwamaprotheni. Amagciwane e-RNA avame ukusebenzisa i-RNA core njengethempulethi yokwakheka kwe-RNA yegciwane kanye ne-mRNA. I-mRNA yegciwane iqondisa iseli lomnikazi ukuthi lenze ama-enzyme egciwane kanye namaprotheni e-capsid, futhi lihlanganise ama-virion amasha. Vele, kunezimo ezihlukile kule patheni. Uma iseli lomnikazi linganikezi ama-enzyme adingekayo ekuphindaphindweni kwamagciwane, izakhi zofuzo zegciwane zinikeza ulwazi lokuqondisa ukwakheka kwamaprotheni angekho. Ama-retrovirus ane-genome ye-RNA okumele iguqulwe ibe yi-DNA, bese ifakwa ku-genome yeseli lomnikazi. Angaphakathi kweqembu lesi-VI le-Baltimore classification scheme. Ukuze kuguqulwe i-RNA ibe yi-DNA, ama-retrovirus kumele aqukathe izakhi zofuzo ezifaka i-enzyme ethize ehlobene negciwane eguqula ithempulethi ye-RNA ibe yi-DNA. Ukubhalwa kabusha akwenzeki kumaseli angenayo igciwane—i-enzyme edingekayo ephindaphindayo i-transcriptase itholakala kuphela ekubonakalisweni kwezakhi zofuzo zegciwane ngaphakathi kwamaseli angenayo igciwane. Iqiniso lokuthi amanye ama-retrovirus akhiqiza amanye ama-enzyme awo angatholakali kumnikazi liye lavumela abacwaningi ukuthi bakhe imithi evimbela la ma-enzyme. Le mithi ivimbela ukuphindaphinda ngokunciphisa umsebenzi we-enzyme ngaphandle kokuthinta imetabolism yomnikazi. Le ndlela iholele ekuthuthukisweni kwemithi ehlukahlukene esetshenziswa ukwelapha la magciwane futhi ibilokhu isebenza kahle ekunciphiseni inani lama-virion athelelekayo (amakhophi e-RNA yegciwane) egazini liye emazingeni angabonakali kubantu abathintekile yigciwane.

 Ukuphuma
Isigaba sokugcina sokuphindaphinda kwegciwane ukukhululwa kwama-virion amasha akhiqizwa kumnikazi, lapho ekwazi ukuthelela amaseli aseduze futhi aphinde umjikelezo wokuphindaphinda. Njengoba usufundile, amanye amagciwane akhishwa lapho iseli eliyibamba lifa, kanti amanye amagciwane angashiya amangqamuzana athelelekile ngokuhluma nge-membrane ngaphandle kokubulala iseli ngqo.

chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 21. Viruses | 21.2 Virus Infection and Hosts | Different Hosts and Their Viruses
chapterContent: Njengoba usufundile, amagciwane avame ukucacisa kakhulu ukuthi yimaphi amasosha omzimba kanye nokuthi yimaphi amangqamuzana angaphakathi kwamasosha omzimba azowathelela. Lesi sici segciwane senza ukuthi siqonde uhlobo olulodwa noma ezimbalwa zokuphila eMhlabeni. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kunezinhlobo eziningi ezahlukene zamagciwane eMhlabeni kangangokuthi cishe yonke into ephilayo ineqoqo layo lamagciwane elizama ukuthelela amangqamuzana ayo. Ngisho namaseli amancane kakhulu futhi alula kakhulu, i-prokaryotic bacteria, angahlaselwa yizinhlobo ezithile zamagciwane.

answer2: Cishe zonke izinto eziphilayo zinamagciwane angakwazi ukuthelela
distractor2b: Amagciwane athelela kuphela izinto eziphilayo ezinamaseli amaningi
question3: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezingangenwa amagciwane?
answer3: Cishe zonke izinto eziphilayo, okuhlanganisa amabhaktheriya, izitshalo, izilwane, nezinye izinto eziphilayo

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 21. Amagciwane | 21.2 Ukutheleleka Kwamagciwane kanye Nezindawo Ezihlala Kuwo | Ama-Bacteriophages
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 21. Viruses | 21.2 Virus Infection and Hosts | Bacteriophages
chapterContent: Ama-bacteriophage angamagciwane athelela amabhaktheriya (Isithombe 21.9). Uma ukutheleleka kweseli yi-bacteriophage kuphumela ekukhiqizweni kwama-virion amasha, ukutheleleka kuthiwa kuyakhiqiza. Uma ama-virion ekhishwa ngokuqhuma kweseli, igciwane liphindaphinda ngomjikelezo we-lytic (Isithombe 21.10). Isibonelo se-bacteriophage ye-lytic yi-T4, ethelela i-Escherichia coli etholakala emgodini wamathumbu womuntu. Nokho, ngezinye izikhathi, igciwane lingahlala ngaphakathi kweseli ngaphandle kokukhishwa. Isibonelo, lapho i-bacteriophage efudumele ithelela iseli lebhaktheriya, iphindaphinda ngomjikelezo we-lysogenic (Isithombe 21.10), futhi i-genome yegciwane ifakwa ku-genome yeseli eliphethe. Lapho i-DNA ye-phage ifakwa ku-genome yeseli eliphethe, ibizwa ngokuthi i-prophage. Isibonelo se-bacteriophage ye-lysogenic yigciwane le-λ (lambda), eliphinde lithelele igciwane le-E. coli. Amagciwane athelela amangqamuzana ezitshalo noma ezilwane nawo angase abhekane nezifo lapho engakhiqizi ama-virion isikhathi eside. Isibonelo ama-herpesvirus ezilwane, okuhlanganisa namagciwane e-herpes simplex, imbangela ye-herpes kubantu. Enqubweni ebizwa ngokuthi i-latency, la magciwane angaba khona ezicutshini zezinzwa isikhathi eside ngaphandle kokukhiqiza ama-virion amasha, kodwa ashiye i-latency ngezikhathi ezithile futhi abangele izilonda esikhumbeni lapho igciwane liphindaphinda khona. Ngisho noma kukhona ukufana phakathi kwe-lysogeny kanye ne-latency, igama elithi lysogenic cycle livame ukugcinelwa ukuchaza ama-bacteriophages. I-latency izochazwa ngokuningiliziwe ngezansi.

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 21. Amagciwane | 21.2 Ukutheleleka Kwamagciwane kanye Nezindawo Ezihlala Kuwo | Amagciwane Ezilwane
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 21. Viruses | 21.2 Virus Infection and Hosts | Animal Viruses
chapterContent:
Amagciwane ezilwane, ngokungafani namagciwane ezitshalo namabhaktheriya, akudingeki angene odongeni lweseli ukuze afinyelele iseli eliyibambayo. Amagciwane ezilwane angavalekile noma angenalutho angangena emaseli ngezindlela ezimbili ezahlukene. Njengoba iphrotheni eku-capsid yegciwane ibopha kwi-receptor yayo esiseleni esiyibambayo, igciwane lingathathwa ngaphakathi kweseli nge-vesicle ngesikhathi senqubo evamile yeseli ye-endocytosis eqondiswa yi-receptor. Enye indlela yokungena kweseli esetshenziswa amagciwane angavalekile ukuthi amaprotheni e-capsid enze izinguquko zesimo ngemva kokubopha kwi-receptor, adale iziteshi kulwelwesi lweseli eliyibambayo. I-genome yegciwane ibe isifakwa "eselini eliyibambayo ngalezi ziteshi ngendlela efana naleyo esetshenziswa ama-bacteriophages amaningi. Amagciwane avalekile anezindlela ezimbili zokungena emaseli ngemva kokubopha kuma-receptor awo: i-endocytosis eqondiswa yi-receptor, noma i-fusion. Amagciwane amaningi avalekile angena esiseleni nge-endocytosis eqondiswa yi-receptor ngendlela efana namanye amagciwane angavalekile. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, i-fusion yenzeka kuphela ngama-virion avalekile. Lawa magciwane, afaka phakathi i-HIV phakathi kwabanye, asebenzisa amaprotheni akhethekile okuhlanganisa ama-envelope awo ukuze enze i-envelope ihlangane ne-plasma membrane yeseli, ngaleyo ndlela ikhulule i-genome kanye ne-capsid yegciwane ku-cytoplasm yeseli.

 Ngemva kokwenza amaprotheni awo nokukopisha ama-genome awo, amagciwane ezilwane aqedela ukuhlanganiswa kwama-virion amasha bese ephuma esitokisini. Amagciwane ezilwane amboziwe angase aqhume kusuka ku-membrane yeseli njengoba ehlangana, ethatha ucezu lwe-plasma membrane yeseli enkambisweni. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, inzalo yegciwane engamboziwe, njenge-rhinoviruses, iqoqana kumaseli athelelekile kuze kube yilapho kukhona isignali ye-lysis noma i-apoptosis, futhi wonke ama-virion akhishwa ndawonye.

 Njengoba uzofunda kumojula olandelayo, amagciwane ezilwane ahlotshaniswa nezifo ezahlukahlukene zabantu. Amanye awo alandela iphethini yakudala yesifo esibi, lapho izimpawu ziba zimbi kakhulu isikhathi esifushane kulandelwa ukuqedwa kwegciwane emzimbeni yisistimu yomzimba kanye nokululama ekugcineni ekuthelelekeni. Izibonelo zezifo ezibi kakhulu zegciwane umkhuhlane ovamile kanye nomkhuhlane. Amanye amagciwane abangela ukutheleleka okungapheli isikhathi eside, njengegciwane elibangela i-hepatitis C, kanti amanye, njengegciwane le-herpes simplex, abangela izimpawu ezingapheli kuphela. Amanye amagciwane, njengegciwane le-herpes lomuntu 6 no-7, kwezinye izimo elingabangela isifo esincane sengane i-roseola, avame ukubangela ukutheleleka okuphumelelayo ngaphandle kokubangela izimpawu nhlobo kumuntu ophethe, ngakho-ke sithi laba ziguli banegciwane elingenazimpawu.

 Ekuthelelekeni kwe-hepatitis C, igciwane liyakhula futhi lizale emangqamuzaneni esibindi, okubangela amazinga aphansi okulimala kwesibindi. Umonakalo uphansi kakhulu kangangokuthi abantu abanegciwane bavame ukungazi ukuthi banegciwane, futhi ukutheleleka okuningi kutholakala kuphela ngokusebenza kwegazi okuvamile ezigulini ezinezici eziyingozi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, njengoba izimpawu eziningi zezifo ezibangelwa amagciwane zibangelwa ukusabela kwamasosha omzimba, ukuntuleka kwezimpawu kuyinkomba yokusabela okubuthakathaka kwamasosha omzimba egciwaneni. Lokhu kuvumela ukuthi igciwane liphunyuke ekuqedweni yisistimu yomzimba futhi liqhubeke kubantu iminyaka eminingi, ngesikhathi esifanayo likhiqiza amazinga aphansi e-virion kulokho okwaziwa ngokuthi isifo segciwane esingamahlalakhona.

 Njengoba sekuxoxiwe kakade, igciwane le-herpes simplex lingahlala lisesimweni sokulibaziseka ezicutshini zezinzwa izinyanga, ngisho neminyaka. Njengoba igciwane lifihla "ezicutshini futhi lenza amaprotheni egciwane ambalwa uma ekhona, akukho lutho impendulo yomzimba elwa nalo, futhi ukuzivikela egciwaneni kuncipha kancane kancane. Ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile, okuhlanganisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zokucindezeleka ngokomzimba nangokwengqondo, igciwane le-herpes simplex elifihliwe lingase liphinde lisebenze futhi lidlule umjikelezo wokuphindaphinda esikhumbeni, okubangela izilonda ezihambisana nesifo. Uma ama-virion ekhiqizwa esikhumbeni futhi amaprotheni egciwane ekhiqizwa, impendulo yomzimba iphinde ivuselelwe futhi ixazulule izilonda zesikhumba ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ngokubhubhisa amagciwane esikhumbeni. Ngenxa yalolu hlobo lomjikelezo wokuphindaphinda, ukuvela kwezilonda ezibandayo kwenzeka ngezikhathi ezithile, yize amagciwane ehlala ezicutshini zezinzwa impilo yonke. Ukutheleleka okufihliwe kuvamile nakwamanye ama-herpesvirus, okuhlanganisa igciwane le-varicella-zoster elibangela i-chickenpox. Ngemva kokutheleleka yi-chickenpox ebuntwaneni, igciwane le-varicella-zoster lingahlala lifihliwe iminyaka eminingi futhi liphinde lisebenze kubantu abadala ukuze libangele isimo esibuhlungu esaziwa ngokuthi ama-shingles"(Isithombe 21.11).

 Amanye amagciwane athelela izilwane, okuhlanganisa negciwane le-hepatitis C okukhulunywe ngalo ngenhla, aziwa ngokuthi amagciwane e-oncogenic: Anekhono lokubangela umdlavuza. Lawa magciwane aphazamisa ukulawulwa okuvamile komjikelezo weseli lomnikazi kungaba ngokungenisa izakhi zofuzo ezikhuthaza ukukhula kweseli okungalawulwa (ama-oncogene) noma ngokuphazamisa ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ezivimbela ukukhula kweseli. Amagciwane e-oncogenic angaba amagciwane e-DNA noma e-RNA. Umdlavuza owaziwa ukuthi uhlotshaniswa nokutheleleka kwegciwane uhlanganisa umdlavuza wesibeletho obangelwa yi-human papillomavirus (HPV) (Isithombe 21.12), umdlavuza wesibindi obangelwa yigciwane le-hepatitis C, i-T-cell leukemia, kanye nezinhlobo eziningana ze-lymphoma
question1: Amagciwane ezilwane angavalekile angangena kanjani esitokisini esiphethwe yigciwane?
answer1: Nge-endocytosis eqondiswa yi-receptor noma ngokufaka i-genome yabo ngeziteshi ezakhiwe ku-host membrane
question2: Iyiphi indlela yokungena kweseli ehlukile kuma-virus ambozwe?
answer2: Ukuhlanganiswa kwe-virus envelope ne-host cell membrane
question3: Amagciwane amboziwe avame kanjani ukuphuma esitokisini esinokutheleleka?
answer3: Ngokuhluma kusuka ku-plasma membrane nokuthola ingxenye ye-host membrane
question4: Kwenzekani ngokuvamile lapho amagciwane ezilwane angamboziwe ekhishwa esitokisini esiphethwe yisilwane?
answer4: Iseli eliphethe lidlula ku-lysis noma i-apoptosis, likhipha ama-virion amaningi ngesikhathi esisodwa
distractor4c: Amagciwane ahlala unomphela ngaphakathi kweseli eliyibambayo
question5: Kuyini ukutheleleka ngegciwane okungapheli?
answer5: Ukutheleleka lapho igciwane lihlala khona iminyaka eminingi ngenkathi liqhubeka nokukhiqiza amazinga aphansi ama-virion
question6: Kuyini ukubambezeleka kwamagciwane njengegciwane le-herpes simplex?
answer6: Isimo sokulala lapho igciwane lihlala ezicutshini zomsingathi ngaphandle kokukhiqiza inani elikhulu lama-virion amasha
distractor6a: Ukuphindaphinda okusheshayo kwegciwane okubhubhisa amaseli ombungazi
distractor6b: Ukususwa unomphela kwegciwane yisistimu yomzimba yokuzivikela
distractor6c: Isigaba lapho amagciwane ethelela khona amagciwane kuphela
question7: Yini engabangela ukuvuselelwa kabusha kokutheleleka kwegciwane le-herpes simplex elifihliwe?
answer7: Ukucindezeleka ngokomzimba noma ngokwengqondo
question8: Ayini amagciwane abangela umdlavuza?
answer8: Amagciwane angabangela umdlavuza ngokuphazamisa ukulawulwa okuvamile komjikelezo weseli lomnikazi
question9: Yimuphi umdlavuza womuntu ohlotshaniswa kakhulu nokutheleleka yi-human papillomavirus (HPV)?
question10: Yiliphi igciwane elingahlala lingabonakali ngemva kokubangela i-chickenpox bese kamuva liphinde liphinde libangele i-shingles?
answer10: Igciwane le-Varicella-zoster

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 21. Amagciwane | 21.2 Ukutheleleka Kwamagciwane kanye Nezindawo Ezihlala Kuwo | Amagciwane Ezitshalo
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 21. Viruses | 21.2 Virus Infection and Hosts | Plant Viruses
chapterContent:
Amagciwane ezitshalo, njengamanye amagciwane, aqukethe umongo we-DNA noma i-RNA. Usuvele ufunde ngenye yalezi, igciwane le-mosaic likagwayi. Njengoba amangqamuzana ezitshalo enodonga lweseli ukuvikela amangqamuzana awo, la magciwane awasebenzisi i-endocytosis eqondiswa yi-receptor ukungena kumaseli ezilwane njengoba kubonakala kumagciwane ezilwane. Ukuze amagciwane amaningi ezitshalo adluliselwe kusuka esitshalweni kuya esitshalweni, umonakalo kwamanye amangqamuzana ezitshalo kumele uvele ukuze igciwane lingene kumnikazi omusha. Lo monakalo uvame ukubangelwa yisimo sezulu, izinambuzane, izilwane, umlilo, noma imisebenzi yabantu efana nokulima noma ukunakekela imvelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, inzalo yezitshalo ingase ithole izifo zamagciwane ezivela ezitshalweni zabazali. Amagciwane ezitshalo angadluliselwa yizinhlobo ezahlukene ze-vectors, ngokuxhumana noju lwesitshalo esinegciwane, ngezinto eziphilayo ezifana nezinambuzane nama-nematode, kanye nempova. Lapho amagciwane ezitshalo edluliselwa phakathi kwezitshalo ezahlukene, lokhu kwaziwa ngokuthi ukudluliselwa okuvundlile, futhi uma ezuzwe njengomzali, lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukudluliselwa okuqondile.

 Izimpawu zezifo zamagciwane ziyahlukahluka ngokuya ngegciwane kanye nomnikazi walo (bheka ithebula elingezansi). Esinye isibonakaliso esivamile yi-hyperplasia, ukwanda okungajwayelekile kwamangqamuzana okubangela ukubonakala kwezimila zezitshalo ezaziwa ngokuthi ama-galls. Amanye amagciwane abangela i-hypoplasia, noma ukukhula kweseli okunciphile, emaqabunga ezitshalo, okubangela ukuba kuvele izindawo ezincane neziphuzi. Amanye amagciwane athinta isitshalo ngokubulala ngqo amangqamuzana ezitshalo, inqubo eyaziwa ngokuthi i-cell necrosis. Ezinye izimpawu zamagciwane ezitshalo zifaka amaqabunga angakhekile kahle, imicu emnyama eziqwini zezitshalo, ukukhula okushintshile kweziqu, amaqabunga, noma izithelo, kanye namabala ayindilinga, okuyizindawo eziyindilinga noma eziqondile zokushintsha kombala ezitholakala eqabungeni.

 Ezinye Izimpawu Ezivamile Zezifo Ezibangelwa Amagciwane Ezitshalo
Izimpawu
Kubonakala njenge

 I-Hyperplasia
Ama-galls (ama-tumors)

 I-Hypoplasia
Amabala aphuzi anciphile, aphuzi emaqabunga

 I-cell necrosis
Iziqu ezifile, ezimnyama, amaqabunga, noma izithelo

 Amaphethini okukhula angajwayelekile
Iziqu, amaqabunga, noma izithelo ezingakahleleki kahle

 Ukushintsha kombala
Imigqa ephuzi, ebomvu, noma emnyama, noma amasongo eziqwini, amaqabunga, noma izithelo

 Amagciwane ezitshalo angaphazamisa kakhulu ukukhula kwezitshalo kanye nentuthuko, okuthinta kakhulu ukutholakala kokudla kwethu. Abangela ikhwalithi yezitshalo kanye nobuningi obubi emhlabeni jikelele, futhi angaletha ukulahlekelwa okukhulu kwezomnotho minyaka yonke. Amanye amagciwane angalimaza izitshalo ezisetshenziswa ekutshalweni kwezitshalo. Amanye amagciwane athinta izitshalo zokudla zezolimo afaka igama lesitshalo asithintayo, njengegciwane le-tomato spotted wilt, igciwane le-bean common mosaic, kanye negciwane le-cucumber mosaic. Ezitshalweni ezisetshenziselwa ukuhlobisa izihlahla, amagciwane amabili avame kakhulu yi-peony ring spot kanye negciwane le-rose mosaic. Kunezinhlobo eziningi kakhulu zamagciwane ezitshalo okuxoxwa ngazo ngokuningiliziwe, kodwa izimpawu zegciwane le-bean common mosaic ziholela ekukhiqizweni okuphansi kwebhontshisi kanye nezitshalo ezingakhuli kahle, ezingakhiqizi. Ku-rose yokuhlobisa, isifo se-rose mosaic sibangela imigqa ephuzi egobile kanye namabala anemibala emaqabunga esitshalo
question1: Kungani amagciwane ezitshalo engangeni emaseli omuntu nge-receptor-mediated endocytosis?
answer1: Amaseli ezitshalo anodonga oluqinile lweseli oluvimbela le ndlela yokungena
distractor1a: Amagciwane ezitshalo awakwazi ukubopha kumaseli abambe iqhaza
distractor1c: Amagciwane ezitshalo angena kuphela ngama-bacterial vectors
question2: Ama-virus amaningi ezitshalo afinyelela kanjani esitshalweni esisha esisingethe?
answer2: Ngomonakalo ezicutshini zezitshalo obangelwa isimo sezulu, izinambuzane, izilwane, noma imisebenzi yabantu
distractor2c: Ngokungena ezindongeni zamaseli ezingaphelele usebenzisa ama-enzyme egciwane
question3: Kuyini ukudluliswa kwamagciwane ezitshalo ngokuvundlile?
answer3: Ukudluliswa kwamagciwane phakathi kwezitshalo ezahlukene
distractor3a: Ukudluliswa kwamagciwane kusuka ezitshalweni zabazali kuya enzalweni
distractor3b: Ukudluliswa kwamagciwane kusuka ezimpandeni kuya emaqabunga ngaphakathi kwesitshalo esifanayo
question4: Kuyini ukudluliswa kwamagciwane ezitshalo ngokuqondile?
answer4: Ifa lezifo ezibangelwa amagciwane kusukela ezitshalweni zabazali kuya enzalweni
question5: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo se-hyperplasia ebangelwa yigciwane lesitshalo?
answer5: Ukwakheka kwezinyongo (amathumba)
question6: Iyini i-hypoplasia ezitshalweni ezitheleleke ngamagciwane?
answer6: Ukukhula kwamaseli okunciphile okukhiqiza izindawo ezincane neziphuzi emaqabunga
question7: Amagciwane ezitshalo angathinta kanjani ezolimo kakhulu?
answer7: Zinciphisa ikhwalithi yesivuno kanye nobuningi baso, okubangela ukulahlekelwa okukhulu kwezomnotho
distractor7c: Zithinta kuphela izitshalo ezikhuliswe ezindlini zokugcina izithombo
question8: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezivame ukusebenza njengezithwali zamagciwane ezitshalo?
answer8: Izinambuzane kanye ne-nematodes
question9: Yiluphi uphawu olubangelwa yi-cell necrosis ezitshalweni?
answer9: Iziqu, amaqabunga, noma izithelo ezifile, ezimnyama
question10: Bheka uMfanekiso 21.13. Yiziphi izimpawu zezifo ezibangelwa amagciwane ezitshalo ozibonayo kule micrograph ekhanyayo yamaseli empande yesitshalo?
answer10: I-hyperplasia

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 21. Amagciwane | 21.3 Ukuvimbela Nokwelapha Ukutheleleka Ngegciwane | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 21. Viruses | 21.3 Prevention and Treatment of Viral Infections | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Iningi lokuqukethwe okuchazwe kulesi sigaba alikho ngaphakathi kwe-AP®. Sihlola eminye yale mibono lapho sifunda ngesimiso somzimba sokuzivikela. Kodwa-ke, ngenxa yokuthi sonke sizolwa nokutheleleka ngamagciwane futhi sizothola imijovo yokulwa nezifo eziningi, okuhlanganisa imijovo yomkhuhlane wezinkathi ezithile, okuqukethwe kulesi sigaba kubalulekile empilweni yethu ngaphandle kwekilasi. Ngesikhathi sifunda, cabanga ngokuthi kungani kunezinhlobo eziningi zama-antibiotic atholakalayo ekwelapheni ukutheleleka ngamagciwane kodwa imithi embalwa etholakalayo yokwelapha ukutheleleka ngamagciwane. Amagciwane ahluke kanjani kuma-bacteria kokubili ngesakhiwo kanye nomsebenzi?

 Amagciwane abangela izifo ezahlukahlukene ezilwaneni, okuhlanganisa nabantu, kusukela kumkhuhlane ovamile kuya ezifweni ezingaba yingozi njenge-meningitis (Isithombe 21.14). Lezi zifo zingelashwa ngemithi yokulwa namagciwane noma ngemijovo, kodwa amanye amagciwane ayakwazi ukugwema impendulo yomzimba futhi aguquke abe ukumelana nemithi yokulwa namagciwane.
question1: Kungani imithi embalwa etholakalayo yokwelapha izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane uma kuqhathaniswa nezifo ezibangelwa amagciwane?
answer1: Ama-virus aphindaphinda ngaphakathi kwamaseli e-host esebenzisa imishini ye-host, okwenza kube nzima ukuwahlasela ngaphandle kokulimaza i-host
question2: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyindlela evamile yokuvimbela izifo eziningi ezibangelwa amagciwane?
answer2: Ukugoma
question3: Yiziphi izifo ezilandelayo ezishiwo kulesi sigaba ezibangelwa amagciwane?
answer3: I-Meningitis
question4: Yiziphi izindlela ezimbili ezinkulu ezisetshenziswa ukulwa nezifo ezibangelwa amagciwane?
answer4: Imithi yokulwa namagciwane kanye nemigomo
question5: Kungani ezinye izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane zingase zibe nzima ukuzelapha?
answer5: Amanye amagciwane angagwema amasosha omzimba futhi aguquke abe ukumelana nemithi yokulwa namagciwane
distractor5a: Amagciwane awakwazi ukutholakala yisimiso somzimba sokuzivikela
distractor5b: Amagciwane ahlala engaphandle kwamaseli aphethwe yiwo
distractor5c: Amagciwane azalana kancane kakhulu ukuba angahlaselwa yimithi

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 21. Amagciwane | 21.3 Ukuvimbela Nokwelapha Ukutheleleka Ngegciwane | Imithi Yokuvimbela
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 21. Viruses | 21.3 Prevention and Treatment of Viral Infections | Vaccines for Prevention
chapterContent:
Nakuba sinemithi elwa namagciwane ephumelelayo elinganiselwe, njengaleyo esetshenziselwa ukwelapha umkhuhlane, indlela eyinhloko yokulawula isifo segciwane iwukugoma, okuhloswe ngayo ukuvimbela ukuqubuka ngokwakha amasosha omzimba egciwaneni noma emndenini wegciwane (Isithombe 21.15). Imithi yokugoma ingalungiselelwa kusetshenziswa amagciwane aphilayo, amagciwane abulewe, noma ama-subunit ama-molecule egciwane. Imithi yokugoma ebulala amagciwane kanye namagciwane ama-subunit womabili awakwazi ukubangela isifo.

 Imithi yokugoma ephilayo yegciwane yenzelwe elabhorethri ukubangela izimpawu ezimbalwa kubamukeli ngenkathi ibanikeza amasosha omzimba okuvikela ukutheleleka esikhathini esizayo. I-polio kwakuyisifo esisodwa esasimelela ingqophamlando ekusetshenzisweni kwemijovo. Imikhankaso yokugoma ngobuningi ngawo-1950 (umuthi wokugoma obulewe) kanye nawo-1960 (umuthi wokugoma ophilayo) yanciphisa kakhulu ukwanda kwalesi sifo, okwabangela ukukhubazeka kwemisipha ezinganeni futhi kwadala ukwesaba okukhulu kubantu abaningi lapho kuvela ubhubhane lwesifunda. Impumelelo yomjovo we-polio yavula indlela yokunikezwa njalo kwemijovo yabantwana yokulwa nesimungumungwane, u-mumps, i-rubella, i-chickenpox, nezinye izifo.

 Ingozi yokusebenzisa imijovo ephilayo, evame ukusebenza kangcono kunemijovo ebulewe, ingozi ephansi kodwa ebalulekile yokuthi la magciwane azobuyela esimweni sawo esibangela izifo ngokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo ngemuva. Imithi yokugoma ephilayo ivame ukwenziwa ngokunciphisa (ukubuthaka) igciwane lohlobo lwe-wild-type” (elibangela izifo) ngokulikhulisa elabhorethri ezicutshini noma emazingeni okushisa ahlukile kulokho igciwane elijwayelene nakho kumuntu ophethe. Ukuzivumelanisa nala maseli amasha noma amazinga okushisa kubangela izinguquko kuma-genome egciwane, okuvumela ukuthi likhule kangcono elabhorethri ngenkathi kuvimbela ikhono lalo lokubangela izifo lapho libuyiselwa ezimweni ezitholakala kumuntu ophethe. Ngakho-ke la magciwane ancishisiwe asabangela ukutheleleka, kodwa awakhuli kahle, okuvumela impendulo yomzimba ukuthi ikhule ngesikhathi ukuze kuvinjelwe izifo ezinkulu. Ukuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo kwenzeka lapho umuthi wokugoma udlula ezinguqukweni kumuntu ophethe ngendlela yokuthi uguqukele kumuntu ophethe futhi ungaphinde ubangele izifo, ezingabe sezisakazekela kwabanye abantu ebhubhaneni. Lolu hlobo lwesimo lwenzeka muva nje ngo-2007 eNigeria lapho izinguquko emthini wokugomela i-polio zaholela ebhubhaneni le-polio kulelo zwe.

 Eminye imithi yokugoma isathuthuka njalo ngoba amagciwane athile, njenge-influenza, anezinga eliphezulu lokuguqulwa kwezakhi zofuzo uma kuqhathaniswa namanye amagciwane namaseli avamile omuntu ophethe. Nge-influenza, izinguquko ku- Ama-molecule angaphezulu aleli gciwane asiza umzimba ukuba ubalekele amasosha omzimba avikelayo okungenzeka ukuthi atholakale esikhathini somkhuhlane odlule, okwenza kube nesidingo sokuthi abantu bagonywe minyaka yonke. Amanye amagciwane, njengalawo abangela izifo zasebuntwaneni, isimungumungwane, ulwelwesi kanye ne-rubella, ayashintshashintsha kaningi kangangokuthi umuthi ofanayo usetshenziswa unyaka nonyaka.
question1: Iyiphi indlela eyinhloko yokulawula izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane?
answer1: Ukugoma
question2: Yiziphi izinhlobo zezinto ezingasetshenziswa ukulungiselela imijovo?
answer2: Amagciwane aphilayo, amagciwane abulewe, noma ama-molecule amancane amagciwane
question3: Kungani imijovo yegciwane ebulewe kanye nemijovo yeyunithi encane ibhekwa njengephephile?
answer3: Abakwazi ukubangela izifo
question4: Iyini inzuzo eyinhloko yemithi yokugomela ephilayo encishisiwe?
answer4: Ngokuvamile zikhiqiza amasosha omzimba aqinile kunemithi yokugoma ebulewe
distractor4c: Akudingi mpendulo yomzimba ukuze kusebenze kahle
question5: Iyini ingozi enkulu ehlobene nemithi yokugomela ephilayo encishisiwe?
answer5: Igciwane lingaguquka libe yisimo esibangela isifo
question6: Kusho ukuthini ukunciphisa igciwane?
answer6: Ukwenza buthaka igciwane ukuze libangele izifo ezincane noma lingadali nhlobo izifo kuyilapho lisakhuthaza amasosha omzimba
question7: Kungani umuthi omusha wokugomela umkhuhlane uvame ukudingeka njalo ngonyaka?
answer7: Amagciwane omkhuhlane ashintsha ngokushesha, ashintsha ama-molecule awo angaphezulu
distractor7a: Umuthi wokugoma uyayeka ukusebenza ngemva kwenyanga eyodwa
distractor7c: Abantu balahlekelwa ngokuphelele amasosha abo omzimba minyaka yonke
question8: Kungani imithi yokugomela isimungumungwane, ukhunta kanye ne-rubella ivame ukusebenza iminyaka eminingi?
answer8: Lawa magciwane ashintshashintsha kaningi kakhulu
question9: Yisiphi isifo esancishiswa kakhulu ngemikhankaso yokugoma ngobuningi phakathi nawo-1950 nawo-1960?

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 21. Amagciwane | 21.3 Ukuvimbela Nokwelapha Ukutheleleka Ngegciwane | Imithi Yokugoma Nemithi Yokulwa Negciwane Yokwelapha
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 21. Viruses | 21.3 Prevention and Treatment of Viral Infections | Vaccines and Antiviral Drugs for Treatment
chapterContent:
Kwezinye izimo, imijovo ingasetshenziswa ukwelapha ukutheleleka ngegciwane okusebenzayo. Umqondo ngemuva kwalokhu ukuthi ngokunikeza umuthi wokugomela, amasosha omzimba ayakhuliswa ngaphandle kokwengeza igciwane elibangela izifo. Endabeni yama-rabies, isifo esibulalayo sezinzwa esidluliselwa ngamathe ezilwane ezinegciwane lama-rabies, ukuqhubeka kwalesi sifo kusukela ngesikhathi sokulunywa yisilwane kuze kube yilapho singena ohlelweni lwezinzwa oluphakathi kungaba amasonto ama-2 noma ngaphezulu. Lesi isikhathi esanele sokugoma umuntu osola ukuthi ulunywe yisilwane esinegciwane, futhi impendulo yawo yokuzivikela yomzimba yanele ukuvimbela igciwane ukuthi lingangeni ezicutshini zezinzwa. Ngakho-ke, imiphumela engaba yingozi yezinzwa yalesi sifo iyagwenywa, futhi umuntu kufanele alulame kuphela ekulunyweni yilesi sifo. Le ndlela isetshenziswa futhi ekwelapheni i-Ebola, enye yamagciwane asheshayo futhi abulalayo kakhulu emhlabeni. Sidluliselwa ngamalulwane nezinkawu ezinkulu, lesi sifo singadala ukufa kubantu abangu-70-90% abangenwe yilesi sifo zingakapheli amasonto ama-2. Ukusebenzisa imijovo esanda kuthuthukiswa ethuthukisa impendulo yomzimba ngale ndlela, kunethemba lokuthi abantu abathintekile bazokwazi ukulawula kangcono igciwane, okungenzeka basindise iphesenti elikhulu labantu abangenwe yileli gciwane ekufeni okusheshayo nokubuhlungu kakhulu.

 Enye indlela yokwelapha ukutheleleka ngegciwane ukusebenzisa imithi yokulwa namagciwane. Le mithi ivame ukuba nempumelelo encane ekwelapheni izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane, kodwa ezimweni eziningi, isetshenziswe ukulawula nokunciphisa izimpawu zezifo eziningi ezibangelwa amagciwane. Kwamagciwane amaningi, le mithi ingavimbela igciwane ngokuvimbela izenzo zephrotheni elilodwa noma amaningi alo. Kubalulekile ukuthi amaprotheni aqondiwe abhalwe izakhi zofuzo ezibangelwa amagciwane nokuthi lawa ma-molecule angabi khona esitokisini esinempilo. Ngale ndlela, ukukhula kwegciwane kuyavinjelwa ngaphandle kokulimaza umnikazi. Kunemithi eminingi yokulwa namagciwane etholakalayo yokwelapha ukutheleleka, eminye iqondene negciwane elithile kanti eminye ingathinta amagciwane amaningi.

 Kuye kwaklanywa imithi yokulwa namagciwane yokwelapha i-herpes kanye ne-influenza. Kwama-herpes, imithi efana ne-acyclovir inganciphisa inani nobude beziqephu zesifo esisebenzayo segciwane, lapho iziguli zithola khona izilonda ezibangelwa amagciwane emaseli azo esikhumba. Njengoba igciwane lihlala lifihlekile ezicutshini zomzimba impilo yonke, lo muthi awuphilisi kodwa ungenza izimpawu zesifo zilawuleke kalula. Nge-flu, imithi efana ne-oseltamivir (Isithombe 21.16) inganciphisa isikhathi sezimpawu zomkhuhlane ngosuku olu-1 noma olu-2, kodwa umuthi awuzivimbeli ngokuphelele izimpawu. I-Oseltamivir isebenza ngokuvimbela i-enzyme (i-viral neuraminidase) evumela ama-virion amasha ukuthi ashiye amaseli awo athelelekile. Ngakho-ke, i-Oseltamivir ivimbela ukusabalala kwegciwane kusuka kumaseli athelelekile kuya kwangathelelekile. Eminye imithi yokulwa namagciwane, njenge-Ribavirin, isetshenziswe ekwelapheni izinhlobo ezahlukene zokutheleleka ngamagciwane, yize indlela esebenza ngayo ngokumelene namagciwane athile ingacaci.

 Kuze kube manje, ukusetshenziswa okuphumelelayo kakhulu kwemithi yokulwa namagciwane kube ekwelapheni i-retrovirus HIV, ebangela isifo, uma singalashwa, esivame ukubulala phakathi neminyaka eyi-10-12 ngemva kokutheleleka. Imithi yokulwa ne-HIV ikwazile ukulawula ukuphindaphindana kwamagciwane kuze kube yilapho abantu abathola le mithi besinda isikhathi eside kakhulu kunalabo abangalashwanga.

 Imithi yokulwa ne-HIV ivimbela ukuphindaphindana kwamagciwane ezigabeni eziningi ezahlukene zomjikelezo wokuphindaphindana kwe-HIV (Isithombe 21.17). Kuye kwasungulwa imithi evimbela ukuhlanganiswa kwe-HIV viral envelope ne-plasma membrane yeseli eliyibamba (fusion inhibitors), ukuguqulwa kwe-RNA genome yayo ibe yi-DNA enezintambo ezimbili (reverse transcriptase inhibitors), ukuhlanganiswa kwe-DNA yegciwane ku-host genome (integrase inhibitors), kanye nokucutshungulwa kwamaprotheni egciwane (protease inhibitors).

 Uma noma yimiphi yale mithi isetshenziswa ngayinye, izinga eliphezulu lokuguqulwa kwegciwane liyivumela ukuthi ikhule kalula futhi ngokushesha ukumelana nomuthi, inciphise ukusebenza kahle komuthi. Intuthuko ekwelapheni i-HIV kwaba ukuthuthukiswa kwe-HAART, ukwelashwa kwe-antiretroviral okusebenzayo kakhulu, okubandakanya ingxube yemithi ehlukene, ngezinye izikhathi ebizwa ngokuthi i-drug cocktail.” Ngokuhlasela igciwane ezigabeni ezahlukene zomjikelezo walo wokuziphindaphinda, kunzima kakhulu ngegciwane ukuthi likhule ukumelana nemithi eminingi ngesikhathi esisodwa. Noma kunjalo, ngisho nokusetshenziswa kokwelashwa kwe-HAART okuhlanganisiwe, kukhona ukukhathazeka ngokuthi, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, igciwane lizokhula ukumelana nalokhu kwelashwa. Ngakho-ke, imithi emisha yokulwa ne-HIV ihlala ithuthukiswa ngethemba lokuqhubeka nempi ngokumelene naleli gciwane elibulalayo kakhulu.
question1: Kungani umuthi wokugomela amarabi ungasebenza kahle ngemva kokuba umuntu evezwe yileli gciwane?
answer1: Ngoba impendulo yomzimba ingakhula ngaphambi kokuba igciwane lifinyelele ohlelweni lwezinzwa oluphakathi
distractor1a: Ngoba umuthi wokugoma ubulala wonke amagciwane ngokushesha
distractor1b: Ngoba amagciwane e-rabies awakwazi ukuthelela amangqamuzana ezinzwa
distractor1c: Ngoba amagciwane e-rabies azalana ngaphandle komzimba kuphela
question2: Kungani imithi yokulwa namagciwane iklanyelwe ukuhlasela amaprotheni egciwane kunokuba ihlose amaprotheni abangela izifo?
answer2: Ukuvimbela ukuphindaphindana kwamagciwane ngaphandle kokulimaza amaseli anempilo
question3: Iyiphi imiphumela i-acyclovir enayo ekuthelelekeni kwe-herpes?
answer3: Kunciphisa inani kanye nobude bokuqubuka kwesifo kodwa akuqedi igciwane elicashile
distractor3b: Ivimbela igciwane ukuthi lingangeni kumaseli omuntu ophethe
question4: I-oseltamivir (Tamiflu) isiza kanjani ekwelapheni umkhuhlane?
answer4: Ivimbela i-neuraminidase ebangelwa amagciwane, inciphisa ukukhishwa kwama-virion amasha avela kumaseli athelelekile.
distractor4b: Ivimba ukunamathela kwegciwane kumaseli abambe iqhaza
question5: Kungani ukwelashwa ngama-antiviral kube yimpumelelo enkulu ekwelapheni ukutheleleka nge-HIV?
answer5: Kungavimbela ukuphindaphindeka kwegciwane ngokwanele ukwandisa kakhulu isikhathi sokuphila kwabantu abangenwe yileli gciwane
distractor5b: Kuvimbela i-HIV ekutheleleni noma yimaphi amaseli
question6: Kuyini i-HAART (ukwelashwa ngama-antiretroviral okusebenzayo kakhulu)?
answer6: Inhlanganisela yemithi eminingi yokulwa namagciwane ehlose izigaba ezahlukene zokuphindaphindana kwe-HIV
question7: Kungani i-HAART isebenza kangcono kunokusebenzisa umuthi owodwa wokulwa negciwane lengculazi?
answer7: Kunzima kakhulu ukuthi i-HIV ikwazi ukumelana nemithi eminingana esebenza ngezigaba ezahlukene ngesikhathi esisodwa
distractor7c: Isusa unomphela i-HIV DNA ku-genome yomnikazi wayo
question8: Yimuphi u-enzyme ohloselwe yi-reverse transcriptase inhibitors?
answer8: I-transcriptase ebuyela emuva
question9: Yiliphi uhlobo lwemithi yokulwa negciwane lengculazi evimbela i-DNA yegciwane ukuthi ingafakwa ku-genome yomnikazi?
question10: Yiluphi uhlobo lwemithi yokulwa negciwane lengculazi oluvimba ukuhlangana kwe-virus ne-membrane yeseli lomnikazi?
answer10: Izithibi zokuhlanganiswa

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 21. Amagciwane | 21.3 Ukuvimbela Nokwelapha Ukutheleleka Ngegciwane | I-Virology Esetshenzisiwe
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 21. Viruses | 21.3 Prevention and Treatment of Viral Infections | Applied Virology
chapterContent:
Ucwaningo lwamagciwane luholele ekwakhiweni kwezindlela ezintsha ezahlukene zokwelapha izifo ezingezona ezibangelwa amagciwane. Amagciwane asetshenziswe ekwelashweni kwezakhi zofuzo. Ukwelashwa kwezakhi zofuzo kusetshenziselwa ukwelapha izifo zezakhi zofuzo ezifana nokuntuleka okukhulu kwamasosha omzimba (SCID), isifo esidluliselwa ngofuzo, esiphindaphindayo lapho izingane zizalwa khona zinezinhlelo zomzimba ezisengozini enkulu. Uhlobo oluvamile lwe-SCID lubangelwa ukuntuleka kwe-enzyme, i-adenosine deaminase (ADA), ephula izisekelo ze-purine. Ukuze kwelashwe lesi sifo ngokwelashwa kwezakhi zofuzo, amangqamuzana omnkantsha wamathambo athathwa esigulini se-SCID bese kufakwa i-gene ye-ADA. Yilapho amagciwane angena khona, futhi ukusetshenziswa kwawo kuncike ekhonweni lawo lokungena emaseli aphilayo futhi alethe izakhi zofuzo nawo. Amagciwane afana ne-adenovirus, igciwane lomuntu lokuphefumula eliphezulu, aguqulwa ngokungezwa kwezakhi zofuzo ze-ADA, bese igciwane lihambisa le zakhi zofuzo esitokisini. Amangqamuzana aguquliwe, manje akwazi ukwenza i-ADA, abese ebuyiselwa ezigulini ngethemba lokuzelapha. Ukwelashwa ngezakhi zofuzo kusetshenziswa amagciwane njengomthwali wezakhi zofuzo (ama-viral vectors), nakuba kusahlolwa, kunesithembiso sokwelashwa kwezifo eziningi zofuzo. Noma kunjalo, izinkinga eziningi zobuchwepheshe zidinga ukuxazululwa ukuze le ndlela ibe yindlela esebenzayo yokwelapha izifo zofuzo.

 Okunye ukusetshenziswa kwezokwelapha kwamagciwane kuncike ekuqondeni kwawo kanye nekhono lokubulala amangqamuzana awathelelayo. Amagciwane e-Oncolytic aklanywa elabhorethri ngqo ukuhlasela nokubulala amangqamuzana omdlavuza. I-adenovirus eguqulwe izakhi zofuzo eyaziwa ngokuthi i-H101 isetshenziswe kusukela ngo-2005 ezivivinyweni zemitholampilo eShayina ukwelapha umdlavuza wekhanda nentamo. Imiphumela ibilokhu ithembisa, ngesilinganiso esikhulu sempendulo yesikhashana ekuhlanganisweni kwe-chemotherapy kanye nokwelashwa ngegciwane kunokwelashwa nge-chemotherapy kuphela. Lolu cwaningo oluqhubekayo lungamemezela ukuqala kwenkathi entsha yokwelashwa komdlavuza, lapho amagciwane eklanywa ukuthola nokubulala amangqamuzana omdlavuza ngqo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi asakazeke kuphi emzimbeni.

 Ukusetshenziswa kwesithathu kwamagciwane kwezokwelapha kuncike ekuqondeni kwawo futhi kuhilela ukusebenzisa ama-bacteriophages ekwelapheni ukutheleleka kwamagciwane. Izifo zamagciwane ziye zelashwa ngama-antibiotic kusukela ngawo-1940. Kodwa-ke, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amabhaktheriya amaningi athuthukise ukumelana nama-antibiotic. Isibonelo esihle yi-Staphylococcus aureus engamelana ne-methicillin (MRSA, ebizwa ngokuthi i-mersa”), ukutheleleka okuvame ukutholakala ezibhedlela. Leli bhaktheriya limelana nezinhlobo ezahlukene zama-antibiotic, okwenza kube nzima ukwelapha. Ukusetshenziswa kwama-bacteriophages akhethekile kulawo ma-bacteria kuzodlula ukumelana kwawo nama-antibiotic futhi kuwabulale ikakhulukazi. Nakuba ukwelashwa nge-phage kusetshenziswa eRiphabhulikhi yaseGeorgia ukwelapha ama-bacteria angamelana nama-antibiotic, ukusetshenziswa kwawo ukwelapha izifo zabantu akukavunyelwa emazweni amaningi. Kodwa-ke, ukuphepha kokwelashwa kwaqinisekiswa e-United States lapho i-U.S. Food and Drug Administration ivuma ukufafaza inyama ngama-bacteriophages ukuze kubhujiswe i-pathogen yokudla i-Listeria. Njengoba izinhlobo eziningi zamabhaktheriya ezingamelana nama-antibiotic zithuthuka, ukusetshenziswa kwama-bacteriophages kungaba yisisombululo esingaba khona sale nkinga, futhi ukuthuthukiswa kokwelashwa nge-phage kuyinto ethakazelisa kakhulu abacwaningi emhlabeni jikelele.
question1: Iyini inhloso yokwelashwa ngezakhi zofuzo?
answer1: Ukwelapha izifo zofuzo ngokungenisa izakhi zofuzo ezisebenzayo emaseli esiguli
distractor1c: Ukwandisa unomphela amazinga okuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo
question2: Amagciwane asetshenziswa kanjani ekwelashweni kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer2: Zisebenza njengezivikeli zamagciwane ukuthutha izakhi zofuzo emaseli
question3: Yisiphi isifo okuxoxwa ngaso njengesiphathwa ngokuhlolwa ngokwelashwa kwezakhi zofuzo ezibangelwa amagciwane?
answer3: Ukuntuleka okukhulu kwamasosha omzimba okuhlangene (i-SCID)
question4: Yini amagciwane e-oncolytic aklanyelwe ukuyenza?
answer4: Ukuthelela nokubulala amaseli omdlavuza ngokuqondile
question5: Kungani ukwelashwa nge-phage kubhekwa njengokwelashwa okuthembisayo?
answer5: Ama-bacteriophage angabulala ngqo amabhaktheriya amelana nama-antibiotic
distractor5b: Ama-bacteriophage aqinisa amasosha omzimba ngokumelene nesikhunta
distractor5c: Ama-bacteriophage aguqula amabhaktheriya abe amagciwane angenangozi
question6: Yiliphi igciwane elingamelana namagciwane okukhulunywe ngalo ngqo kulesi sigaba?
answer6: I-Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) engamelana ne-Methicillin
question7: Yiliphi igciwane elitholakala ekudleni eliye lalawulwa kusetshenziswa ama-bacteriophages avunyelwe yi-U.S. Food and Drug Administration?
answer7: I-Listeria
question8: Kungani ama-bacteriophage ewusizo ekwelapheni izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane?
answer8: Zithelela futhi zibulale amabhaktheriya athile ngaphandle kokuthembela kuma-antibiotic
distractor8a: Zikhuthaza amabhaktheriya ukuthi akhiqize imithi yokugoma
question9: Amagciwane angasetshenziswa kanjani ekwelashweni kwezakhi zofuzo?
answer9: Ama-virus asetshenziselwa ukuthutha i-gene iye esitokisini
distractor9a: Amagciwane asetshenziselwa ukuhlasela nokubulala amaseli athile
distractor9b: Ama-bacteriophages asetshenziswa ukwelapha izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane
distractor9c: Amagciwane asetshenziswa ukubhubhisa igciwane lokudla i-Listeria

chapterContent: Okuqukethwe okuchazwe kulesi sigaba kungaphandle kwemingcele ye-AP®. Kodwa-ke, kuyathakazelisa ukuqaphela ukuthi ama-prion nama-viroid—amagciwane alula kakhulu ngesakhiwo kunamagciwane—angadala izifo ezibulalayo, okuhlanganisa isifo sezinkomo ezihlanyayo kanye nesifo se-Creutzfeldt–Jakob. Ama-Prion angamaprotheni athelelanayo, kanti ama-viroid ayizifo ze-RNA ezinezintambo ezilodwa (ama-agent anekhono lokubangela izifo) ezithelela izitshalo.
question1: Ayini ama-prion?
answer1: Amaprotheni athelelanayo angabangela izifo
question2: Ayini ama-virusi?
answer2: Ama-pathogen e-RNA angenantambo eyodwa ahlasela izitshalo
question3: Yisiphi isifo esibangelwa ama-prion?
answer3: Isifo sezinkomo ezihlanyayo
question4: Yisiphi isifo somuntu esihlotshaniswa nama-prion?
answer4: Isifo seCreutzfeldt-Jakob
question5: Ama-prion ahluke kanjani kuma-viroid?
answer5: Ama-Prion amaprotheni athelelanayo, kanti ama-viroid ayizifo ezibangelwa amagciwane ze-RNA ezinezintambo ezilodwa.
distractor5a: Ama-Prion aqukethe i-DNA, kanti ama-viroid aqukethe amaprotheni
distractor5b: Ama-Prion athelela izitshalo, kanti ama-virus athelela izilwane kuphela

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 21. Amagciwane | 21.4 Ezinye Izinto Ezingamangqamuzana: Ama-Prions nama-Viroid | Ama-Prions
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 21. Viruses | 21.4 Other Acellular Entities: Prions and Viroids | Prions
chapterContent:
Ama-Prion, abizwa kanjalo ngoba angama-proteinaceous, ayizinhlayiya ezithelelanayo—ezincane kunamagciwane—ezingenawo ama-nucleic acid (i-DNA noma i-RNA). Ngokomlando, umqondo we-ejenti ethelelanayo engasebenzisi ama-nucleic acid wawubhekwa njengento engenakwenzeka, kodwa umsebenzi wokuqala wesazi sezinto eziphilayo esiwine uMklomelo weNobel uStanley Prusiner ukholise iningi lezazi zezinto eziphilayo ukuthi izinto ezinjalo zikhona ngempela.

 Izifo ezibulalayo ze-neurodegenerative, njenge-kuru kubantu kanye ne-bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE) ezinkomeni (ezaziwa ngokuthi isifo sezinkomo ezihlanyayo) kwabonakala ukuthi zidluliselwa ngama-prion. Lesi sifo sasakazeka ngokudla inyama, izicubu zezinzwa, noma izitho zangaphakathi phakathi kwamalungu ohlobo olufanayo. I-Kuru, edabuka kubantu ePapua New Guinea, yasakazeka isuka kumuntu iye kumuntu ngokudla izinkomo ngokwesiko. I-BSE, eyatholwa ekuqaleni e-United Kingdom, yasakazeka phakathi kwezinkomo ngomkhuba wokufaka izicubu zezinzwa zezinkomo ekudleni kwezinye izinkomo. Abantu abane-kuru ne-BSE babonisa izimpawu zokulahlekelwa ukulawula ukunyakaza komzimba kanye nokuziphatha okungavamile, njengokuqhuma okungalawuleki kokuhleka ne-kuru, okulandelwa ukufa. I-Kuru yalawulwa ngokunxenxa abantu ukuba bayeke ukudla izinkomo ngokwesiko.

 Ngakolunye uhlangothi, i-BSE ekuqaleni kwakucatshangwa ukuthi ithinta izinkomo kuphela. Izinkomo ezifa ngenxa yalesi sifo kwabonakala ukuthi zinezilonda noma imigodi” ebuchosheni, okwenza izicubu zobuchopho zifane nesiponji. Nokho, kamuva ekuqubukeni kwalesi sifo, kwaboniswa ukuthi isifo esifanayo se-encephalopathy kubantu esaziwa ngokuthi isifo se-Creutzfeldt-Jakob (CJD) singatholakala ngokudla inyama yenkomo evela ezilwaneni ezine-BSE, okwabangela ukuvinjelwa kwamanye amazwe ukungeniswa kwenyama yenkomo yaseBrithani futhi kwabangela umonakalo omkhulu kwezomnotho embonini yenyama yenkomo yaseBrithani (Isithombe 21.18). I-BSE isekhona ezindaweni ezahlukene, futhi nakuba kuyisifo esingavamile, abantu abathola i-CJD kunzima ukuselapha. Lesi sifo singasakazeka sisuka kumuntu siye kumuntu ngegazi, ngakho amazwe amaningi avimbele ukunikela ngegazi ezindaweni ezihlotshaniswa ne-BSE.

 Imbangela ye-spongiform encephalopathy, njenge-kuru ne-BSE, uhlobo oluthelelanayo lweprotheyini yeselula evamile ebizwa ngokuthi i-PrP (prion protein). Yilolu hlobo oluyinhlayiya ye-prion. I-PrP ikhona ngezindlela ezimbili, i-PrPc, uhlobo olujwayelekile lweprotheyini, kanye ne-PrPsc, uhlobo oluthelelanayo. Uma isifakwe emzimbeni, i-PrPsc equkethwe yi-prion ibopha ku-PrPc bese iyiguqula ibe yi-PrPsc. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni okukhulu kweprotheyini ye-PrPsc, ehlangana ndawonye. I-PrPsc igoqwa ngendlela engavamile, futhi ukwakheka kwayo (isimo) kuyisisusa esiqondile sezilonda ezibonakala ebuchosheni bezinkomo ezinegciwane. Ngakho-ke, nakuba kungengenxa yabagxeki abathile phakathi kososayensi, i-prion ibonakala sengathi iwuhlobo olusha ngokuphelele lwe-ejenti ethelelanayo, eyokuqala etholakale ukuthi ukudluliselwa kwayo akuxhomekile ezizakhini zofuzo ezenziwe nge-DNA noma i-RNA.
question1: Ayini ama-prion?
answer1: Izinhlayiya zamaprotheni ezithelelanayo ezingenayo i-DNA noma i-RNA
question2: Yiziphi izifo ezibangelwa ama-prion?
answer2: I-Kuru kanye ne-bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE)
question3: I-kuru yayidluliselwa kanjani ngokwesiko phakathi kwabantu?
answer3: Ngokudla abantu ngokwesiko
question4: Isifo se-bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE) saqala kanjani ukusabalala phakathi kwezinkomo?
answer4: Ngokupha izinkomo izicubu zezinzwa ezivela kwezinye izinkomo
question5: Yisiphi isifo esibangelwa ukudla inyama yenkomo evela ezinkomeni ezine-BSE kubantu?

answer7: Iguqula amaprotheni ajwayelekile e-PrPc abe yifomu le-PrPsc elingajwayelekile, okuholela ekuhlanganisweni kwamaprotheni
question8: Kungani ama-prion ebhekwa njengezinto ezithelelanayo eziyingqayizivele?
answer8: Basakaza izifo ngaphandle kokusebenzisa i-DNA noma i-RNA njengezinto zofuzo
