answer9: Izilonda ezenza izicubu zobuchopho zibukeke njengesponji

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 21. Amagciwane | 21.4 Ezinye Izinto Ezingamangqamuzana: Ama-Prions nama-Viroid | Ama-Viroid
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 21. Viruses | 21.4 Other Acellular Entities: Prions and Viroids | Viroids
chapterContent:
Ama-Viroid ayizifo ezibangelwa yizitshalo: izinhlayiya ze-RNA ezincane, ezinentambo eyodwa, eziyindilinga ezilula kakhulu kunegciwane. Azinayo i-capsid noma i-envelope yangaphandle, kodwa njengama-virus angazalana kuphela ngaphakathi kweseli eliyibambayo. Nokho, ama-Viroid awakhiqizi amaprotheni, futhi akhiqiza kuphela i-molecule eyodwa, ethize ye-RNA. Izifo zabantu ezibangelwa ama-viroid azikatholakali.

 Ama-Viroid ayaziwa ukuthi athelela izitshalo (Isithombe 21.19) futhi abangela ukwehluleka kwezitshalo kanye nokulahlekelwa yizigidi zamaRandi emalini engenayo yezolimo minyaka yonke. Ezinye zezitshalo azithelela zihlanganisa amazambane, ukhukhamba, utamatisi, ama-chrysanthemum, ama-avokhado, namasundu kakhukhunathi
question1: Ayini ama-virusi?
answer1: Amagciwane amancane, anentambo eyodwa, ayindilinga e-RNA plant angenayo i-capsid kanye ne-enclosure
question2: Ama-virus ahluke kanjani kuma-virus?
answer2: Ama-virusi awanawo i-capsid futhi awakhiqizi amaprotheni
distractor2b: Ama-virusi azalana ngokuzimela ngaphandle kwamaseli omgcini
question3: Ingabe ama-virusi angazala ngaphandle kweseli eliyibamba?
answer3: Cha, zingazalana kuphela ngaphakathi kweseli eliyibamba
question4: Hlobo luni lwe-molecule olukhiqizwa ama-virusi?
answer4: I-molecule eyodwa, ethize ye-RNA
question5: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezaziwa ukuthi zithelelekile ngama-virus?
answer5: Izitshalo
question6: Ingabe zikhona izifo zabantu eziye zatholakala njengezibangelwa ama-virus?
answer6: Cha, azikho izifo zabantu ezibangelwa ama-virus ezitholakele
question7: Kungani ama-virusi ebaluleke kakhulu kwezomnotho?
answer7: Zibangela izifo zezitshalo eziholela ekuhlulekeni kwezitshalo kanye nokulahlekelwa okukhulu kwezolimo
question8: Yisiphi kulezi zitshalo ezilandelayo okukhulunywa ngaso ukuthi singenwe yi-virusi?
answer8: Amazambane
question9: Yisiphi isitatimende ngama-virusi esinembile?
answer9: Zilula kunamagciwane ngoba zakhiwe ngama-molecule amancane e-RNA ayindilinga kuphela.
distractor9a: Ziqukethe i-capsid yeprotheni kanye ne-genome ye-DNA

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 21. Amagciwane | 21.4 Ezinye Izinto Ezingena Emangqamuzaneni: Ama-Prions Nama-Viroid | Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi | Udokotela Wezifo Ezibangelwa Amagciwane
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 21. Viruses | 21.4 Other Acellular Entities: Prions and Viroids | Career Connection | Virologist
chapterContent:
I-Virology iwucwaningo lwamagciwane, futhi isazi se-virologist ngumuntu oqeqeshwe kulo mkhakha. Ukuqeqeshwa kwi-virology kungaholela ezindleleni eziningi ezahlukene zomsebenzi. Ochwepheshe be-virologist bahileleke kakhulu ocwaningweni lwezemfundo nasekufundiseni emakolishi nasezikoleni zezokwelapha. Abanye ochwepheshe be-virologist belapha iziguli noma bahileleke ekwakhiweni nasekukhiqizweni kwemithi yokugoma. Bangase bahlanganyele ezifundweni ze-epidemiologic (Isithombe 21.20) noma babe ngababhali besayensi, ukubala imisebenzi embalwa engaba khona.

 Uma ucabanga ukuthi ungaba nesithakazelo emsebenzini we-virology, thola umeluleki kulo mkhakha. Izikhungo eziningi zezokwelapha ezinkulu zineminyango ye-virology, futhi izibhedlela ezincane zivame ukuba nama-lab e-virology ngaphakathi kweminyango yazo ye-microbiology. Zivolontiyele elebhu ye-virology isemester noma usebenze kwelinye ehlobo. Ukuxoxa ngalo msebenzi nokubona mathupha umsebenzi kuzokusiza ukuthi unqume ukuthi umsebenzi we-virology ukulungele yini. Iwebhusayithi ye-American Society of Virology iyinsiza enhle yolwazi mayelana nokuqeqeshwa kanye nemisebenzi ye-virology

answer3: Ukuthuthukisa nokukhiqiza imithi yokugoma

answer4: Ukufundisa emakolishi noma ezikoleni zezokwelapha

answer5: Zithandele noma usebenze elabhorethri ye-virology

answer6: Inikeza ulwazi oluqondile futhi isiza ekunqumeni ukuthi umsebenzi uyafaneleka yini

answer7: I-American Society of Virology

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 21. Amagciwane | 21.6 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 21. Viruses | 21.6 Chapter Summary
chapterContent:
21.1 Ukuvela Kwamagciwane, Ukwakheka Kwawo, Nokuhlukaniswa
Amagciwane ayizinto ezincane, ezingenaseli ezingabonwa kuphela nge-electron microscope. Ama-genome awo aqukethe i-DNA noma i-RNA—hhayi kokubili—futhi aphindaphinda esebenzisa amaprotheni okuphindaphinda eseli eliyibamba. Amagciwane ayahlukahluka, athelela i-archaea, amabhaktheriya, isikhunta, izitshalo, nezilwane. Amagciwane aqukethe umongo we-nucleic acid ozungezwe i-protein capsid ene-lipid envelope yangaphandle noma engenayo. Ukuma kwe-capsid, ukuba khona kwe-envelope, kanye nokwakheka komongo kunquma ezinye izinto zokuhlukaniswa kwamagciwane. Indlela yokuhlukanisa esetshenziswa kakhulu, ukuhlukaniswa kwe-Baltimore, ihlukanisa amagciwane ngokusekelwe endleleni akhiqiza ngayo i-mRNA yawo.

 21.2 Ukutheleleka Kwamagciwane kanye Nabasingathi
Ukuphindaphinda kwamagciwane ngaphakathi kweseli eliphilayo kuhlala kukhiqiza izinguquko esitokisini, ngezinye izikhathi kuholele ekufeni kweseli futhi ngezinye izikhathi kubulala kancane kancane amangqamuzana athelelekile. Kunezigaba eziyisithupha eziyisisekelo emjikelezweni wokuphindaphinda kwamagciwane: ukunamathela, ukungena, ukukhulula, ukuphindaphinda, ukuhlangana, nokukhululwa. Ukutheleleka ngegciwane kungase kube nomphumela, okuholela kuma-virion amasha, noma okungakhiqizi, okusho ukuthi igciwane lihlala ngaphakathi kweseli ngaphandle kokukhiqiza ama-virion amasha. Ama-bacteriophages angamagciwane athelela amabhaktheriya. Anezindlela ezimbili ezahlukene zokuphindaphinda: umjikelezo we-lytic, lapho igciwane liphindaphinda futhi liqhume khona kuma-bacteria, kanye nomjikelezo we-lysogenic, ohilela ukufakwa kwe-genome yegciwane ku-genome ye-bacterial host. Amagciwane ezilwane abangela izifo ezahlukahlukene, kanti ezinye zibangela izimpawu ezingapheli (i-hepatitis C), ezinye izimpawu ezingapheli (amagciwane afihlekile njenge-herpes simplex virus 1), kanti ezinye zibangela izimpawu ezimbalwa kakhulu, uma zikhona (ama-herpes virus abantu 6 no-7). Amagciwane e-Oncogenic ezilwaneni anamandla okubangela umdlavuza ngokuphazamisa ukulawulwa komjikelezo weseli le-host. Amagciwane ezitshalo anesibopho somonakalo omkhulu kwezomnotho kokubili kwezolimo kanye nezitshalo ezisetshenziselwa ukuhlobisa.

 21.3 Ukuvimbela Nokwelapha Ukutheleleka Ngegciwane
Amagciwane abangela izifo ezahlukahlukene kubantu. Eziningi zalezi zifo zingavinjelwa ngokusebenzisa imijovo yegciwane, evuselela ukuzivikela komzimba ngokumelene negciwane ngaphandle kokubangela izifo ezinkulu. Imijovo yegciwane ingasetshenziswa nasezifweni zegciwane ezisebenzayo, okwandisa ikhono lesimiso somzimba sokuzivikela ekulawuleni noma ekubhubhiseni igciwane. Uchungechunge lwemithi yokulwa namagciwane ehlose ama-enzyme kanye neminye imikhiqizo yamaprotheni yezakhi zofuzo zegciwane luye lwathuthukiswa futhi lwasetshenziswa ngempumelelo exubile. Inhlanganisela yemithi yokulwa negciwane isetshenziswe ukulawula ngempumelelo igciwane, yandisa isikhathi sokuphila sabantu abangenwe yileli gciwane. Amagciwane anezisetshenziswa eziningi emithini, njengokwelapha izifo zofuzo, umdlavuza, kanye nokutheleleka kwamagciwane.

 21.4 Ezinye Izinto Ezingamangqamuzana: Ama-Prions nama-Viroids
Ama-Prions yizinto ezithathelwanayo eziqukethe amaprotheni, kodwa angenayo i-DNA noma i-RNA, futhi abonakala ekhiqiza imiphumela yazo ebulalayo ngokuphindaphinda izimo zawo futhi aqongelelane ezicutshini. Kucatshangwa ukuthi anegalelo ezifweni eziningana zobuchopho eziqhubekayo, okuhlanganisa isifo sezinkomo ezihlanyayo kanye nesifo se-Creutzfeldt-Jakob. Ama-Viroid ayizifo ze-RNA ezinezintambo ezilodwa ezithelela izitshalo. Ukuba khona kwabo kungaba nomthelela omkhulu embonini yezolimo
question1: Amagciwane aqala ukutholakala ngemuva kokuthuthukiswa kwesihlungi se-porcelain, esibizwa ngokuthi isihlungi se-Chamberland-Pasteur. Isihlungi se-porcelain sabasiza kanjani ososayensi ukuthola amagciwane?

question28: Ukuthuthukiswa kwesihlungi se-porcelain, esibizwa ngokuthi isihlungi se-Chamberland-Pasteur, kwabasiza kanjani ososayensi ukuthola amagciwane?

distractor28c: Ngemva kokuhlunga uketshezi olukhishwe esitshalweni, ososayensi bakwazile ukulandelela izinyathelo zomlando
question29: Ososayensi baphakamise imibono embalwa ukuchaza imvelaphi yamagciwane. Thola ukuthi yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuchaza kangcono ukuthi ososayensi bachaza kanjani futhi kungani futhi bathuthukise leyo mibono.

question32: Abacwaningi bakwazile ukuthuthukisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zemithi yokulwa negciwane lengculazi, njengomuthi i-AZT. Usebenza kanjani umuthi i-AZT?

question33: Qhathanisa imijikelezo yokuzala ye-lytic kanye ne-lysogenic yamagciwane. Nikeza isizathu sokwenza isibonelo sokuthi yimuphi umjikelezo onamandla okukhiqiza ama-virion amaningi.
answer33: Umjikelezo we-lysogenic ungakhiqiza ama-virion amaningi ngokwemfundiso, njengoba i-genome yegciwane ifakwa ku-genome yeseli lomgcini futhi iphindaphindwa kanye neseli lomgcini.

distractor33b: Umjikelezo we-lysogenic ungakhiqiza ama-virion amaningi ngokombono, njengoba umjikelezo wokuzala wamagciwane adlula ku-lysogeny ushesha kakhulu kunomjikelezo wokuzala wamagciwane olandela umjikelezo we-lytic.
distractor33c: Umjikelezo we-lytic ungakhiqiza ama-virion engeziwe ngokombono, njengoba i-prophage elandela umjikelezo we-lysogenic ekugcineni ikhishwa ku-genome yeseli lomnikazi bese ingena kumjikelezo we-lytic.
question34: Bonisa ukuqonda kwakho ngezifo ezibangelwa amagciwane ngokuphendula okulandelayo: Ingabe umuntu ongakaze axhumane negciwane le-varicella-zoster angaba sengozini yokuthola i-chickenpox noma i-shingles uma esondelana nomuntu one-shingles? Chaza isizathu sakho.

distractor34a: Umuntu angaba sengozini yokuthola i-shingles. I-shingles iwukutheleleka kokuqala kwegciwane ngaphambi kokuba lingene ekubambezelekeni kumuntu ohlala kulo.
distractor34b: Umuntu uzoba sengozini yokuthola i-chickenpox. I-chickenpox iwukutheleleka kokuqala kwegciwane okuvele kucashile emzimbeni.
distractor34c: Umuntu angaba sengozini yokuthola i-shingles. Igciwane lingena kumuntu futhi lisebenze uma umuntu one-shingles esondelana naye.
question35: Yisiphi isinyathelo emjikelezweni wokuphindaphindeka kwamagciwane ocabanga ukuthi sibaluleke kakhulu ukuthi igciwane lithelele amangqamuzana? Chaza ukuthi kungani

distractor35b: Isinyathelo sokuhlanganiswa sibaluleke kakhulu ngoba ama-virion amasha ahlanganiswa ukuze athelele amangqamuzana.
distractor35c: Isinyathelo sokuqala sibaluleke kakhulu njengoba i-nucleic acid yegciwane idinga ukungena esitokisini somsingathi inqunu, ishiye i-capsid ngaphandle.
question36: Kwabaningi, igciwane lesimungumungwane alibangeli ukugula okukhulu. Izimpawu zifaka phakathi umkhuhlane kanye nokuqubuka, kodwa izimpawu zivame ukuphela cishe ngemva kwesonto. Kodwa-ke, kwabanye, igciwane lesimungumungwane lingaba yingozi kakhulu. Igciwane lesimungumungwane lingasibangela kanjani isifo esingaba yingozi?
answer36: Isimungumungwane singadala i-encephalitis/meningitis, okubangela ikhanda elibuhlungu, ukuquleka futhi ezimweni ezimbi kakhulu kungaba yingozi empilweni.
distractor36a: Isimungumungwane singadala isifo se-meningococcal, esibangela ikhanda elibuhlungu, ukuquleka futhi ezimweni ezimbi kakhulu singasongela ukuphila.
distractor36b: Isimungumungwane singadala isifo esihlukile seCreutzfeldt-Jakob, esibangela ikhanda elibuhlungu, ukuquleka futhi ezimweni ezimbi kakhulu singasongela ukuphila.
distractor36c: Isimungumungwane singadala isifo seLegionnaires, esibangela ikhanda elibuhlungu, ukuquleka futhi ezimweni ezimbi kakhulu singasongela ukuphila.
question37: Bheka uMfanekiso 21.21. Igrafu ikhombisa amazinga okuguquka kwamagciwane ahlukene namabhaktheriya. I-ss imele umucu owodwa, i-ds imele umucu ophindwe kabili, kanye ne-retro yama-retrovirus (amagciwane e-RNA abhala i-DNA bese eyifaka ku-DNA yabasingathi). answer37: Ama-Viroid anezakhi zofuzo ezincane futhi mancane kakhulu

question38: Bheka uMfanekiso 21.21. Igrafu ikhombisa amazinga okuguquka kwamagciwane ahlukene namabhaktheriya. I-ss imele umucu owodwa, ama-ds emucu ophindwe kabili, kanye ne-retro yama-retrovirus (amagciwane e-RNA abhala i-DNA bese eyifaka ku-DNA yabasingathi). distractor38b: Inosayizi we-genome ophakathi kuka-1,000 no-10,000 nt, cishe cishe u-5,000 nt
distractor38c: Inosayizi we-genome ophakathi kancane ngaphansi kuka-10,000 nt
question39: Ama-Prion abangela uhlobo lwe-CJD (i-Creutzfeldt Jakob Disease). Kuye kwabhalwa kanjani ukuthi lesi sifo sisakazeka sisuka kumuntu siye kumuntu?
answer39: Ukuhlinzwa ngamathuluzi asetshenziswe ngaphambilini esigulini esine-vCJD esasingahlanjululwe ngokwanele futhi ama-hormone okukhula kwe-pituitary angcolile athathwe ezindlaleni ze-pituitary zomuntu ezifile.
distractor39a: Ngokudla inyama ethelelekile kubantu kanye nama-hormone okukhula kwe-pituitary angcolile athathwe ezindlaleni ze-pituitary zabantu ezifile.
distractor39b: Ukuhlinzwa ngamathuluzi asetshenziswe ngaphambilini esigulini esine-vCJD esasingahlanjululwe ngokwanele futhi ama-hormone okukhula kwe-pineal angcolisiwe athathwe ezindlaleni ze-pineal zabantu ezidunjini ezinegciwane.
distractor39c: Ukuhlinzwa ngamathuluzi asetshenziswe ngaphambilini esigulini esine-vCJD esasingahlanjululwe ngokwanele futhi ama-hormone okukhula kwe-pituitary angcolisiwe athathwe ezindlala ze-pituitary zabantu kubantu abangaphilile kahle
question40: Bheka uMfanekiso 21.22. Isithombe sibonisa amaprotheni amabili ahilelekile ku-bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE, isifo sezinkomo ezihlanyayo). Iphrotheni engakwesobunxele iphilile. question41: Bheka uMfanekiso 21.18. Buyekeza isithombe se-prion kanye nezicubu zobuchopho ezithelelekile. Sebenzisa ukuqonda kwakho ama-prion ukuze ukhethe impendulo engcono kakhulu kulokhu okulandelayo: Kungani ukudluliselwa kwe-prion kungaxhomekile ezizakhini zofuzo ezenziwe nge-DNA noma i-RNA?

question42: Bheka uMfanekiso 21.23. Ithebula libonisa ukuHlelwa kweBaltimore okusetshenziselwa ukuhlukanisa amagciwane abe amaqembu ayisikhombisa ngokusekelwe ezintweni zawo zofuzo. Hlola ulwazi ngaphakathi komongo walokho okwaziyo ngamagciwane ukuze uphendule okulandelayo: Uyini umehluko phakathi kwendlela amagciwane eQembu I kanye neQembu III azalana ngayo?
answer42: Eqenjini I, i-RNA ibhalwa kusukela ku-genome ye-DNA kanti eqenjini III, i-RNA ibhalwa kusukela ku-genome ye-RNA.
distractor42a: Kuma-virus eQembu I, i-RNA ibhalwa kusuka ku-genome ye-RNA, kanti kuma-virus eQembu III, i-RNA ibhalwa kusuka ku-genome ye-DNA.
distractor42b: Kuma-virus eQembu I, i-DNA ibhalwa kusuka ku-genome ye-DNA, kanti kuma-virus eQembu III, i-RNA ibhalwa kusuka ku-genome ye-RNA
distractor42c: Kuma-virus eQembu I, i-DNA ibhalwa kusuka ku-genome ye-RNA, kanti kuma-virus eQembu III, i-RNA ibhalwa kusuka ku-genome ye-DNA.
question43: Bheka uMfanekiso 21.23. Ithebula libonisa ukuHlelwa kweBaltimore okusetshenziselwa ukuhlukanisa amagciwane abe amaqembu ayisikhombisa ngokusekelwe ezintweni zawo zofuzo. Hlola ukufana noma umehluko phakathi kwe-genome yeQembu I neQembu VI, kanye nendlela izinhlobo ezimbili zamagciwane ezizalana ngayo.
answer43: Ama-virus eqembu I asebenzisa i-DNA njenge-genome yawo kuyilapho ama-virus eqembu VI esebenzisa i-RNA. Ama-virus eqembu I azala ngokubhala i-RNA kusuka ku-genome yawo ye-DNA kuyilapho ama-virus eqembu VI enza i-DNA kusuka ku-RNA esebenzisa i-reverse transcriptase ngaphambi kokuba azale kabusha.
distractor43a: Amagciwane eqembu I nele-VI asebenzisa i-RNA njenge-genome yawo. Amagciwane eqembu I azalana ngokubhala i-RNA kusuka ku-genome yawo ye-DNA, kuyilapho amagciwane eqembu VI eqala ngokwakha i-genome yawo ye-RNA esebenzisa i-reverse transcriptase ngaphambi kokuba azalane.
distractor43b: Amagciwane eqembu I nele-VI asebenzisa i-DNA njenge-genome yawo. Amagciwane eqembu I azalana ngokubhala i-RNA kusuka ku-genome yawo ye-DNA kuyilapho amagciwane eqembu VI eqala ngokuqamba i-genome yawo ye-DNA esebenzisa i-reverse transcriptase ngaphambi kokuba azalane.
distractor43c: Amagciwane eqembu I nele-VI asebenzisa i-DNA njenge-genome yawo. Amagciwane eqembu I azalana ngokubhala i-RNA kusuka ku-genome yawo ye-DNA, kuyilapho amagciwane eqembu VI eqala ngokwakha i-genome ye-RNA esebenzisa i-reverse transcriptase ngaphambi kokuba azalane.
question44: Bheka uMfanekiso 21.24. Umdwebo ongezansi ukhombisa izigaba lapho igciwane lithelela khona iseli eliyibamba, elihlonzwe ngenombolo. Kungasiphi izigaba lapho inani lezinto zofuzo zegciwane liqala ukushintsha khona ngaphakathi kweseli eliyibamba? Xoxa ngempendulo yakho ngencazelo
answer44: 2, ngoba i-RNA yegciwane iphindaphindwa yi-RNA polymerase yegciwane, okwandisa inani lezinto zofuzo zegciwane esitokisini somsingathi ngaphambi kokuba amagciwane amasha ahlanganiswe.
distractor44b: 3, ngoba amagciwane amasha ayahlangana ngaphakathi kweseli
question45: Bheka uMfanekiso 21.25. Lo mfanekiso ukhombisa ukwanda kokutheleleka kwe-human papillomavirus (HPV) kanye nokukhula ngaphambi komdlavuza kanye nomdlavuza emaqenjini ahlukene eminyaka. Yisiphi isiphetho esingasifinyelela ngokusekelwe kulo mfanekiso?
answer45: Amanani aphezulu okutheleleka kwe-HPV aholela emazingeni aphezulu okukhula ngaphambi komdlavuza
distractor45a: Amanani aphezulu okutheleleka kwe-HPV aholela emazingeni aphezulu omdlavuza
distractor45b: Ukwanda kwe-HPV akuhlobene nokwanda kwesifo somdlavuza
distractor45c: Ukwanda kwe-HPV akuhlobene nokwanda kwezifo ngaphambi komdlavuza
question46: Bheka uMfanekiso 21.26. I-dia amagremu engezansi ibonisa imijikelezo yokuzala ye-lytic kanye ne-lysogenic yamagciwane. Hlola umehluko phakathi kwemijikelezo ukuze uphendule okulandelayo: Yimuphi umjikelezo ozogcina i-DNA yaleli gciwane ezizukulwaneni eziningana, futhi kungani kunjalo?
answer46: I-Lysogenic, ngoba i-DNA yegciwane ingadluliselwa lapho iseli eliyibamba liphindaphinda
distractor46a: I-Lysogenic, ngoba i-DNA yegciwane ingasuswa kwi-DNA yeseli lomnikazi uma ingaphansi kokucindezeleka
distractor46b: I-Lytic, ngoba i-DNA yegciwane ingasuswa ku-DNA yeseli lomnikazi uma ingaphansi kokucindezeleka
distractor46c: I-Lytic, ngoba i-DNA yegciwane ingadluliselwa lapho iseli eliyibamba liphindaphinda
question47: Bheka uMfanekiso 21.26. I-dia amagremu engezansi ibonisa imijikelezo yokuzala ye-lytic kanye ne-lysogenic yamagciwane. Ngokusekelwe kumdwebo, hlola ukuthi lesi sitatimende esilandelayo siyiqiniso noma singamanga, bese unikeza isizathu sokusekela impendulo yakho: Umjikelezo we-lysogenic uvumela amagciwane ukuthi alondoloze i-genome yawo phakathi nezimo ezingezinhle.”
answer47: Amanga, ngoba lapho iseli eliphethe libhekana nezimo ezingezinhle, i-prophage iphuma ku-genome bese ingena kumjikelezo we-lytic
distractor47a: Yiqiniso, ngoba lapho iseli eliphethe libhekana nezimo ezingezinhle, liyayeka ukuhlukana futhi lihlale lisesimweni esifanayo.
distractor47b: Yiqiniso, ngoba iseli elibambayo esigabeni sokuphindaphinda kanye naphakathi kwezimo ezingezinhle lihlala kumjikelezo we-lysogenic njengoba umjikelezo we-lytic ufaneleka kakhulu.
distractor47c: Amanga, ngoba lapho iseli eliphethe libhekana nezimo ezingezinhle, igciwane lingena esikhathini sokulibaziseka

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.0 Introduction
chapterContent: Iningi labantu licabanga ngamabhaktheriya njengezinto eziphilayo ezibangela izifo. Nakuba amanye amabhaktheriya engabangeli izifo, amaningi awanjalo. Isibonelo, amabhaktheriya ahlala esikhumbeni sethu nasendleleni yokugaya ukudla enza izinto eziningi ezinhle kithi. Asivikela ezifweni ezibangelwa izifo, asisize ekugayeni ukudla kwethu, futhi akhiqize amanye amavithamini ethu nezinye izakhamzimba. Le misebenzi ibilokhu yaziwa isikhathi eside. Muva nje, ososayensi baqoqe ubufakazi bokuthi la mabhaktheriya angasiza futhi ekulawuleni imizwa yethu, athonye amazinga ethu omsebenzi, futhi asize ngisho nokulawula isisindo ngokuthinta ukukhetha kwethu ukudla kanye namaphethini okumunca. I-Human Microbiome Project isiqalile inqubo yokuhlukanisa amabhaktheriya ethu avamile (kanye ne-archaea) ukuze siqonde kangcono le misebenzi. Bheka Umfanekiso 22.1
question1: Iyiphi indima ebalulekile yamabhaktheriya avamile emzimbeni womuntu?
answer1: Zisisiza ekusivikeleni ezifweni ezibangelwa amagciwane futhi zisize ekugayweni kokudla okugayiwe
distractor1a: Zibhubhisa zonke ezinye izinto eziphilayo emzimbeni
distractor1c: Zithatha indawo yamangqamuzana omuntu njengoba siguga
question2: Yimuphi umsebenzi ohlose ukuqoqa ama-microorganism avame ukuhlala futhi aphile kubantu?
answer2: Iphrojekthi ye-Human Microbiome
question3: Ngokusho kocwaningo lwamanje, amabhaktheriya e-commensal angathonya yikuphi okulandelayo?
answer3: Isimo sengqondo, amazinga omsebenzi, kanye nesisindo somzimba
question4: Kungani amabhaktheriya amaningi ebhekwa njengenzuzo kunokuba abe yingozi?
answer4: Zikhiqiza amavithamini, zisize ekugayeni ukudla, futhi zivikele ezifweni ezibangelwa amagciwane
question5: Atholakala kuphi amabhaktheriya avamile emzimbeni womuntu?
answer5: Esikhumbeni kanye nasemzimbeni wokugaya ukudla
question6: Iyini inhloso eyinhloko yeProjekthi ye-Human Microbiome?
answer6: Ukuqonda kangcono amabhaktheriya avamile kanye ne-archaea aphila kubantu
distractor6a: Ukususa zonke izinto eziphilayo emzimbeni womuntu

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.1 Ukuhlukahluka Kwe-Prokaryotic | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.1 Prokaryotic Diversity | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Esikhathini esidlule samuva nje, ososayensi bahlanganisa izinto eziphilayo zibe imibuso eyisithupha ngokusekelwe ezindinganisweni eziningana, okuhlanganisa ukungabikho noma ukuba khona kwe-nucleus kanye nezinye i-organelles eziboshwe yi-membrane, ukungabikho noma ukuba khona kwezindonga zamaseli, ukuba namangqamuzana amaningi, njalo njalo. Njengoba sifundile ngaphambili, ama-prokaryotes ayengamaseli okuqala ukuvela eMhlabeni eminyakeni eyizigidi ezingu-3.5 kuya kwezingu-4.5 edlule futhi ayengenawo ama-nucleus nama-cytoplasmic organelles. Ngasekupheleni kwekhulu lama-20, ososayensi baqhathanisa ukulandelana kwe-RNA encane ye-ribosomal, okwaholela endleleni eyisisekelo yokuhlanganisa izinto eziphilayo eMhlabeni. Ngokusekelwe kokungafani kwesakhiwo se-membrane yamaseli naku-rRNA, uCarl Woese nozakwabo baphakamise uhlelo lwe-domain ezintathu. I-domain Bacteria ihlanganisa zonke izinto eziphilayo embusweni i-Eubacteria (amagciwane), i-domain Archaea ihlanganisa amanye ama-prokaryotes, kanti i-domain Eukarya ihlanganisa wonke ama-eukaryotes, okuhlanganisa ama-protists, isikhunta, izitshalo, nezilwane. Ama-Prokaryotes abonisa ukuhlukahluka okukhulu ngesimo nangomsebenzi futhi agcwele futhi atholakala yonke indawo. Ngaphezu kokuhlala ezindaweni ezilinganiselwe njengohlelo lokugaya ukudla komuntu, ama-prokaryote atholakala ezimweni ezimbi kakhulu (ama-extremophiles), kusukela eziphethwini ezishisayo ezibilayo kuya eGreat Salt Lake nasezindaweni ezibandayo e-Antarctica.

 Ngenxa yokuthi ama-prokaryote ahlala ezindaweni eziningi ezahlukene, athuthukise amasu amaningi okuhlangabezana nezidingo zawo zamandla, okuhlanganisa i-chemosynthesis, i-photosynthesis, ukuphefumula kwamaseli angena-aerobic, kanye nokuphefumula kwamaseli angena-aerobic. Iziphethwini ezishisayo kanye nemigodi yamanzi kungenzeka ukuthi kwakuyizindawo lapho impilo yaqala khona, futhi kukhona ubufakazi bezinsalela bokuba khona kwama-microbial mat eminyakeni engaba yizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-3.5 edlule. Phakathi neminyaka eyizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezimbili zokuqala zomlando woMhlaba, umkhathi wawuntula inani elanele lomoya-mpilo, futhi yizinto eziphilayo ezingena-aerobic kuphela ezazikwazi ukuphila. Ama-Cyanobacteria aqala kuma-phototrophs okuqala futhi aqala ukungenisa umoya-mpilo emkhathi. Ukwanda kokuhlushwa komoya-mpilo kuvumela ukuvela kwezinye izinhlobo zokuphila nezinye izinqubo ze-metabolic. Ama-prokaryote amaningi akhetha ukuhlala emiphakathini, evame ukwakha ama-biofilms.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 1 yohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Ama-Prokaryote atholakala yonke indawo. Zimboza yonke indawo ongayicabanga lapho kunomswakama owanele, futhi zihlala ngaphakathi nangaphakathi kwezinye izinto eziphilayo. Emzimbeni womuntu ojwayelekile, amangqamuzana e-prokaryotic amaningi kakhulu kunamangqamuzana omzimba womuntu cishe ngeshumi kuya kwelilodwa. Zakha iningi lezinto eziphilayo kuzo zonke izindawo zemvelo. Amanye ama-prokaryotes achuma ezindaweni ezingafaneleki kuzo izinto eziningi eziphilayo. Ama-prokaryotes aphinda asebenzise izakhamzimba—izinto ezibalulekile (njenge-carbon ne-nitrogen)—futhi aqhuba ukuvela kwezindawo zemvelo ezintsha, ezinye zazo ezingokwemvelo kanti ezinye zenziwe ngabantu. Ama-prokaryotes abelokhu ekhona eMhlabeni kusukela kudala ngaphambi kokuba kuvele ukuphila kwamangqamuzana amaningi.

answer5: Zingachuma ezindaweni ezimbi kakhulu njengeziphethu ezishisayo, amachibi anosawoti, kanye ne-Antarctica
distractor5b: Zidinga amazinga okushisa aphakathi ukuze ziphile

answer6: Eminyakeni engaba yizigidigidi ezingu-3.5 kuya kwezingu-4.5 edlule
question7: Iyiphi indima edlalwa yi-prokaryotes ezindaweni zemvelo?
answer7: Ziphinda zisebenzise izakhamzimba ezibalulekile njengekhabhoni ne-nitrogen futhi zisiza ekuqhubekiseni intuthuko yesimiso sezinto eziphilayo

answer8: Umkhathi wawuntula umoya-mpilo owanele

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.1 Ukuhlukahluka Kwama-Prokaryotes | Ama-Prokaryotes, Izakhamuzi Zokuqala Zomhlaba
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.1 Prokaryotic Diversity | Prokaryotes, the First Inhabitants of Earth
chapterContent: Ukuphila kwaqala nini futhi kuphi? Zazinjani izimo eMhlabeni lapho kuqala ukuphila? Ama-Prokaryote ayeyizinhlobo zokuqala zokuphila eMhlabeni, futhi ayekhona izigidigidi zeminyaka ngaphambi kokuba kuvele izitshalo nezilwane. Umhlaba nenyanga yawo kucatshangwa ukuthi uneminyaka engaba yizigidigidi ezingu-4.54 ubudala. Lokhu kulinganiselwa kusekelwe ebufakazini obuvela ekubalweni kwe-radiometric kwezinto ze-meteorite kanye nezinye izinto ezingaphansi komhlaba ezivela eMhlabeni nasenyangeni. Umhlaba wakuqala wawunomoya ohlukile kakhulu (owawuqukethe i-oxygen encane yama-molecule) kunanamuhla futhi wawubhekene nemisebe enamandla; ngakho-ke, izinto zokuqala eziphilayo zaziyochuma lapho zazivikelwe khona kakhulu, njengasekujuleni kolwandle noma ngaphansi kobuso boMhlaba. Ngalesi sikhathi futhi, umsebenzi omkhulu wentaba-mlilo wawuvamile eMhlabeni, ngakho-ke kungenzeka ukuthi lezi zinto zokuqala eziphilayo—ama-prokaryote okuqala—zazijwayele amazinga okushisa aphezulu kakhulu. Umhlaba wakuqala wawuthambekele ekuguqukeni kwe-geological kanye nokuqhuma kwentaba-mlilo, futhi wawuhlaselwa yimisebe ye-mutagenic evela elangeni. Izinto zokuqala eziphilayo zazingama-prokaryote ayengakwazi ukumelana nalezi zimo ezinzima.
question1: Yiziphi izinhlobo zokuqala zokuphila eMhlabeni?
answer1: Ama-Prokaryotes
question2: Cishe uMhlaba nenyanga yawo kudala kangakanani?
answer2: Cishe iminyaka eyizigidigidi ezingu-4.54 ubudala
question3: Iminyaka elinganiselwa yoMhlaba yanqunywa kanjani?
answer3: Ngokusebenzisa i-radiometric dating yama-meteorite nezinto ezivela eMhlabeni nasenyangeni
question4: Kungani izinto eziphilayo zokuqala cishe zatholakala ekujuleni kolwandle noma ngaphansi kobuso boMhlaba?
answer4: Lezi zindawo zazivikela emisebeni enamandla
distractor4c: Ukukhanya kwelanga kwakudingeka kubo bonke abantu abasebasha
question5: Yisiphi isimo semvelo esasivamile eMhlabeni wakuqala?
answer5: Umsebenzi ovame ukwenzeka wezintaba-mlilo kanye nokuguquka kwesimo sendawo
question6: Yisiphi isici esavumela ama-prokaryotes okuqala ukuba asinde eMhlabeni wakuqala?
answer6: Bazivumelanisa nezimo ezinzima, okuhlanganisa amazinga okushisa aphezulu kakhulu
distractor6c: Babedinga izitshalo eziqhakazayo ukuze bathole izakhamzimba
question7: Umkhathi wakuqala woMhlaba wawuhluke kanjani kumkhathi wanamuhla?
answer7: Yayiqukethe umoya-mpilo omncane kakhulu wama-molecule

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.1 Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Ama-Prokaryotes, Izakhamuzi Zokuqala Zomhlaba | Ama-Microbial Mat
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.1 Prokaryotic Diversity | Prokaryotes, the First Inhabitants of Earth | Microbial Mats
chapterContent:
Ama-microbial mat noma ama-biofilm amakhulu angase amele izinhlobo zokuqala zokuphila eMhlabeni; kunobufakazi bezinsalela bokuba khona kwawo kusukela eminyakeni engaba yizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-3.5 eyedlule. I-microbial mat iyishidi lama-prokaryote elinezingqimba eziningi (Isithombe 22.2) elihlanganisa kakhulu amabhaktheriya, kodwa futhi ne-archaea. Ama-microbial mat anobukhulu obuncane amasentimitha, futhi ngokuvamile akhula lapho izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinto zihlangana khona, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezimanzi. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zama-prokaryote eziwakhayo zenza izindlela ezahlukene ze-metabolic, futhi yingakho imibala yazo ehlukahlukene. Ama-prokaryote kuma-microbial mat abanjwe ndawonye yinto enamathelayo efana neglue ayikhipha ebizwa ngokuthi i-extracellular matrix.

 Ama-microbial mat okuqala cishe athola amandla awo kumakhemikhali atholakala eduze kwemigodi yamanzi. I-hydrothermal vent iwukuphuka noma ukuqhekeka ebusweni boMhlaba okukhipha amanzi afudumele ngokwe-geothermal. Ngokuvela kwe-photosynthesis eminyakeni engaba yizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezintathu edlule, amanye ama-prokaryotes kuma-microbial mats aqala ukusebenzisa umthombo wamandla otholakala kabanzi—ukukhanya kwelanga—kanti amanye ayesathembele kumakhemikhali avela emithonjeni yamanzi ukuze athole amandla nokudla.
question1: Ayini ama-microbial mat?
answer1: Amashidi e-prokaryotes anezingqimba eziningi akhiwe ikakhulukazi amabhaktheriya kanye ne-archaea
distractor1a: Izendlalelo ze-algae kanye ne-fungi ezikhula emachibini ahlanzekile

answer5: Ezindaweni ezimanzi lapho izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinto zihlangana khona

answer7: Ukuvela kwe-photosynthesis

chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.1 Prokaryotic Diversity | Prokaryotes, the First Inhabitants of Earth | Stromatolites
chapterContent: Ama-microbial mat aqoshwe phansi amelela irekhodi lokuqala lokuphila eMhlabeni. I-stromatolite isakhiwo se-sedimentary esakhiwe lapho amaminerali ekhishwa emanzini ngama-prokaryotes kuma-microbial mat (Isithombe 22.3). Ama-stromatolite akha amatshe agqitshwe nge-carbonate noma i-silicate. Nakuba ama-stromatolite amaningi ayizinto zakudala, kunezindawo eMhlabeni lapho ama-stromatolite esakhiwa khona. Isibonelo, ama-stromatolite akhulayo atholakale e-Anza-Borrego Desert State Park eSan Diego County, eCalifornia.
question1: Iyini i-stromatolite?
answer1: Isakhiwo se-sedimentary esakhiwe lapho amaminerali ekhishwa emanzini ngama-prokaryotes ku-mat ye-microbial
distractor1a: Ikoloni le-algae ye-eukaryotic eyenziwe yaba yizinsalela
question2: Kungani ama-stromatolite ebalulekile kososayensi?
answer2: Zimelela obunye bobufakazi bokuqala bezinto zasendulo zokuphila eMhlabeni
distractor2c: Zifakazela ukuthi ama-dinosaur ayehlala ezindaweni zasolwandle
question3: Yiziphi izinhlobo zamatshe ngokuvamile ezakhiwa ama-stromatolite?
answer3: Amatshe anezingqimba ze-carbonate noma ze-silicate
question4: Ama-stromatolite akheka kanjani?
answer4: Ama-prokaryotes kuma-microbial mats akhipha amaminerali emanzini, adale izakhiwo ze-sedimentary ezingqimba
distractor4a: Ukuqhuma kwentaba-mlilo kubeka izingqimba ze-lava phezu kwamagciwane
distractor4b: Izilwane zicindezela udaka lube amatshe agqitshwe ngendwangu
distractor4c: Umoya ubeka isihlabathi nxazonke zezitshalo ezifile
question5: Ingabe ama-stromatolite atholakala kuphela njengezinsalela zasendulo?
answer5: Cha, ama-stromatolite asakhiwa kwezinye izindawo nanamuhla
distractor5a: Yebo, zaphela eminyakeni engaphezu kwezigidigidi ezimbili edlule
distractor5b: Yebo, zakhiwa ngaphambi kokuba i-photosynthesis ivele
question6: Ingatholakalaphi i-stromatolite ekhula namuhla ngokusho kombhalo?
answer6: Ipaki Kahulumeni Yase-Anza-Borrego Desert eSan Diego County, eCalifornia

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.1 Ukuhlukahluka Kwama-Prokaryotes | Ama-Prokaryotes, Izakhamuzi Zokuqala Zomhlaba | Umkhathi Wasendulo
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.1 Prokaryotic Diversity | Prokaryotes, the First Inhabitants of Earth | The Ancient Atmosphere
chapterContent:
Ubufakazi bubonisa ukuthi phakathi neminyaka eyizigidi ezimbili zokuqala zokuba khona koMhlaba, umkhathi wawungenawo umoya-mpilo, okusho ukuthi kwakungekho umoya-mpilo wama-molecule. Ngakho-ke, yilabo kuphela izinto eziphilayo ezingakhula ngaphandle komoya-mpilo—izinto eziphilayo ezingenawo umoya-mpilo—ezazikwazi ukuphila. Izinto eziphilayo ezizenzakalelayo eziguqula amandla elanga abe amandla amakhemikhali zibizwa ngokuthi ama-phototrophs, futhi zavela zingakapheli iminyaka eyizigidi eziyinkulungwane kusukela kwadalwa uMhlaba. Ngemuva kwalokho, ama-cyanobacteria, aziwa nangokuthi i-algae eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, avela kulezi zi-phototrophs ezilula eminyakeni eyizigidi eziyinkulungwane kamuva. Ama-Cyanobacteria (Isithombe 22.4) aqala ukungenisa umoya-mpilo emkhathi. Ukwanda komoya-mpilo womkhathi kwavumela ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlela ezisebenza kahle ze-O2 ezisebenzisa i-catabolic. Kwavula futhi umhlaba ukuze kwandiswe ukoloni, ngoba enye i-O2 iguqulwa ibe yi-O3 (i-ozone) futhi i-ozone imunca ngempumelelo ukukhanya kwe-ultraviolet okwakungabangela ukuguqulwa okubulalayo ku-DNA. Ekugcineni, ukwanda kokuhlushwa kwe-O2 kwavumela ukuvela kwezinye izinhlobo zokuphila.

 Umhlaba Wasekuqaleni wawungenazo izinto eziningi eziphilayo njengoba siwazi namuhla, ngenani elikhulu lokuguquguquka kwezakhi zofuzo, umsebenzi wezintaba-mlilo, kanye nomoya ongenawo umoya (okusho ukuthi wawuntula umoya-mpilo). Ngakho-ke, imvelaphi yokuphila eMhlabeni ithakazelisa kakhulu ososayensi.

 Enye yemibono yokuqala yokuthi ukuphila kwaqala kanjani eMhlabeni kwakuyi-panspermia, esukela ekhulwini lesi-5 BC. I-Panspermia ingumqondo wokuthi ukuphila kusatshalaliswa ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zendawo yonke ezintweni ezifana nama-meteoroid nama-asteroids. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, i-organic com amakhilogremu kanye nama-microorganisms azokwazi ukusinda ezimweni ezimbi kakhulu zesikhala.

 Kodwa-ke, ngawo-1960, ososayensi uStanley Miller noHarold Urey benze izivivinyo zelebhu ezabonisa ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi i-organic com amakhilogremu, kufaka phakathi ama-amino acid, yakhiwe ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile kusuka kuma-molecule angaphili kanye namandla, kokubili okwakungaba khona ezimweni zokuqala zoMhlaba. Ngemva kwalokho, kwatholakala ubufakazi obuyimivubukulo bama-microbial mata ngemigodi yamanzi ashisayo olwandle olujulile, obusukela eminyakeni eyizigidigidi ezingu-3.5 edlule. Ngenxa yalokho, manje sekukhona imibono eminingana mayelana nokuthi impilo yayingavela kanjani eMhlabeni.
question1: Kusho ukuthini ukuthi umkhathi wasekuqaleni woMhlaba wawunobuthi?
answer1: Yayingenayo i-oxygen yama-molecule
question2: Yiziphi izinto eziphilayo ezakwazi ukusinda eminyakeni yokuqala eyizigidigidi ezimbili eMhlabeni?

answer4: Ama-cyanobacteria

answer6: I-ozone imunce imisebe ye-ultraviolet eyingozi engalimaza i-DNA

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.1 Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | Amagciwane Ayakwazi Ukuzivumelanisa Nezimo: Ukuphila Ezindaweni Ezimaphakathi Nezinzima Kakhulu
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.1 Prokaryotic Diversity | Microbes Are Adaptable: Life in Moderate and Extreme Environments
chapterContent:
Ezinye izinto eziphilayo ziye zasungula amasu azivumela ukuba zisinde ezimweni ezinzima. Ama-Prokaryote ayachuma ezindaweni eziningi ezahlukene: Amanye akhula ezimweni ezingabonakala zijwayelekile kithi, kanti amanye akwazi ukuchuma futhi akhule ngaphansi kwezimo ezingabulala isitshalo noma isilwane. Cishe wonke ama-prokaryote anodonga lweseli, isakhiwo esivikelayo esiwavumela ukuba asinde ezimweni ezimbili eziyingozi kanye neziyingozi. Amanye ama-bacteria enhlabathi akwazi ukwakha ama-endospores amelana nokushisa nesomiso, ngaleyo ndlela avumela izinto eziphilayo ukuba zisinde kuze kube yilapho izimo ezinhle zibuya. Lokhu kuguquguquka, kanye nokunye, kuvumela ama-bacteria ukuba abe uhlobo lokuphila oluningi kakhulu kuzo zonke izindawo zemvelo zasemhlabeni nezasemanzini.

 Amanye ama-bacteria nama-archaea ajwayele ukukhula ngaphansi kwezimo ezimbi kakhulu futhi abizwa ngokuthi ama-extremophile, okusho ukuthi abathandi bezinto ezimbi kakhulu.” Ama-extremophile atholakale kuzo zonke izinhlobo zezindawo: ukujula kolwandle, imithombo eshisayo, i-Artic kanye ne-Antarctic, ezindaweni ezomile kakhulu, ekujuleni koMhlaba, ezindaweni ezinobungozi zamakhemikhali, kanye nasezindaweni ezinemisebe ephezulu (Isithombe 22.5), ukubala nje ezimbalwa. Lezi zinto eziphilayo zisinika ukuqonda okungcono kokuhlukahluka kwe-prokaryotic futhi zivula ithuba lokuthola izinhlobo ezintsha ze-prokaryotic ezingaholela ekutholakaleni kwemithi emisha yokwelapha noma zibe nezicelo zezimboni. Ngenxa yokuthi zinezindlela ezikhethekile ezizivumela ukuba ziphile ezimweni ezimbi kakhulu, ama-extremophile amaningi awakwazi ukusinda ezindaweni ezimaphakathi. Kunamaqembu amaningi ahlukene ama-extremophile: Atholakala ngokusekelwe ezimweni lapho ekhula khona kangcono, futhi izindawo eziningana zokuhlala zimbi kakhulu ngezindlela eziningi. Isibonelo, ichibi le-soda linosawoti kanye ne-alkaline, ngakho-ke izinto eziphilayo ezihlala echibini le-soda kumele zibe yi-alkaline kanye ne-halophiles (bheka ithebula elingezansi). Amanye ama-extremophile, njengezinto eziphilayo ezimelana nemisebe, awathandi indawo eyingozi kakhulu (kulokhu, enamazinga aphezulu emisebe), kodwa azivumelanise nokuphila kuyo (Isithombe 22.5).

chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.1 Prokaryotic Diversity | Microbes Are Adaptable: Life in Moderate and Extreme Environments | Prokaryotes in the Dead Sea
chapterContent:
Isibonelo esisodwa sendawo enzima kakhulu uLwandle Olufile, isigodi esinosawoti omningi esiphakathi kweJordani ne-Israyeli. Izindawo ezinosawoti omningi empeleni zingamanzi olwandle aqinile. OLwandle Olufile, ukugcwala kwe-sodium kuphakeme ngokuphindwe kayishumi kunokwamanzi olwandle, kanti amanzi aqukethe amazinga aphezulu e-magnesium (cishe ngokuphindwe ka-40 kunamanzi olwandle) angaba yingozi ezintweni eziningi eziphilayo. I-iron, i-calcium, kanye ne-magnesium, izakhi ezakha ama-ion ahlukene (i-Fe2+, i-Ca2+, kanye ne-Mg2+, zikhiqiza lokho okuvame ukubizwa ngokuthi amanzi aqinile. Uma kuhlanganiswa, ukugcwala okuphezulu kwama-cation ahlukene, i-pH ene-acidic (6.0), kanye nokushintshashintsha kwemisebe yelanga okukhulu kwenza uLwandle Olufile lube yindawo eyingqayizivele, futhi enobutha obuhlukile, (Isithombe 22.6).

 Hlobo luni lwama-prokaryotes esiwathola oLwandle Olufile? Ama-bacterial mat abekezelela usawoti kakhulu afaka phakathi i-Halobacterium, i-Haloferax volcanii (etholakala kwezinye izindawo, hhayi uLwandle Olufile kuphela), i-Halorubrum sodomense, kanye ne-Halobaculum gomorrense, kanye ne-archaea Haloarcula marismortui, phakathi kwezinye.
question1: Kungani uLwandle Olufile lubhekwa njengendawo enzima yezinto eziphilayo eziningi?
answer1: Inezinga likasawoti eliphezulu kakhulu, amazinga aphezulu e-magnesium, i-acidic pH, kanye nemisebe yelanga enamandla kakhulu
distractor1b: Amanzi alo abanda kakhulu unyaka wonke
question2: Ingakanani i-sodium equkethwe oLwandle Olufile uma iqhathaniswa namanzi avamile olwandle?
answer2: Kuphakeme ngokuphindwe kayishumi

answer3: Ama-Halophile
question4: Yisiphi isici soLwandle Olufile esingaba yingozi ezintweni eziningi eziphilayo?
answer4: Ukuhlushwa kwayo okuphezulu kakhulu kwe-magnesium
question5: Yiluphi uhlobo olubalwe endimeni oluyibhaktheriya elibekezelela usawoti elitholakala oLwandle Olufile?
answer5: I-Halobacteria

question7: Yisiphi isizinda esihlanganisa i-Haloarcula marismortui?

chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.1 Prokaryotic Diversity | Microbes Are Adaptable: Life in Moderate and Extreme Environments | Unculturable Prokaryotes and the Viable-but-Non-Culturable State
chapterContent:
Izazi ze-microbiologists zivame ukukhulisa ama-prokaryotes elabhorethri zisebenzisa indawo efanele yokukhulisa equkethe zonke izakhamzimba ezidingekayo yizinto eziphilayo ezihlosiwe. Le ndawo ingaba uketshezi, umhluzi, noma okuqinile. Ngemva kwesikhathi sokufukamela ekushiseni okulungile, kufanele kube nobufakazi bokukhula kwamagciwane (Isithombe 22.7). Inqubo yokukhulisa amabhaktheriya iyinkimbinkimbi futhi ingenye yezinto ezinkulu kakhulu ezitholwe yisayensi yanamuhla. Udokotela waseJalimane uRobert Koch udunyiswa ngokuthola amasu okukhulisa okuhlanzekile, okuhlanganisa ukudaya nokusebenzisa imithombo yokukhula. Umsizi wakhe uJulius Petri wasungula isidlo sikaPetri esisetshenziswa kakhulu emalabhorethri anamuhla. UKoch wasebenza kakhulu nebhaktheriya yesifo sofuba iMycobacterium ebangela isifo sofuba futhi wakha ama-postulates ukuze abone izinto eziphilayo ezibangela izifo eziqhubeka nokusetshenziswa kabanzi emphakathini wezokwelapha. Ama-postulates kaKoch afaka ukuthi into eziphilayo zingabonakala njengembangela yesifo uma zikhona kuzo zonke izibonelo ezithelelekile futhi zingekho kuzo zonke izibonelo ezinempilo, futhi ziyakwazi ukuzala kabusha ukutheleleka ngemva kokukhuliswa izikhathi eziningi. Namuhla, amasiko ahlala eyithuluzi eliyinhloko lokuxilonga kwezokwelapha nakwezinye izindawo zebhayoloji yama-molecular.

 Nokho, amanye ama-prokaryote awakwazi ukukhula endaweni yelebhu. Eqinisweni, amaphesenti angaphezu kwangu-99 amabhaktheriya nama-archaea awakwazi ukukhuliswa. Ngokuvamile, lokhu kungenxa yokuntuleka kolwazi lokuthi yini okufanele yondle lezi zinto eziphilayo nokuthi zingakhuliswa kanjani; zinezidingo ezikhethekile zokukhula ezingaziwa ososayensi, njengokudinga izakhamzimba ezithile, i-pH, izinga lokushisa, ingcindezi, ama-co-factor, noma ama-co-metabolites. Amanye amabhaktheriya awakwazi ukukhuliswa ngoba ayizilokazane ezingaphakathi kweseli futhi awakwazi ukukhuliswa ngaphandle kweseli elibambayo.

 Kwezinye izimo, izinto eziphilayo ezikhuliswayo azikwazi ukukhuliswa ngaphansi kwezimo ezicindezelayo, yize izinto eziphilayo ezifanayo zingakhuliswa ngaphambilini. Lezo zinto eziphilayo ezingenakukhuliswa kodwa ezingakafi zisesimweni esisebenzayo kodwa esingakhuliswa (i-VBNC). Isimo se-VBNC senzeka lapho ama-prokaryote esabela ezingcindezini zemvelo ngokungena esimweni sokulala esivumela ukusinda kwawo. Izindlela zokungena esimweni se-VBNC aziqondakali ngokuphelele. Enqubweni ebizwa ngokuthi ukuvuselelwa, i-prokaryote ingabuyela empilweni evamile lapho izimo zemvelo zithuthuka.

 Ingabe isimo se-VBNC siyindlela engavamile yokuphila yama-prokaryote? Eqinisweni, iningi lama-prokaryote ahlala enhlabathini noma emanzini olwandle awakwazi ukukhuliswa. Kuthiwa ingxenye encane kuphela, mhlawumbe iphesenti elilodwa, lama-prokaryote angakhuliswa ngaphansi kwezimo zelebhu. Uma lezi zinto eziphilayo zingakhuliswa, khona-ke kwaziwa kanjani ukuthi zikhona futhi ziyaphila? Izazi ze-microbiologist zisebenzisa amasu ama-molecule, njenge-polymerase chain reaction (PCR), ukukhulisa izingxenye ezikhethiwe ze-DNA yama-prokaryote, okubonisa ukuthi akhona. Khumbula ukuthi i-PCR ingenza izigidigidi zamakhophi esigaba se-DNA enqubweni ebizwa ngokuthi i-amplification
question1: Ubani ohlonishwa ngokuthuthukisa amasu okuthola amasiko ahlanzekile amagciwane?
answer1: URobert Koch

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.1 Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | I-Ecology Yama-Biofilms
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.1 Prokaryotic Diversity | The Ecology of Biofilms
chapterContent:
Kuze kube yiminyaka embalwa edlule, izazi zezinto eziphilayo ezincane zazicabanga ngama-prokaryotes njengezinto ezihlukene ezihlala ngokwehlukana. Nokho, lo modeli awubonisi imvelo yangempela yama-prokaryotes, iningi lawo elikhetha ukuhlala emiphakathini lapho lingasebenzisana khona. I-biofilm umphakathi wezinto eziphilayo ezincane (Isithombe 22.8) obanjwe ndawonye ku-matrix ene-gummy-textured equkethe ikakhulukazi ama-polysaccharides akhishwa yizinto eziphilayo, kanye namanye amaprotheni nama-nucleic acid. Ama-biofilms akhula anamathele ezindaweni. Amanye ama-biofilms afundwe kahle akhiwa ama-prokaryotes, yize ama-biofilms e-fungal nawo echazwe kanye namanye akhiwe ngengxube ye-fungi namabhaktheriya.

 Ama-biofilms akhona cishe yonke indawo: angabangela ukuvaleka kwamapayipi futhi ahlale kalula ezindaweni zezimboni. Ezimweni zakamuva, ezinkulu zokungcoliswa kokudla ngamagciwane, ama-biofilms adlale indima enkulu. Zihlala ezindaweni zasekhaya, njengezindawo zokuphekela zasekhishini, amabhodi okusika, amasinki, nezindlu zangasese, kanye nezindawo emzimbeni womuntu, njengezindawo zamazinyo ethu.

 Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo ezigcwala i-biofilm, kanye nendawo yazo yokuvikela i-exopolysaccharidic (EPS), kwenza le miphakathi ibe namandla kakhulu kune-free-living, noma i-planktonic, prokaryotes. Into enamathelayo ebamba amabhaktheriya ndawonye futhi ayihlanganisi ama-antibiotic amaningi kanye nama-disinfectants, okwenza amabhaktheriya e-biofilm aqine kakhulu kune-planktonic. Sekukonke, ama-biofilm kunzima kakhulu ukuwabhubhisa ngoba amelana nezinhlobo eziningi ezivamile zokubulala amagciwane.

chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.2 Structure of Prokaryotes | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Izizinda I-Archaea nama-bacteria aqukethe izinto eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa ezingenayo i-nucleus kanye nezinye i-organelles eziboshwe yi-membrane. La maqembu amabili anomehluko omkhulu we-biochemical kanye nokwakheka. Iningi lawo linodonga lweseli olungaphandle kwe-plasma cell membrane, ukwakheka kwalo kungahluka phakathi kwamaqembu, kanti amaningi anezakhiwo ezengeziwe njenge-flagella ne-pili. Ama-Prokaryotes nawo anama-ribosome, lapho kwenzeka khona ukwenziwa kwamaprotheni. Ngenhloso ye-AP®, akudingeki ukuthi ubambe ngekhanda amaqembu ahlukahlukene amabhaktheriya. Nokho, kufanele ukwazi ukuhlukanisa phakathi kwama-prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes futhi wazi izizinda.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 kanye ne-Big Idea 3 yohlaka lwe-AP® Biology Curriculum. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuhlaka lwe-Curriculum zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 2

 Kunomehluko omkhulu phakathi kwamaseli e-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic. Kodwa-ke, wonke amaseli anezakhiwo ezine ezivamile: i-plasma membrane, esebenza njengesivikelo seseli futhi ihlukanise iseli endaweni yalo; i-cytoplasm, into efana nejeli ngaphakathi kweseli; ama-nucleic acid, izinto zofuzo zeseli; kanye nama-ribosome, lapho kwenzeka khona ukwenziwa kwamaprotheni. Ama-Prokaryote afika ngezimo ezahlukene, kodwa amaningi awela ezigabeni ezintathu: i-cocci (eyisiyingi), i-bacilli (emise okwenduku), kanye ne-spirilli (emise okwe-spiral) (Isithombe 22.9)

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.2 Ukwakheka Kwama-Prokaryotes | Iseli Le-Prokaryotic
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.2 Structure of Prokaryotes | The Prokaryotic Cell
chapterContent:
Khumbula ukuthi ama-prokaryotes (Isithombe 22.10) ayizinto eziphilayo ezi-unicellular ezingenazo i-organelles noma ezinye izakhiwo zangaphakathi eziboshwe yi-membrane. Ngakho-ke, azinayo i-nucleus kodwa kunalokho ngokuvamile zine-chromosome eyodwa—ucezu lwe-DNA eyindilinga, enezintambo ezimbili olutholakala endaweni yeseli ebizwa ngokuthi i-nucleoid. Ama-prokaryotes amaningi anodonga lweseli ngaphandle kwe-plasma membrane.

 Khumbula ukuthi ama-prokaryotes ahlukaniswe ngama-domain amabili ahlukene, i-Bacteria kanye ne-Archaea, kanye ne-Eukarya, ezakha ama-domain amathathu okuphila (Isithombe 22.11).

 Ukwakheka kodonga lweseli kuhluka kakhulu phakathi kwama-domain Ama-Bacteria kanye ne-Archaea. Ukwakheka kwezindonga zeseli lawo kuhlukile nasezindongeni zeseli ze-eukaryotic ezitholakala ezitshalweni (i-cellulose) noma i-fungi kanye nezinambuzane (i-chitin). Udonga lweseli lusebenza njengengqimba evikelayo, futhi lunesibopho sokuma kwento ephilayo. Amanye ama-bacteria ane-capsule yangaphandle ngaphandle kodonga lweseli. Ezinye izakhiwo zikhona kwezinye izinhlobo ze-prokaryotic, kodwa hhayi kwezinye (Ithebula 22.2). Isibonelo, i-capsule etholakala kwezinye izinhlobo yenza kube lula ukuthi izinto eziphilayo zinamathele ezindaweni, ziyivikele ekuphelelweni amanzi emzimbeni nasekuhlaselweni ngamaseli e-phagocytic, futhi zenze amagciwane amelane kakhulu nezimpendulo zethu zomzimba. Ezinye izinhlobo zine-flagella (eyodwa, i-flagellum) esetshenziselwa ukuhamba, kanye ne-pili (eyodwa, i-pilus) esetshenziselwa ukunamathela ezindaweni. Ama-plasmid, aqukethe i-extra-chromosome DNA, nawo akhona ezinhlotsheni eziningi zamabhaktheriya kanye ne-archaea.

 Izici ze-phyla yamaBhaktheriya zichazwe ku-Figure 22.12 kanye no-Figure 22.13; I-Archaea ichazwe ku-Figure 22.14

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.2 Ukwakheka Kwama-Prokaryotes | Iseli Le-Prokaryotic | Ulwelwesi Lwe-Plasma
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.2 Structure of Prokaryotes | The Prokaryotic Cell | The Plasma Membrane
chapterContent: I-plasma membrane iyi-lipid bilayer encane (6 kuya ku-8 nano amamitha ) ezungeze ngokuphelele iseli futhi ihlukanise ingaphakathi nengaphandle. Indlela yayo yokungena kalula igcina ama-ion, amaprotheni, kanye namanye ama-molecule ngaphakathi kweseli futhi iwavimbele ekusakazekeni endaweni engaphandle kweseli, kuyilapho amanye ama-molecule engase ahambe nge-membrane. Khumbula ukuthi isakhiwo esijwayelekile se-cell membrane yi-phospholipid bilayer eyakhiwe yizingqimba ezimbili zama-lipid molecule. Ku-archaeal cell membranes, amaketanga e-isoprene (phytanyl) axhunywe ku-glycerol athatha indawo yama-fatty acid axhunywe ku-glycerol kuma-bacterial membranes. Amanye ama-archaeal membranes angama-lipid monolayer esikhundleni sama-bilayer (Isithombe 22.14)

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.2 Ukwakheka Kwama-Prokaryotes | Iseli Le-Prokaryotic | Udonga Lweseli
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.2 Structure of Prokaryotes | The Prokaryotic Cell | The Cell Wall
chapterContent:
I-cytoplasm yamaseli e-prokaryotic inezinga eliphezulu lama-solutes ancibilikisiwe. Ngakho-ke, ingcindezi ye-osmotic ngaphakathi kweseli iphakeme kakhulu. Udonga lweseli luyingqimba evikelayo ezungeze amanye amaseli futhi iwanike ukuma nokuqina. Lutholakala ngaphandle kwe-membrane yeseli futhi luvimbela i-osmotic lysis (ukuqhuma ngenxa yokwanda kwevolumu). Ukwakheka kwamakhemikhali kwezindonga zeseli kuyahlukahluka phakathi kwe-archaea namabhaktheriya, futhi kuyahlukahluka phakathi kwezinhlobo zamabhaktheriya.

 Izindonga zeseli lamabhaktheriya ziqukethe i-peptidoglycan, eyakhiwe ngamaketanga e-polysaccharide axhunyaniswe ngama-peptide angavamile aqukethe ama-amino acid e-L- kanye ne-D okuhlanganisa i-D-glutamic acid kanye ne-D-alanine. Amaprotheni ngokuvamile anama-amino acid e-L kuphela; ngenxa yalokho, ama-antibiotic ethu amaningi asebenza ngokulingisa ama-amino acid e-D ngakho-ke anemiphumela ethile ekuthuthukisweni kodonga lweseli lamabhaktheriya. Kunezinhlobo ezingaphezu kwe-100 ezahlukene ze-peptidoglycan. Amaprotheni engqimba engu-S (ungqimba olungaphezulu) nawo akhona ngaphandle kwezindonga zeseli ze-archaea namabhaktheriya.

 Amabhaktheriya ahlukaniswe ngamaqembu amabili amakhulu: i-Gram positive ne-Gram negative, ngokusekelwe ekusabeleni kwawo ekudayini kwe-Gram. Qaphela ukuthi wonke amabhaktheriya e-Gram-positive angamalungu ama-phyla amabili (ama-Firmicutes nama-Actinobacteria); amabhaktheriya kwenye i-phyla (ama-Proteobacteria, ama-Chlamydia, ama-Spirochetes, ama-Cyanobacteria, nabanye) ange-Gram-negative. Indlela yokufaka i-Gram staining iqanjwe ngomsunguli wayo, usosayensi waseDenmark uHans Christian Gram (1853–1938). Izimpendulo ezahlukene zamabhaktheriya enkambisweni yokufaka i-dain ekugcineni zibangelwa isakhiwo sodonga lwamaseli. Izinto eziphilayo ze-Gram-positive ngokuvamile azinalo ulwelwesi lwangaphandle olutholakala ezintweni eziphilayo ze-Gram-negative (Isithombe 22.15). Kufika kumaphesenti angama-90 odonga lwamaseli kumabhaktheriya e-Gram-positive akhiwa yi-peptidoglycan, kanti iningi lazo zonke ezinye lakhiwe ngezinto ezi-acidic ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-teichoic acid. Ama-Teichoic acid angase axhunywe ndawonye nama-lipids kulwelwesi lwe-plasma ukuze akhe ama-lipoteichoic acid. Ama-Lipoteichoic acid aqinisa udonga lwamaseli kulwelwesi lwamaseli. Amabhaktheriya angenayo i-gram anodonga lweseli oluncane kakhulu olwakhiwe yizingqimba ezimbalwa ze-peptidoglycan (amaphesenti ayi-10 kuphela odonga lweseli lonke), oluzungezwe yi-envelope yangaphandle equkethe ama-lipopolysaccharides (LPS) nama-lipoprotein. Le envelope yangaphandle ngezinye izikhathi ibizwa ngokuthi i-lipid bilayer yesibili. I-chemistry yale envelope yangaphandle ihluke kakhulu, nokho, kuleyo ye-lipid bilayer evamile eyakha ama-plasma membranes.

 Izindonga zamaseli e-Archaean azinayo i-peptidoglycan. Kunezinhlobo ezine ezahlukene zezindonga zamaseli e-Archaean. Uhlobo olulodwa lwakhiwe yi-pseudopeptidoglycan, efana ne-peptidoglycan ngokwesimo kodwa equkethe ushukela ohlukile ku-polysaccharide chain. Ezinye izinhlobo ezintathu zezindonga zamaseli zakhiwe ngama-polysaccharides, ama-glycoprotein, noma iphrotheni emsulwa.

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.2 Isakhiwo Sama-Prokaryotes | Ukuzala
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.2 Structure of Prokaryotes | Reproduction
chapterContent:
Ukuzalela kuma-prokaryotes akusebenzi ngokocansi futhi kuvame ukwenzeka ngokuhlukana kwe-binary. Khumbula ukuthi i-DNA ye-prokaryote ikhona njenge-chromosome eyodwa, eyindilinga. Ama-prokaryote awadluli ku-mitosis. Kunalokho i-chromosome iyaphindaphindwa futhi amakhophi amabili avelayo ayahlukana, ngenxa yokukhula kweseli. I-prokaryote, manje ekhulisiwe, icindezelwa ngaphakathi enkabazwe yayo futhi amaseli amabili avelayo, angama-clone, ahlukene. Ukuhlukana kwe-binary akunikezi ithuba lokuhlanganiswa kabusha kwezakhi zofuzo noma ukuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo, kodwa ama-prokaryote angabelana ngezakhi zofuzo ngezinye izindlela ezintathu.

 Ekuguqulweni, i-prokaryote ithatha i-DNA etholakala endaweni yayo ekhishwa amanye ama-prokaryote. Uma i-bacterium engeyona i-pathogenic ithatha i-DNA yezakhi zofuzo ezinobuthi ezivela ku-pathogen futhi ifaka i-DNA entsha ku-chromosome yayo, nayo ingaba yi-pathogenic. Ekudluliselweni, ama-bacteriophages, amagciwane athelela amabhaktheriya, ngezinye izikhathi nawo ahambisa izingcezu ezimfushane ze-DNA ye-chromosome kusuka kwelinye i-bacterium iye kwelinye. Ukudluliselwa kwezakhi zofuzo kuphumela ekubeni yinto ephilayo ephinde yahlanganiswa. I-Archaea ayithintwa ama-bacteriophages kodwa kunalokho inamagciwane ayo adlulisela izinto zofuzo kusuka komunye umuntu ziye komunye. Ekuhlanganisweni, i-DNA idluliselwa kusuka kwenye i-prokaryote iye kwenye nge-pilus, ehlanganisa izinto eziphilayo. I-DNA edluliselwe ingaba ngesimo se-plasmid noma njenge-hybrid, equkethe i-plasmid kanye ne-chromosome DNA. Lezi zinqubo ezintathu zokushintshana kwe-DNA ziboniswe kuMfanekiso 22.17.

 Ukuzala kungaba ngokushesha kakhulu: imizuzu embalwa kwezinye izinhlobo. Lesi sikhathi esifushane sokuzalwa esihambisana nezindlela zokuhlanganiswa kwezakhi zofuzo kanye namazinga aphezulu okuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuphumela ekuguqukeni okusheshayo kwama-prokaryotes, okuwavumela ukuthi aphendule ezinguqukweni zemvelo (njengokwethulwa kwe-antibiotic) ngokushesha okukhulu.

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.2 Ukwakheka Kwama-Prokaryotes | Ukuvela Kwama-Prokaryotes
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.2 Structure of Prokaryotes | The Evolution of Prokaryotes
chapterContent:
Ososayensi bayiphendula kanjani imibuzo mayelana nokuvela kwama-prokaryotes? Ngokungafani nezilwane, izinto zobuciko ezirekhodini lezinsalela zama-prokaryotes zinikeza ulwazi oluncane kakhulu. Izinsalela zama-prokaryotes asendulo zibukeka njengezibhamuza ezincane edwaleni. Abanye ososayensi baphendukela ku-genetics kanye nesimiso sewashi lama-molecule, esiphethe ngokuthi njengoba izinhlobo ezimbili zisanda kuhlukana, kulapho izakhi zofuzo zazo (kanjalo namaprotheni) zizoba zifana kakhulu. Ngokuphambene nalokho, izinhlobo ezahlukana kudala zizoba nezakhi zofuzo eziningi ezingafani.

 Ososayensi e-NASA Astrobiology Institute kanye nase-European Molecular Biology Laboratory babambisana ukuhlaziya ukuvela kwama-molecule kwamaprotheni athile angu-32 avamile ezinhlotsheni ezingu-72 zama-prokaryotes.2 Imodeli abayithole kudatha yabo ikhombisa ukuthi amaqembu amathathu abalulekile ama-bacteria—i-Actinobacteria, i-Deinococcus, ne-Cyanobacteria (ababhali abayibiza ngokuthi i-Terrabacteria)—ayengawokuqala ukuqoqa umhlaba. (Khumbula ukuthi i-Deinococcus uhlobo lwe-prokaryote—ibhaktheriya—emelana kakhulu nemisebe ye-ionizing.) Ama-Cyanobacteria angama-photosynthesizers, kuyilapho ama-Actinobacteria eyiqembu lamabhaktheriya avamile kakhulu afaka izinhlobo ezibalulekile ekuboleni kwemfucuza yezinto eziphilayo.

 Izikhathi zokuhlukana zisikisela ukuthi amabhaktheriya (amalungu e-domain Bacteria) ahluka ezinhlotsheni ezivamile zokhokho phakathi kweminyaka eyizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-2.5 nezingu-3.2 eyedlule, kanti ama-archaea ahluka ngaphambilini: phakathi kweminyaka eyizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-3.1 nezingu-4.1 eyedlule. Kamuva ama-Eukarya ahlukana nomugqa wama-Archaean. Ama-stromatolite angenye yezinto eziphilayo ezindala kakhulu ezatholakala eMhlabeni cishe eminyakeni eyizigidi ezi-3.5 eyedlule. Kukhona ubufakazi bokuthi la ma-prokaryote nawo ayengenye yezinto zokuqala ezenziwe eMhlabeni. Eqinisweni, ama-prokaryote amabhaktheriya cishe ayenesibopho sokuqongelela umoya-mpilo okokuqala emkhathini wethu nge-photosynthesis. Iqembu i-Terrabacteria lalinazo izindlela eziningi zokuhlala ezweni, njengokumelana nokomisa. Ezinye zalezi zimo zazihlobene ne-photosynthesis, njenge-com amakhilogremu evikela amaseli ekukhanyeni okweqile. Lezi zindlela zokuqala ze-prokaryotic ezihlobene ne-photosynthesis zaziyisisekelo se-photosynthesis kumaseli e-eukaryotic. Lokhu kufakazelwa ukufana kwesakhiwo kanye nomsebenzi phakathi kwamanye ama-prokaryotes e-photosynthetic kanye nama-chloroplast e-eukaryotic.

chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.3 Prokaryotic Metabolism | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ngenxa yokuthi ama-prokaryote ayizinto eziphilayo ezihlukahlukene ngokwe-metabolic, angachuma ezindaweni eziningi ezahlukene esebenzisa imithombo eminingi yamandla ne-carbon. Amanye ayizinto ezibolayo ezibalulekile ekujikelezeni kwezakhamzimba ezindaweni zemvelo, isibonelo, imijikelezo yekhabhoni ne-nitrogen. (Kamuva, sizohlola ngokujulile indima yale mijikelezo ezindaweni zemvelo.) Amabhaktheriya amaningi akha ubudlelwano bokubambisana nezinye izinto eziphilayo; isibonelo, amabhaktheriya alungisa i-nitrogen ahlala ezimpandeni zemifino. Amanye amabhaktheriya ayizifo ezibangela izifo noma ama-parasite.

 Njengawo wonke amaseli, ama-prokaryote adinga izakhamzimba ezinkulu (kufaka phakathi ikhabhoni, i-hydrogen, i-nitrogen, i-oxygen, i-phosphorus, ne-sulfur) kanye nezakhamzimba ezincane, njengezakhi zensimbi ezivela ekukhuleni nasekusebenzeni kwe-enzyme.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yoHlaka lweKharikhulamu lwe-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka lweKharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

chapterContent:
Izindawo ezahlukene kanye nezindawo zemvelo eMhlabeni zinezimo ezahlukahlukene ngokwezinga lokushisa, izakhamzimba ezitholakalayo, i-asidi, usawoti, kanye nemithombo yamandla. Ama-prokaryote ahlonyiswe kahle kakhulu ukuze aphile ngezakhamzimba nezimo eziningi. Ukuze aphile, ama-prokaryote adinga umthombo wamandla, umthombo wekhabhoni, kanye nezinye izakhamzimba ezengeziwe.

 Ama-macronutrients
Amaseli empeleni ayiqoqo elihlelwe kahle lama-macromolecule namanzi. Khumbula ukuthi ama-macromolecule akhiqizwa yi-polymerization yamayunithi amancane abizwa ngokuthi ama-monomers. Ukuze amaseli akhe wonke ama-molecule adingekayo ukuze asekele impilo, adinga izinto ezithile, ezibizwa ngokuthi izakhamzimba ndawonye. Lapho ama-prokaryote ekhula emvelweni, athola izakhamzimba zawo emvelweni. Izakhamzimba ezidingekayo ngobuningi zibizwa ngokuthi ama-macronutrients, kanti lezo ezidingekayo ngobuningi noma ngobuningi zibizwa ngokuthi ama-micronutrients. Izinto ezimbalwa nje zibhekwa njengezakhamzimba ezinkulu—ikhabhoni, i-hydrogen, i-oxygen, i-nitrogen, i-phosphorus, ne-sulfure. (I-mnemonic yokukhumbula lezi zinto isifinyezo se-CHONPS.)

 Kungani la ma-macronutrients edingeka ngobuningi? Yizingxenye ze-organic com amakhilogremu emaseli, okuhlanganisa namanzi. I-Carbon iyisici esiyinhloko kuwo wonke ama-macromolecule: ama-carbohydrate, amaprotheni, ama-nucleic acid, ama-lipid, kanye nezinye izinto eziningi amakhilogremu . I-Carbon ihlanganisa cishe amaphesenti angu-50 okwakheka kweseli. I-nitrogen imelela amaphesenti angu-12 esisindo esomile seseli elijwayelekile futhi iyisakhi samaprotheni, ama-nucleic acid, kanye nezinye izakhi zeseli. Iningi le-nitrogen elitholakala emvelweni yi-atmospheric nitrogen (N2) noma olunye uhlobo lwe-inorganic. I-diatomic nitrogen (N2) nitrogen, nokho, ingaguqulwa ibe uhlobo lwe-organic kuphela yizinto eziphilayo ezithile, ezibizwa ngokuthi izinto eziphilayo ezilungisa i-nitrogen. Kokubili i-hydrogen kanye ne-oxygen kuyingxenye yezinto eziningi eziphilayo amakhilogremu kanye namanzi. I-phosphorus iyadingeka yizo zonke izinto eziphilayo ukuze kuhlanganiswe ama-nucleotide nama-phospholipid. I-sulfur iyingxenye yesakhiwo sama-amino acid athile njenge-cysteine ne-methionine, futhi ikhona futhi kumavithamini amaningana nama-coenzyme. Ezinye izakhi ezibalulekile ze-macro yi-potassium (K), i-magnesium (Mg), i-calcium (Ca), kanye ne-sodium (Na). Nakuba lezi zakhi zidingeka ngamanani amancane, zibaluleke kakhulu ekwakhiweni nasekusebenzeni kweseli le-prokaryotic.

 Ama-Micronutrients
Ngaphezu kwalezi zakhi ze-macro, ama-prokaryotes adinga izakhi zensimbi ezahlukahlukene ngamanani amancane. Lezi zibizwa ngokuthi ama-micronutrients noma ama-trace elements. Isibonelo, insimbi iyadingeka ekusebenzeni kwama-cytochromes ahilelekile ekusabeleni kokuthutha kwama-electron. Amanye ama-prokaryotes adinga ezinye izakhi—njenge-boron (B), i-chromium (Cr), kanye ne-manganese (Mn)—ngokuyinhloko njengama-enzyme cofactors.

 Izindlela Ama-Prokaryotes Athola Ngazo Amandla
Ama-Prokaryotes angasebenzisa imithombo ehlukene yamandla ukuhlanganisa ama-macromolecule avela kuma-molecule amancane. Ama-phototroph (noma izinto eziphilayo ezi-phototrophic) athola amandla awo elangeni. Ama-chemotroph (noma izinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisa i-chemosynthetic) athola amandla awo kumakhemikhali amakhilogremu. Ama-chemotroph angasebenzisa i-organic com amakhilogremu njengemithombo yamandla abizwa ngokuthi ama-chemoorganotrophs. Lawo angasebenzisa i-inorganic com amakhilogremu njengemithombo yamandla abizwa ngokuthi ama-chemolithotrophs.

 Izindlela Ama-Prokaryot Athola Ngazo I-Carbon
 Ama-Prokaryot awagcini nje ngokusebenzisa imithombo ehlukene yamandla kodwa futhi nemithombo ehlukene ye-carbon com amakhilogremu. Khumbula ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ezikwazi ukulungisa i-inorganic carbon zibizwa ngokuthi ama-autotrophs. Ama-Autotrophic prokaryots akhiqiza ama-molecule e-organic kusuka ku-carbon dioxide. Ngokuphambene nalokho, ama-heterotrophic prokaryotes athola i-carbon kusuka ku-organic com amakhilogremu. Ukuze isithombe sibe nzima kakhulu, amagama achaza indlela ama-prokaryot athola ngayo amandla kanye ne-carbon angahlanganiswa. Ngakho-ke, ama-photoautotrophs asebenzisa amandla avela elangeni, kanye ne-carbon evela ku-carbon dioxide namanzi, kanti ama-chemoheterotrophs athola amandla kanye ne-carbon emthonjeni wamakhemikhali wezinto eziphilayo. Ama-chemolitoautotrophs athola amandla awo kusuka ku-com engaphili amakhilogremu, futhi akha ama-molecule awo ayinkimbinkimbi kusuka ku-carbon dioxide. Ithebula elingezansi (bheka ithebula elingezansi) lifingqa imithombo ye-carbon kanye namandla kuma-prokaryotes.

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.3 I-Prokaryotic Metabolism | Indima Yama-Prokaryotes Ezinhlelweni Zemvelo | Ama-Prokaryotes Nomjikelezo Wekhabhoni
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.3 Prokaryotic Metabolism | Role of Prokaryotes in Ecosystems | Prokaryotes and the Carbon Cycle
chapterContent:
Ama-Prokaryote atholakala yonke indawo: Akukho ndawo noma indawo lapho engekho khona. Ama-Prokaryote adlala indima eminingi ezindaweni ahlala kuzo. Izindima azidlalayo emijikelezweni yekhabhoni ne-nitrogen zibalulekile empilweni eMhlabeni.

 Ama-Prokaryote kanye noMjikelezo Wekhabhoni
Ikhabhoni ingenye yezakhamzimba ezibaluleke kakhulu, futhi ama-prokaryote adlala indima ebalulekile emjikelezweni wekhabhoni (Isithombe 22.18). Ikhabhoni ijikeleziswa ezindaweni zokugcina amanzi ezinkulu zoMhlaba: umhlaba, umkhathi, izindawo zasemanzini, inhlabathi namatshe, kanye ne-biomass. Ukuhamba kwekhabhoni kwenzeka nge-carbon dioxide, esuswa emkhathini yizitshalo zasemhlabathini nama-prokaryote asemanzini, futhi ibuyiselwa emkhathini ngokuphefumula kwezinto eziphilayo ze-chemoorganotrophic, okuhlanganisa ama-prokaryote, isikhunta, nezilwane. Nakuba indawo yokugcina ikhabhoni enkulu kunazo zonke ezindaweni zemvelo zomhlaba isemadwaleni nasezindaweni, leyo khabhoni ayitholakali kalula.

 Inani elikhulu lekhabhoni etholakalayo litholakala ezitshalweni zasemhlabathini. Izitshalo, ezingabakhiqizi, zisebenzisa i-carbon dioxide emoyeni ukuze zenze i-carbon com amakhilogremu. Ngokuphathelene nalokhu, umthombo owodwa obaluleke kakhulu we-carbon com amakhilogremu yi-humus, okuyingxube yezinto eziphilayo ezivela ezitshalweni ezifile nama-prokaryotes amelana nokubola. Abathengi njengezilwane basebenzisa i-organic com amakhilogremu ekhiqizwa abakhiqizi futhi bakhiphe i-carbon dioxide emoyeni. Ngemuva kwalokho, amabhaktheriya nesikhunta, ndawonye abizwa ngokuthi ama-decomsers, enza ukuqhekeka (ukubola) kwezitshalo nezilwane kanye ne-organic com yazo amakhilogremu. Umthelela obaluleke kakhulu we-carbon dioxide emoyeni ukubola kwezinto ezifile (izilwane ezifile, izitshalo, kanye ne-humus) eziphefumula.

 Ezindaweni ezinamanzi kanye ne-anoxic sediments yazo, kukhona omunye umjikelezo we-carbon owenzekayo. Kulokhu, umjikelezo usekelwe ku-one-carbon com amakhilogremu. Ezindaweni ze-anoxic sediments, ama-prokaryotes, ikakhulukazi ama-archaea, akhiqiza i-methane (CH4). Le methane ingena endaweni engaphezulu kwenhlabathi, ecebile nge-oxygen futhi isekela amabhaktheriya abizwa ngokuthi ama-methane oxidizers axuba i-methane ibe yi-carbon dioxide, bese ebuyela emkhathini.

chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.3 Prokaryotic Metabolism | Role of Prokaryotes in Ecosystems | Prokaryotes and the Nitrogen Cycle
chapterContent:
Ama-Prokaryote akhona yonke indawo: Akukho ndawo noma indawo lapho engekho khona. Ama-Prokaryote adlala indima eminingi ezindaweni ahlala kuzo. Izindima azidlalayo emijikelezweni yekhabhoni ne-nitrogen zibalulekile empilweni eMhlabeni.

 Ama-Prokaryote kanye noMjikelezo weNitrogen
I-nitrogen iyinto ebaluleke kakhulu empilweni ngoba iyingxenye yamaprotheni nama-nucleic acid. Ingumsoco omkhulu, futhi ngokwemvelo, iphinda isetshenziswe kusukela ku-organic com pounds iye ku-ammonia, ama-ion e-ammonium, i-nitrate, i-nitrite, kanye negesi ye-nitrogen ngezinqubo eziningi, eziningi zazo ezenziwa ama-prokaryote kuphela. Njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 22.19, ama-prokaryote ayisihluthulelo somjikelezo we-nitrogen. Ichibi elikhulu kunawo wonke le-nitrogen elitholakala endaweni yemvelo yomhlaba yi-gaseous nitrogen evela emoyeni, kodwa le nitrogen ayisetshenziswa izitshalo, ezingabakhiqizi abayinhloko. I-nitrogen yegesi iyaguqulwa, noma ilungiswe” ibe yizinhlobo ezitholakala kalula njenge-ammonia ngenqubo yokulungiswa kwe-nitrogen. I-Amonia ingasetshenziswa izitshalo noma iguqulwe ibe ezinye izinhlobo.

 Omunye umthombo we-ammonia yi-ammonification, inqubo lapho i-ammonia ikhishwa khona ngesikhathi sokubola kwe-com equkethe i-nitrogen amakhilogremu. I-Ammonia ekhishwa emoyeni, nokho, imele amaphesenti ayi-15 kuphela e-nitrogen iyonke ekhishwayo; okusele kufana ne-N2 ne-N2O. I-Ammonia iguqulwa ngendlela engadingi i-oxygen ngamanye ama-prokaryotes, okwenza i-N2 ibe umkhiqizo wokugcina. I-Nitrification ukuguqulwa kwe-ammonium ibe yi-nitrite ne-nitrate. I-Nitrification enhlabathini yenziwa ngamagciwane esizukulwane se-Nitrosomas, i-Nitrobacter, ne-Nitrospira. Amagciwane enza inqubo ephambene, ukunciphisa i-nitrate enhlabathini ibe yi-com engcolile amakhilogremu njenge-N2O, NO, ne-N2, inqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-denitrification

Nakuba amabhaktheriya amaningi ehlanganyela ebudlelwaneni obuhambisanayo nababungazi bawo, amanye akhona ebudlelwaneni bezinambuzane, okubangela izifo. Amabhaktheriya amaningi ashintshe ukumelana nama-antibiotic, futhi ososayensi bathuthukisa ama-antibiotic amasha asebenza kahle ekulweni nokutheleleka okubangelwa izifo ezivelelayo. Izibonelo zokutheleleka okubangelwa amabhaktheriya zifaka phakathi i-pneumonia, isifo sofuba, i-typhoid, kanye nesifo se-Lyme. Nakuba ezinye izifo seziqediwe, ukuvela kokutheleleka okusha, njenge-MRSA, kunikeza ubufakazi bokuthi ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kuyinqubo eqhubekayo. Ososayensi bezifo bafunda ukuthi isifo sithinta kanjani inani labantu.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 1 kanye no-Big Idea 3 wohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 1
Inqubo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo iqhuba ukuhlukahluka nobunye bokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 1.C

 Izifo ezibhubhisayo nezinhlupho ezithwalwa amagciwane, kokubili amagciwane kanye namagciwane ngokwemvelo, ziye zathinta abantu kusukela ekuqaleni komlando wesintu. Imbangela yangempela yalezi zifo yayingaqondwa ngaleso sikhathi, futhi abanye abantu babecabanga ukuthi izifo ziyisijeziso esingokomoya. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu baqaphela ukuthi ukuhlala kude nabantu abahluphekile, nokulahla izidumbu kanye nempahla yabo siqu yezisulu zokugula, kunciphisa amathuba abo okugula.

 Izazi zezifo ezibangelwa yizifo zihlola ukuthi izifo zithinta kanjani umphakathi. Ubhubhane yisifo esenzeka kubantu abaningi ngokungavamile emphakathini ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ubhubhane luwubhubhane olusakazeke kabanzi, ngokuvamile emhlabeni wonke. Isifo esivamile yisifo esihlala sikhona, ngokuvamile sisezingeni eliphansi, emphakathini.

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.4 Izifo Zamabhaktheriya Kubantu | Umlando Omude Wezifo Zamabhaktheriya | Ubhubhane Lwase-Athens | Izifo Zezimbungulu | Ukufuduka Kwezifo Kuya Emiphakathini Emisha
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.4 Bacterial Diseases in Humans | Long History of Bacterial Disease | The Plague of Athens | Bubonic Plagues | Migration of Diseases to New Populations
chapterContent:
Kunemibhalo egciniwe ngezifo ezithelelanayo kusukela ngo-3000 BC. Izifo eziningi eziwubhubhane ezibangelwa amagciwane ziye zabhalwa eminyakeni engamakhulu amaningana. Ezinye zezifo eziwubhubhane ezikhumbulekayo zaholela ekuncipheni kwamadolobha nezizwe.

 Ekhulwini lama-21, izifo ezithelelanayo zisalokhu ziphakathi kwezimbangela eziphambili zokufa emhlabeni wonke, naphezu kwentuthuko eyenziwe ocwaningweni lwezokwelapha kanye nokwelashwa emashumini eminyaka amuva nje. Isifo sisakazeka lapho igciwane elisibangelayo lidluliselwa kusuka komunye umuntu liye komunye. Ukuze igciwane libangele isifo, kumele likwazi ukuzala emzimbeni womninikhaya futhi lilimaze umninikhaya ngandlela thile.

 Isifo Sase-Athene
Ngo-430 BC, iSifo Sase-Athene sabulala ingxenye eyodwa kwezine yamasosha ase-Athene ayelwa eMpini enkulu yasePeloponnesian futhi senza buthaka ukubusa namandla ase-Athene. Lesi sifo sathinta abantu abahlala e-Athene egcwele abantu kanye namasosha ayesemikhunjini okwakudingeka abuyele e-Athene. Umthombo walesi sifo kungenzeka ukuthi utholakale muva nje lapho abacwaningi base-University of Athens bekwazi ukusebenzisa i-DNA emazinyweni atholwe ethuneni elikhulu. Ososayensi bathole ukulandelana kwe-nucleotide kusuka kubhaktheriya elibangela izifo, i-Salmonella enterica serovar Typhi (Isithombe 22.20), okubangela umkhuhlane we-typhoid.3 Lesi sifo sivame ukubonwa ezindaweni ezinabantu abaningi futhi sibangele ubhubhane emlandweni oqoshiwe.

 Izinhlupho ze-Bubonic
Kusukela ngo-541 kuya ku-750, ukuqubuka kwalokho okungenzeka ukuthi kwakuyisifo se-bubonic (i-Plague of Justinian), kwaqeda ingxenye eyodwa kwezine kuya kwengxenye yabantu esifundeni saseMpumalanga yeMedithera. Inani labantu eYurophu lehle ngamaphesenti angu-50 phakathi nalokhu kuqubuka. Isifo se-Bubonic sasizohlasela iYurophu izikhathi ezingaphezu kwesisodwa.

 Esinye sezifo ezibhubhisa kakhulu kwakuyi-Black Death (1346 kuya ku-1361) okukholakala ukuthi kwakungenye ukuqubuka kwesifo se-bubonic esabangelwa yibhaktheriya i-Yersinia pestis. Kucatshangwa ukuthi yaqala eShayina futhi yasakazeka eceleni kweSilk Road, inethiwekhi yemizila yokuhweba yasemhlabathini neyasolwandle, eya esifundeni saseMedithera naseYurophu, ithwalwa yizimpukane zamagundane ezihlala kumagundane amnyama ayehlala ekhona emikhunjini. I-Black Death yanciphisa inani labantu emhlabeni kusukela kubantu ababalelwa ezigidini ezingu-450 kuya kwabangaba ngu-350 kuya kwabangu-375 million. Isifo se-Bubonic sahlasela iLondon kakhulu futhi maphakathi nawo-1600 (Isithombe 22.21). Ezikhathini zanamuhla, amacala angaba ngu-1,000 kuya ku-3,000 esifo se-bacteria avela emhlabeni wonke minyaka yonke. Nakuba ukuthola isifo se-bubonic ngaphambi kwama-antibiotic kwakusho ukufa okuqinisekile, leli gciwane liyasabela ezinhlotsheni eziningana zama-antibiotic anamuhla, futhi amazinga okufa ngenxa yesifo se-bacteria manje aphansi kakhulu.

 Ukufuduka Kwezifo Kuya Emiphakathini Emisha
Emakhulwini eminyaka, abantu baseYurophu babevame ukuthuthukisa ukuzivikela kwezakhi zofuzo ezifweni ezithathelwanayo ezivamile, kodwa lapho abanqobi baseYurophu befika eNtshonalanga Nenkabazwe, baletha namabhaktheriya namagciwane abangela izifo, okwabangela ubhubhane olwabhubhisa ngokuphelele inani labantu baseMelika Bomdabu, ababengenawo amandla okumelana nezifo eziningi zaseYurophu. Kulinganiselwa ukuthi amaphesenti angama-90 abantu baseMelika Bomdabu bafa ngenxa yezifo ezithathelwanayo ngemva kokufika kwabaseYurophu, okwenza ukunqoba iZwe Elisha kwaba yisiphetho esibikezelwe kusengaphambili.
