chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.4 Izifo Zamabhaktheriya Kubantu | Izifo Ezivelayo Neziphinde Zivele
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.4 Bacterial Diseases in Humans | Emerging and Re-emerging Diseases
chapterContent:
Ukusabalala kwesifo esithile kuyashintshashintsha. Ngakho-ke, izinguquko endaweni ezungezile, igciwane, noma inani labantu elihlala khona zingathinta kakhulu ukusabalala kwesifo. Ngokusho kwe-World Health Organization (WHO) isifo esivelayo (Isithombe 22.22) yilesi esivele kubantu okokuqala, noma okungenzeka ukuthi sasikhona ngaphambilini kodwa sanda ngokushesha ngokwezinga lokwanda noma ngokwezindawo. Le ncazelo ihlanganisa nezifo eziphinda zivela ezazilawulwa ngaphambilini. Cishe amaphesenti angama-75 ezifo ezithathelwanayo ezisanda kuvela ezithinta abantu yizifo ze-zoonotic, i-zoonoses, izifo ezithinta kakhulu izilwane futhi zidluliselwa kubantu; ezinye zivela egciwaneni kanti ezinye zivela ebhaktheriya. I-Brucellosis iyisibonelo se-prokaryotic zoonosis ephinda ivela kwezinye izindawo, kanti i-necrotizing fasciitis (eyaziwa ngokuthi amabhaktheriya adla inyama) ibilokhu ikhula ngokuba yi-virulence eminyakeni engama-80 edlule ngezizathu ezingaziwa.

 Ezinye zezifo ezisanda kuvela manje azizintsha, kodwa ziyizifo ezaziyinhlekelele esikhathini esidlule (Isithombe 22.23). Zabhubhisa imiphakathi futhi zalala isikhashana, ukuze zibuye, ngezinye izikhathi zibe zimbi kakhulu kunangaphambili, njengoba kwakunjalo ngesifo sofuba. Ezinye izifo, njengesifo sofuba, azizange ziqedwe kodwa zazilawulwa kwezinye izindawo zomhlaba kwaze kwaba yilapho zibuya, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zasemadolobheni ezinezinga eliphezulu labantu abanesimiso sokuzivikela somzimba esibuthakathaka. I-WHO ithole izifo ezithile okufanele ziqashwe kabusha emhlabeni wonke. Phakathi kwalezi kukhona izifo ezimbili ezibangelwa amagciwane (umkhuhlane we-dengue kanye nomkhuhlane ophuzi), kanye nezifo ezintathu ezibangelwa amagciwane (i-diphtheria, ikholera, kanye nesifo sofuba). Impi yokulwa nezifo ezithelelanayo ayinaso isiphetho esibonakalayo.

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.4 Izifo Zamabhaktheriya Kubantu | Ama-Biofilms Nezifo
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.4 Bacterial Diseases in Humans | Biofilms and Disease
chapterContent:
Khumbula ukuthi ama-biofilms ayimiphakathi yama-microbial okunzima kakhulu ukuwabhubhisa. Anesibopho sezifo ezifana nokutheleleka ezigulini ezine-cystic fibrosis, isifo se-Legionnaires, kanye ne-otitis media. Akhiqiza i-dental plaque futhi ahlala ama-catheter, ama-prostheses, amadivayisi e-transcutaneous kanye nama-orthopedic, ama-contact lens, kanye namadivayisi angaphakathi njenge-pacemakers. Aphinde akheke emanxebeni avulekile nasezicutshini ezishisiwe. Ezindaweni zokunakekelwa kwempilo, ama-biofilms akhula emishinini ye-hemodialysis, kuma-ventilator omshini, kuma-shunt, nakweminye imishini yezokwelapha. Eqinisweni, amaphesenti angama-65 azo zonke izifo ezitholakala esibhedlela (ukutheleleka kwe-nosocomial) kuthiwa yi-biofilms. Ama-biofilms ahlobene nezifo ezitholakala ekudleni ngoba ahlala ezindaweni zamaqabunga emifino nenyama, kanye nemishini yokucubungula ukudla engahlanzwa ngokwanele.

 Ukutheleleka kwe-biofilm kukhula kancane kancane; ngezinye izikhathi, akubangeli izimpawu ngokushesha. Akuvamile ukuxazululwa ngezindlela zokuzivikela zomsingathi. Uma ukutheleleka nge-biofilm sekuvele, kunzima kakhulu ukukuqeda, ngoba ama-biofilm avame ukumelana nezindlela eziningi ezisetshenziswa ukulawula ukukhula kwamagciwane, okuhlanganisa nama-antibiotic. Ama-biofilm asabela kabi noma okwesikhashana kuphela kuma-antibiotic; kuye kwathiwa angamelana nokugcwala kwama-antibiotic okufika ku-1,000 okusetshenziselwa ukubulala amabhaktheriya afanayo uma ephila ngokukhululeka noma e-planktonic. Umthamo omkhulu kangako wama-antibiotic ungalimaza isiguli; ngakho-ke, ososayensi basebenza ngezindlela ezintsha zokususa ama-biofilm

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.4 Izifo Zamabhaktheriya Kubantu | Ama-antibiotic: Ingabe Sibhekene Nenkinga?
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.4 Bacterial Diseases in Humans | Antibiotics: Are We Facing a Crisis?
chapterContent:
Igama elithi antibiotic livela kwelesiGriki elithi anti against” kanye nelithi bios elisho ukuphila.” I-antibiotic iyikhemikhali, ekhiqizwa ngamagciwane noma ngokwenziwe, ephikisana nokukhula kwezinye izinto eziphilayo. Izindaba nabezindaba zanamuhla zivame ukubhekana nokukhathazeka ngenkinga yama-antibiotic. Ingabe ama-antibiotic ayelapha kalula izifo zamagciwane esikhathini esidlule ayaphelelwa yisikhathi? Ingabe kukhona ama-superbug amasha”—amabhaktheriya aguqukele ekubeni amelane kakhulu neqoqo lethu lama-antibiotic? Ingabe lokhu kungukuqala kokuphela kwama-antibiotic? Yonke le mibuzo iphonsela inselelo umphakathi wezempilo.

 Enye yezimbangela eziyinhloko zama-bacteria amelana nokusebenzisa kabi ama-antibiotic. Ukusetshenziswa okunganaki nokweqile kwama-antibiotic kuholele ekukhethweni kwemvelo kwezinhlobo zama-bacteria amelana. Ama-antibiotic abulala iningi lamabhaktheriya athelelanayo, ngakho-ke kusele izinhlobo ezimelana kuphela. Lezi zinhlobo ezimelana ziyazalana, okuholela ekwandeni kwenani lezinhlobo ezimelana namagciwane kunezingamelani namagciwane. Okunye ukusetshenziswa kabi okukhulu kwama-antibiotic kusezigulini ezinomkhuhlane noma umkhuhlane, lapho ama-antibiotic engasebenzi khona. Enye inkinga ukusetshenziswa ngokweqile kwama-antibiotic ezilwaneni. Ukusetshenziswa njalo kwama-antibiotic ekudleni kwezilwane kukhuthaza ukumelana namagciwane. E-United States, amaphesenti angama-70 ama-antibiotic akhiqizwayo anikezwa izilwane. Lawa ma-antibiotic anikezwa imfuyo ngemithamo ephansi, okwandisa amathuba okuba amelane akhule, futhi lawa ma-bacteria amelana nawo adluliselwa kalula kubantu.

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.4 Izifo Zamabhaktheriya Kubantu | Ama-antibiotic: Ingabe Sibhekene Nenkinga? | Enye Yezinambuzane Ezinkulu: I-MRSA
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.4 Bacterial Diseases in Humans | Antibiotics: Are We Facing a Crisis? | One of the Superbugs: MRSA
chapterContent:
Ukusetshenziswa ngokunganaki kwama-antibiotic kuye kwavula indlela yokuthi amabhaktheriya andise izinhlobo zezinhlobo ezimelana namagciwane. Isibonelo, i-Staphylococcus aureus, evame ukubizwa ngokuthi i-staph,” iyigciwane elivamile elingaphila emzimbeni womuntu futhi ngokuvamile liphathwa kalula ngama-antibiotic. Nokho, uhlobo oluyingozi kakhulu, i-Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) engamelana ne-methicillin lube sematheni eminyakeni embalwa edlule (Isithombe 22.24). Lolu hlobo lumelana nama-antibiotic amaningi asetshenziswa kakhulu, okuhlanganisa i-methicillin, i-amoxicillin, i-penicillin, ne-oxacillin. I-MRSA ingabangela ukutheleleka kwesikhumba, kodwa ingaphinde ithelele igazi, amaphaphu, umgudu womchamo, noma izindawo zokulimala. Ngenkathi ukutheleleka kwe-MRSA kuvamile kubantu abasezikhungweni zezempilo, kuye kwavela nakubantu abaphilile abangazange bangeniswe esibhedlela kodwa abahlala noma abasebenza ezindaweni ezinabantu abambalwa (njengabasebenzi bezempi neziboshwa). Abacwaningi baveze ukukhathazeka ngendlela lo mthombo wokugcina we-MRSA ohlose ngayo abantu abasebasha kakhulu kunalabo abahlala ezindaweni zokunakekelwa. I-Journal of the American Medical Association ibike ukuthi, phakathi kwabantu abahlushwa yi-MRSA ezindaweni zokunakekelwa kwempilo, isilinganiso seminyaka singu-68, kanti abantu abane-MRSA ehlobene nomphakathi (CA-MRSA) banesilinganiso uneminyaka engu-23.

 Ngamafuphi, umphakathi wezokwelapha ubhekene nenkinga yama-antibiotic. Abanye ososayensi bakholelwa ukuthi ngemva kweminyaka eminingi sivikelwe ekuthelelekeni ngamagciwane ngama-antibiotic, kungenzeka ukuthi sibuyela esikhathini lapho ukutheleleka okulula kwamagciwane kungaphinde kubhubhise abantu. Abacwaningi bathuthukisa ama-antibiotic amasha, kodwa kuthatha iminyaka eminingi ucwaningo kanye nezivivinyo zemitholampilo, kanye nokutshalwa kwezimali ezigidini zamaRandi, ukukhiqiza umuthi osebenzayo novunyelwe.

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.4 Izifo Zamabhaktheriya Kubantu | Izifo Ezitholakala Ekudleni
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.4 Bacterial Diseases in Humans | Foodborne Diseases
chapterContent:
Ama-Prokaryote akhona yonke indawo: Ahlala kalula kunoma yiluphi uhlobo lwezinto, futhi ukudla akuyona into ehlukile. Esikhathini esiningi, ama-prokaryote ahlala ukudla kanye nemishini yokucubungula ukudla ngendlela ye-biofilm. Ukuqubuka kokutheleleka ngamagciwane okuhlobene nokudla kuvamile. Isifo esitholakala ekudleni (esibizwa ngokuthi ubuthi bokudla) yisifo esibangelwa ukusetshenziswa kwamagciwane abangela izifo, amagciwane, noma ezinye izilokazane ezingcolisa ukudla. Nakuba i-United States inokudla okuphephile kakhulu emhlabeni, i-U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) ibike ukuthi abantu abayizigidi ezingu-76 bayagula, abangaphezu kuka-300,000 bangeniswa esibhedlela, kanti abantu baseMelika abangu-5,000 bayafa minyaka yonke ngenxa yokugula okubangelwa ukudla.”

 Izici zezifo ezitholakala ekudleni ziye zashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Esikhathini esidlule, kwakujwayelekile ukuzwa ngamacala angavamile e-botulism, isifo esingaba yingozi esikhiqizwa ubuthi obuvela kubhaktheriya we-anaerobic i-Clostridium botulinum. Eminye yemithombo evame kakhulu yaleli gciwane kwakuwukudla okusemathinini okungena-asidi, ama-pickle enziwe ekhaya, kanye nenyama ecutshunguliwe kanye namasoseji. Ithini, imbiza, noma iphakethe lakha indawo efanelekile yokungabi na-aerobic lapho i-Clostridium ingakhula khona. Izinqubo ezifanele zokubulala inzalo kanye nokufaka emathinini ziye zanciphisa ukwanda kwalesi sifo.

 Ngenkathi abantu bengase bathambekele ekucabangeni ngezifo ezitholakala ekudleni njengezihlotshaniswa nokudla okusekelwe ezilwaneni, amacala amaningi manje ahlotshaniswa nokukhiqiza. Kube nokuqubuka okukhulu, okuhlobene nomkhiqizo okuhlotshaniswa nesipinashi esingaphekiwe e-United States kanye namahlumela emifino eJalimane, futhi lezi zinhlobo zokuqubuka sezivame kakhulu. Ukuqubuka kwesipinashi esingaphekiwe ngo-2006 kwakhiqizwa yi-bacterium E. coli serotype O157:H7. I-serotype uhlobo lwamagciwane oluphethe isethi yama-antigen afanayo ebusweni bawo, futhi ngokuvamile kunezinhlobo eziningi ezahlukene zama-serotypes zohlobo lwebhaktheriya. Iningi le-E. coli aliyona ingozi kakhulu kubantu, kodwa i-serotype O157:H7 ingabangela uhudo olunegazi futhi ingaba yingozi.

 Zonke izinhlobo zokudla zingangcoliswa amagciwane. Ukuqubuka kwamuva kwe-Salmonella okubikwe yi-CDC kwenzeke ekudleni okuhlukahlukene njengebhotela lamantongomane, amahlumela e-alfalfa, namaqanda. Ukuqubuka okubulalayo eJalimane ngo-2010 kwabangelwa ukungcoliswa kwe-E. coli kwamahlumela emifino (Isithombe 22.25). Uhlobo olubangele ukuqubuka kwatholakala ukuthi luyi-serotype entsha eyayingakaze ihileleke kwezinye iziqhumane, okubonisa ukuthi i-E. coli iyaqhubeka nokuguquka.

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.4 Izifo Zamabhaktheriya Kubantu | Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi | Isazi Sezifo Ezibangelwa Yizifo
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.4 Bacterial Diseases in Humans | Career Connection | Epidemiologist
chapterContent:
I-Epidemiology iwucwaningo lokuvela, ukusabalala, kanye nezici zempilo kanye nezifo kubantu. Ngakho-ke, iyingxenye yempilo yomphakathi. Isazi sezifo sihlola ukuvama kanye nokusabalala kwezifo kubantu nasezindaweni ezizungezile.

 Isazi sezifo siqoqa idatha mayelana nesifo esithile futhi silandelele ukusabalala kwaso ukuze sithole indlela yokuqala yokudlulisela. Ngezinye izikhathi basebenza ngokubambisana eduze nezazi-mlando ukuze bazame ukuqonda indlela isifo esiguquke ngayo ngokwendawo nangokuhamba kwesikhathi, belandelela umlando wemvelo wezifo ezibangelwa amagciwane. Baqoqa ulwazi oluvela kumarekhodi emitholampilo, izingxoxo zeziguli, ukubhekwa, nanoma yiziphi ezinye izindlela ezitholakalayo. Lolo lwazi lusetshenziselwa ukuthuthukisa amasu, njengokugoma (Isithombe 22.26), futhi baklame izinqubomgomo zezempilo zomphakathi ukuze banciphise ukwanda kwesifo noma ukuvimbela ukusabalala kwaso. Isazi sezifo senza nophenyo olusheshayo uma kwenzeka ukuqubuka ukuze sincome izinyathelo ezisheshayo zokusilawula.

 Isazi sezifo sineziqu ze-bachelor, kanye neziqu ze-master kwezempilo yomphakathi (MPH). Odokotela abaningi bezifo bangodokotela (futhi bane-M.D.), noma bane-Ph.D. emkhakheni ohlobene, njenge-biology noma i-microbiology

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.5 Ama-Prokaryotes Anenzuzo | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.5 Beneficial Prokaryotes | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ngokuvamile sicabanga ngamagciwane uma sicabanga ngama-prokaryotes, sigxile ebudlelwaneni bawo nesifo. Kodwa-ke, ama-prokaryotes amaningi awabangeli izifo futhi adlala indima ehlukahlukene kwezinye izindawo zemvelo. I-nitrogen edingekayo ukuhlanganisa amaprotheni nama-nucleic acid ngokuvamile iyisici esivimbela kakhulu ezintweni eziphilayo futhi amabhaktheriya akwazi ukulungisa i-nitrogen ibe yizinhlobo ezingasetshenziswa yi-eukaryotes. Ama-microbes nawo asetshenziselwa ukususa ukungcola ezindaweni, inqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-bioremediation. Ama-microbes asibiza ngokuthi asekhaya ayadingeka ukuze siphile. Asiza ekugayeni ukudla kwethu, akhiqize izakhamzimba ezibalulekile, asivikele kuma-microbes abangela izifo, futhi asisize ekuqeqesheni amasosha omzimba ethu ukuthi asebenze kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngaphandle kwama-prokaryotes besingeke sibe noshizi, isinkwa, iwayini, ubhiya, ne-yogurt.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo echazwe ku-Big Idea 4 yoHlaka Lwezifundo Ze-AP® Biology. Izinhloso Zokufunda ze-AP® ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo neyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 I-Big Idea 4
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana, futhi lezi zinhlelo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo ziyinkimbinkimbi Izakhiwo.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 4.B
Ukuncintisana nokubambisana kuyizinto ezibalulekile zezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
1.4 Umfundi angasebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya izimo noma ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokwekhwalithi nangobuningi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
4.18 Umfundi uyakwazi ukusebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuhlaziya ukuthi ukusebenzisana ngokubambisana phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo kukhuthaza kanjani ukusebenza kahle ekusetshenzisweni kwamandla nezinto.

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yokuzijwayeza Kwesayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlolwa yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:
[APLO 2.6][APLO 2.28][APLO 2.42][APLO 4.9][APLO 4.1]

 Akuwona wonke ama-prokaryote abangela izifo. Ngokuphambene nalokho, amagciwane amelela iphesenti elincane kakhulu lokwehlukahlukana komhlaba wamagciwane. Eqinisweni, impilo yethu ibingeke ibe khona ngaphandle kwama-prokaryote. Cabanga nje ngendima yama-prokaryote emijikelezweni ye-biogeochemical

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.5 Ama-Prokaryotes Anenzuzo | Ukubambisana Phakathi Kwama-Baktheriya Nama-Eukaryotes: Ukufakwa Kwe-Nitrogen
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.5 Beneficial Prokaryotes | Cooperation between Bacteria and Eukaryotes: Nitrogen Fixation
chapterContent:
I-nitrogen iyinto ebaluleke kakhulu ezintweni eziphilayo, ngoba iyingxenye yama-nucleotide nama-amino acid ayizakhi zokwakha ama-nucleic acid namaprotheni, ngokulandelana. I-nitrogen ivame ukuba yinto evimbela kakhulu ezindaweni zemvelo zomhlaba, ene-nitrogen yomoya, i-N2, enikeza ichibi elikhulu kunawo wonke le-nitrogen etholakalayo. Kodwa-ke, ama-eukaryote awakwazi ukusebenzisa i-nitrogen yomoya, enomoya ukuze akhiqize ama-macromolecule. Ngenhlanhla, i-nitrogen ingalungiswa,” okusho ukuthi iguqulwa ibe yi-ammonia (NH3) kungaba ngokwezinto eziphilayo noma ngokwezinto eziphilayo. Ukulungiswa kwe-nitrogen okwezinto eziphilayo kwenzeka ngenxa yombani noma ngezinqubo zezimboni.

 Ukulungiswa kwe-nitrogen okwezinto eziphilayo (BNF) kwenziwa kuphela ngama-prokaryotes: amabhaktheriya enhlabathi, ama-cyanobacteria, kanye ne-Frankia spp. (amabhaktheriya ane-filamentous asebenzisana nezitshalo ze-actinorhizal ezifana ne-alder, i-bayberry, kanye ne-sweet fern). Ngemuva kwe-photosynthesis, i-BNF iyinqubo yesibili ebaluleke kakhulu yezinto eziphilayo eMhlabeni. Isibalo esimele inqubo simi kanje

 N2⁢ + 16ATP + 8e−⁢ + 8H+⁢ → 2NH3⁢ + 16ADP + 16Pi + H2
lapho i-Pi imele i-phosphate engaphili. I-nitrogen ephelele eqondile nge-BNF ingamathani ayizigidi eziyi-100 kuya kweziyi-180 ngonyaka. Izinqubo zezinto eziphilayo zinikela ngamaphesenti angama-65 e-nitrogen esetshenziswa kwezolimo.

 Ama-Cyanobacteria ayizibambi ze-nitrogen ezibaluleke kakhulu ezindaweni zasemanzini. Enhlabathini, amalungu ohlobo lwe-Clostridium ayizibonelo zama-bacteria aphila ngokukhululeka, alungisa i-nitrogen. Amanye ama-bacteria aphila ngokuhlanganyela nezitshalo ze-legume, okuhlinzeka ngomthombo obaluleke kakhulu we-BNF. Ama-Symbionts angase alungise i-nitrogen eningi enhlabathini kunezinto eziphilayo ezikhululekile ngesilinganiso esingu-10. Ama-bacteria omhlabathi, abizwa ngokuthi ama-rhizobia, ayakwazi ukusebenzisana ngokuhlanganyela nezitshalo ukuze akhe ama-nodule, izakhiwo ezikhethekile lapho kwenzeka khona ukufakwa kwe-nitrogen (Isithombe 22.27). I-nitrogenase, i-enzyme elungisa i-nitrogen, ayisebenzi yi-oxygen, ngakho-ke i-nodule inikeza indawo engena-oxygen ukuze ukufakwa kwe-nitrogen kwenzeke. Le nqubo inikeza umanyolo wezitshalo wemvelo futhi ongabizi, njengoba wehlisa i-nitrogen yomoya ibe yi-ammonia, esetshenziswa kalula yizitshalo. Ukusetshenziswa kwezitshalo kuyindlela enhle kakhulu yokufaka umanyolo wamakhemikhali futhi kunesithakazelo esikhethekile kwezolimo ezisimeme, ezifuna ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamakhemikhali nokulondoloza izinsiza zemvelo. Ngokufakwa kwe-nitrogen nge-symbiotic, isitshalo sizuza ngokusebenzisa okungapheli umthombo we-nitrogen: umkhathi. Amabhaktheriya ayazuza ngokusebenzisa i-photosynthates (ama-carbohydrate akhiqizwa ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis) esitshalweni futhi abe nendawo evikelwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, inhlabathi iyazuza ngokuvundiswa ngokwemvelo. Ngakho-ke, ukusetshenziswa kwe-rhizobia njengomanyolo we-bio kuyindlela eqhubekayo.

 Kungani ama-legumes ebaluleke kangaka? Amanye, njenge-soybean, ayimithombo ebalulekile yamaprotheni ezolimo. Amanye ama-legumes okusanhlamvu abaluleke kakhulu yi-soybean, amakinati, uphizi, uphizi, nobhontshisi. Amanye ama-legumes, njenge-alfalfa, asetshenziselwa ukondla izinkomo

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.5 Ama-Prokaryotes Anenzuzo | I-Biotechnology Yasekuqaleni: Ushizi, Isinkwa, kanye neYogurt
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.5 Beneficial Prokaryotes | Early Biotechnology: Cheese, Bread, and Yogurt
chapterContent:
Ngokusho kweSivumelwano Sezizwe Ezihlangene Sokuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo, i-biotechnology yinoma yiluphi uhlelo lobuchwepheshe olusebenzisa izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo, izinto eziphilayo, noma izinto ezivela kuzo, ukwenza noma ukuguqula imikhiqizo noma izinqubo zokusetshenziswa okuthile.5 Umqondo wokusetshenziswa okuthile” uhilela uhlobo oluthile lokusetshenziswa kwezentengiselwano. Ubunjiniyela bezakhi zofuzo, ukukhethwa kokwenziwa, ukukhiqizwa kwama-antibiotic, kanye namasiko amaseli yizihloko zamanje zokufunda ku-biotechnology. Kodwa-ke, abantu basebenzise ama-prokaryotes ngaphambi kokuba igama elithi i-biotechnology liqanjwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezinye zezimpahla nezinsizakalo zilula njengoshizi, isinkwa, ne-yogurt, ezisebenzisa amabhaktheriya kanye nezinye izinto ezincane, njengemvubelo, isikhunta.

 Ukukhiqizwa koshizi kwaqala cishe eminyakeni engu-4,000–7,000 eyedlule lapho abantu beqala ukuzala izilwane nokucubungula ubisi lwazo. Ukubilisa kulokhu kulondoloza izakhamzimba: Ubisi luzobola ngokushesha, kodwa uma lucutshungulwa njengoshizi, luzinzile kakhulu Ubufakazi busikisela ukuthi imikhiqizo yobisi ekhuliswe, njenge-yogurt, isibe khona okungenani iminyaka engu-4,000.

distractor1b: Inqubo yokuhlukanisa izinto eziphilayo zibe yizizinda

chapterName: 5. Ukuhlukahluka Kwezinto Eziphilayo | 22. Ama-Prokaryotes: Amabhaktheriya Nama-Archaeae | 22.5 Ama-Prokaryotes Anenzuzo | Ukusebenzisa Ama-Prokaryotes Ukuhlanza Iplanethi Yethu: Ukulungiswa Kwezinto Eziphilayo
chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.5 Beneficial Prokaryotes | Using Prokaryotes to Clean up Our Planet: Bioremediation
chapterContent:
Ukulungiswa kabusha kwe-microbial ukusetshenziswa kwama-prokaryotes (noma i-metabolism ye-microbial) ukususa ukungcola. Ukulungiswa kabusha kwe-bio kuye kwasetshenziswa ukususa amakhemikhali ezolimo (izibulala-zinambuzane, umanyolo) aphuma enhlabathini aye emanzini angaphansi komhlaba kanye nangaphansi komhlaba. Izinsimbi ezithile ezinobuthi nama-oxide, njenge-selenium kanye ne-arsenic com amakhilogremu, nazo zingasuswa emanzini ngokulungiswa kabusha kwe-bio. Ukunciphisa i-SeO4-2 ibe yi-SeO3-2 kanye ne-Se0 (i-selenium yensimbi) kuyindlela esetshenziswa ukususa ama-ion e-selenium emanzini. I-Mercury iyisibonelo sensimbi enobuthi engasuswa endaweni ngokulungiswa kabusha kwe-bio. Njengesithako esisebenzayo sezinye izibulala-zinambuzane, i-mercury isetshenziswa embonini futhi futhi ingumkhiqizo wezinqubo ezithile, njengokukhiqizwa kwebhethri. I-Methyl mercury ivame ukuba khona ngamanani aphansi kakhulu ezindaweni zemvelo, kodwa inobuthi kakhulu ngoba iqoqana ezicutshini eziphilayo. Izinhlobo eziningana zamabhaktheriya zingenza ukuguqulwa kwe-bio ye-mercury enobuthi ibe yizinhlobo ezingezona ubuthi. Lawa mabhaktheriya, njenge-Pseudomonas aeruginosa, angaguqula i-Hg+2 ibe yi-Hg0, engeyona ubuthi kubantu.

 Esinye sezibonelo eziwusizo kakhulu nezithakazelisayo zokusetshenziswa kwama-prokaryotes ngezinjongo zokulungisa izinto eziphilayo ukuhlanzwa kokuchitheka kukawoyela. Ukubaluleka kwama-prokaryotes ekuvuseleleni izinto eziphilayo nge-petroleum kuye kwabonakala ekuchithekeni kukawoyela okuningana eminyakeni yamuva nje, njengokuchitheka kuka-Exxon Valdez e-Alaska (1989) (Isithombe 22.28), ukuchitheka kukawoyela e-Prestige eSpain (2002), ukuchitheka eMedithera kusuka esiteshini sikagesi saseLebanon (2006), kanye muva nje, ukuchitheka kukawoyela e-Deepwater Horizon eGulf of Mexico (2010). Ukuze kuhlanzwe lokhu kuchitheka, ukulungiswa kwezinto eziphilayo kukhuthazwa ngokungezwa kwezakhamzimba ezingaphili ezisiza amagciwane ukuba akhule. Amagciwane abhubhisa i-hydrocarbon adla ama-hydrocarbon econsi likawoyela, aphula ama-hydrocarbon. Ezinye izinhlobo, njenge-Alcanivorax borkumensis, zikhiqiza ama-surfactant ancibilikisa uwoyela, kanti amanye amabhaktheriya ancibilikisa uwoyela abe yi-carbon dioxide. Uma kwenzeka ukuchitheka kukawoyela olwandle, ukuvuselelwa kwemvelo okuqhubekayo kuvame ukwenzeka, njengoba kukhona amabhaktheriya adla uwoyela olwandle ngaphambi kokuchitheka. Ngaphezu kwamabhaktheriya ancibilikisa uwoyela ngokwemvelo, abantu bakhetha futhi baklame amabhaktheriya anekhono elifanayo elinamandla akhulayo kanye ne-spectrum ye-hydrocarbon com amakhilogremu angacutshungulwa. Ngaphansi kwezimo ezinhle, kubikwe ukuthi amaphesenti angama-80 ezingxenye ezingashintshi ku-oyela angonakaliswa kungakapheli unyaka owodwa wokuchitheka. Ezinye izingxenyana zamafutha eziqukethe izintambo ze-hydrocarbon ezinuka kamnandi nezinamagatsha amaningi kunzima ukuzisusa futhi zihlala endaweni ezungezile isikhathi eside.

 Isibonelo esithakazelisayo kakhulu sezitshalo zethu ezivamile sihlobene nezinhlelo zethu zokugaya ukudla. Abantu abathatha imithamo ephezulu yama-antibiotic bavame ukulahlekelwa amabhaktheriya amaningi ajwayelekile amathumbu, okuvumela uhlobo olumelana nama-antibiotic ngokwemvelo olubizwa ngokuthi i-Clostridium difficile ukuba lukhule kakhulu futhi lubangele izinkinga ezinkulu zesisu, ikakhulukazi isifo sohudo esingamahlalakhona. Ngokusobala, ukuzama ukwelapha le nkinga ngama-antibiotic kuyenza ibe yimbi kakhulu. Kodwa-ke, iye yelashwa ngempumelelo ngokunikeza iziguli ukufakelwa indle kusuka kubanikeli abanempilo ukuze kubuyiselwe umphakathi ojwayelekile wamagciwane amathumbu. Ososayensi bathola nokuthi ukungabikho kwamagciwane athile abalulekile emgudwini wethu wamathumbu kungasibeka ezinkingeni ezahlukahlukene okuhlanganisa ukukhuluphala, ukumelana ne-insulin, kanye nezinkinga zokuzivikela komzimba. Lapha kuboniswe i-electron micrograph yokuskena ye-Clostridium difficile, igciwane eliyi-Gram-positive, elinomumo wenduku elibangela isifo sohudo esibi. Ukutheleleka kuvame ukwenzeka ngemva kokuba izilwane ezivamile zamathumbu ziqedwe ngama-antibiotic.
question1: Kuyini ukuvuselelwa kwe-microbial?
answer1: Ukusetshenziswa kwama-prokaryotes noma i-metabolism yamagciwane ukususa ukungcola
question2: Yikuphi ukungcola okungasuswa emanzini ngokusebenzisa i-bioremediation?
answer2: Izinsimbi ezinobuthi nama-oxide afana ne-selenium ne-arsenic com amakhilogremu
question3: Amabhaktheriya athile ayikhipha kanjani i-mercury ebuthi?
answer3: Baguqula i-Hg2+ enobuthi ibe yi-Hg0 engenabo ubuthi
question4: Yiliphi igciwane okukhulunywa ngalo elikwazi ukuguqula i-mercury enobuthi ibe uhlobo olungenabo ubuthi?

answer5: Ngokufaka izakhamzimba ezingaphili ezikhuthaza ukukhula kwamagciwane abhubhisa ama-hydrocarbon
question6: Uyini umsebenzi we-Alcanivorax borkumensis ngesikhathi sokulungiswa kwe-bioremediation yokuchitheka kwamafutha?
answer6: Ikhiqiza ama-surfactant ancibilikisa uwoyela
question7: Kungani ukuvuselelwa kwemvelo kwenzeka ngemva kokuchitheka kukawoyela olwandle?
answer7: Ngoba amabhaktheriya adla uwoyela asevele ekhona olwandle
distractor7a: Ngoba amanzi olwandle ancibilikisa uwoyela ngokwemvelo
distractor7c: Ngoba ukukhanya kwelanga kubhubhisa ama-hydrocarbon ngokushesha
question8: Kungani iClostridium difficile ingakhula kakhulu ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla?
answer8: Ama-antibiotic amaningi aqeda amabhaktheriya amaningi ajwayelekile esiswini
distractor8a: Ukudla ushukela omningi kakhulu kubangela ukuthi uphindaphindeke
distractor8c: Ayikwazi ukusinda ngaphandle kokuthi kuthathwe ama-probiotic
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 22.29. Yikuphi ukwelashwa okungatholakala kubantu abane-C. difficile eningi kakhulu ohlelweni lwabo lokugaya ukudla?
distractor9c: Ngokuthatha izithasiselo ze-probiotic ukuze kubuyiselwe umphakathi wamathumbu we-microbial

chapterNameEnglish: 5. Biological Diversity | 22. Prokaryotes: Bacteria and Archaeae | 22.7 Chapter Summary
chapterContent:
22.1 Ukuhlukahluka kwe-Prokaryotic
Ama-Prokaryotes ayekhona izigidigidi zeminyaka ngaphambi kokuba kuvele izitshalo nezilwane. Imithombo eshisayo kanye nemigodi yamanzi kungenzeka ukuthi kwakuyizindawo lapho impilo yaqala khona. Ama-microbial mat kucatshangwa ukuthi amelela izinhlobo zokuqala zokuphila eMhlabeni, futhi kukhona ubufakazi bezinsalela zokuba khona kwawo eminyakeni engaba yizigidigidi ezingu-3.5 eyedlule. Umata we-microbial uyishidi lama-prokaryotes elinezingqimba eziningi elikhula lapho kuhlangana khona izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinto, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezimanzi. Phakathi neminyaka eyizigidigidi ezimbili zokuqala, umkhathi wawungenawo umoya futhi yizinto eziphilayo ezingaphili kahle kuphela ezazikwazi ukuphila. Ama-Cyanobacteria aqala kuma-phototrophs okuqala futhi aqala ukungenisa umoya-mpilo emkhathi. Ukwanda kokuhlushwa komoya-mpilo kwavumela ukuvela kwezinye izinhlobo zokuphila. Ama-microbial mat afakwe ezinsaleleni abizwa ngokuthi ama-stromatolites futhi aqukethe izakhiwo ze-organo-sedimentary ezifakwe elaminated ezakhiwe yimvula yamaminerali ngama-prokaryotes. Amelela irekhodi lokuqala lokuphila eMhlabeni.

 Ama-bacteria nama-archaea akhula cishe kuyo yonke indawo. Labo abasinda ngaphansi kwezimo ezimbi kakhulu babizwa ngokuthi ama-extremophile (abathandi ababi kakhulu). Amanye ama-prokaryote awakwazi ukukhula endaweni yelabhorethri, kodwa awafile. Asesimweni esisebenzayo kodwa esingakhuli kahle (i-VBNC). Isimo se-VBNC senzeka lapho ama-prokaryote engena esimweni sokulala ngenxa yezingcindezi zemvelo. Ama-prokaryote amaningi angabantu bomphakathi futhi akhetha ukuhlala emiphakathini lapho kwenzeka khona ukusebenzisana. I-biofilm umphakathi wamagciwane ohlangene ndawonye ku-matrix ene-gummy-textured.

 22.2 Isakhiwo sama-Prokaryote
Ama-Prokaryote (izizinda i-Archaea nama-Bacteria) ayizinto eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa ezingenayo i-nucleus. Zinengxenye eyodwa ye-DNA eyindilinga endaweni ye-nucleoid yeseli. Ama-prokaryote amaningi anodonga lweseli olungaphandle komngcele we-plasma membrane. Amanye ama-prokaryote angaba nezakhiwo ezengeziwe njenge-capsule, i-flagella, ne-pili. Ama-bacteria nama-Archaea ahlukile ekwakhekeni kwama-lipid e-membrane yawo yeseli kanye nezici zodonga lweseli. Kuma-membrane e-archaeal, amayunithi e-phytanyl, esikhundleni sama-fatty acid, axhunyaniswe ne-glycerol. Amanye ama-membrane e-archaeal angama-lipid monolayer esikhundleni sama-bilayers.

 Udonga lweseli lutholakala ngaphandle kwe-membrane yeseli futhi luvimbela i-osmotic lysis. Ukwakheka kwamakhemikhali kwezindonga zeseli kuyahlukahluka phakathi kwezinhlobo. Izindonga zeseli lebhaktheriya ziqukethe i-peptidoglycan. Izindonga zeseli le-Archaean azinayo i-peptidoglycan, kodwa zingase zibe ne-pseudopeptidoglycan, ama-polysaccharides, ama-glycoprotein, noma izindonga zeseli ezisekelwe kumaprotheni. Amabhaktheriya angahlukaniswa ngamaqembu amabili amakhulu: i-Gram positive kanye ne-Gram negative, ngokusekelwe ekusabeleni kwe-Gram stain. Izinto eziphilayo ze-Gram-positive zinodonga lweseli olujiyile, kanye nama-teichoic acid. Izinto eziphilayo ze-Gram-negative zinodonga lweseli oluncane kanye nemvilophu yangaphandle equkethe ama-lipopolysaccharides nama-lipoprotein.

 22.3 I-Prokaryotic Metabolism
Ama-Prokaryotes yizinto eziphilayo ezihluke kakhulu ngokwe-metabolic; Zichuma ezindaweni eziningi ezahlukene ngamandla e-carbon kanye nemithombo ye-carbon ehlukahlukene, izinga lokushisa eliguquguqukayo, i-pH, ingcindezi, kanye nokutholakala kwamanzi. Izakhamzimba ezidingekayo ngobuningi zibizwa ngokuthi ama-macronutrients, kanti lezo ezidingekayo ngobuningi bokulandelela zibizwa ngokuthi ama-micronutrients noma ama-trace elements. Ama-macronutrients afaka phakathi i-C, H, O, N, P, S, K, Mg, Ca, kanye ne-Na. Ngaphezu kwalezi macronutrients, ama-prokaryotes adinga izakhi zensimbi ezahlukahlukene ukuze akhule futhi asebenze ngama-enzyme. Ama-prokaryotes asebenzisa imithombo ehlukene yamandla ukuhlanganisa ama-macromolecule avela kuma-molecule amancane. Ama-phototrophs athola amandla awo elangeni, kanti ama-chemotrophs athola amandla avela kumakhemikhali amakhilogremu .

 Ama-prokaryotes adlala indima emijikelezweni yekhabhoni ne-nitrogen. Ikhabhoni ibuyiselwa emkhathini ngokuphefumula kwezilwane nezinye izinto eziphilayo ze-chemoorganotrophic. Abathengi basebenzisa i-organic com amakhilogremu ekhiqizwa abakhiqizi futhi bakhiphe i-carbon dioxide emkhathini. Umthelela obaluleke kakhulu we-carbon dioxide emkhathini ukubola kwezinto ezifile. I-nitrogen iphinda isetshenziswe ngokwemvelo kusukela ku-organic com amakhilogremu iye ku-ammonia, ama-ion e-ammonium, i-nitrite, i-nitrate, kanye negesi ye-nitrogen. I-nitrogen yegesi iguqulwa ibe yi-ammonia ngokuqiniswa kwe-nitrogen. I-Amoniya iguqulwa ngendlela engenawo umoya ngamanye ama-prokaryotes, okunikeza i-N2 njengomkhiqizo wokugcina. I-Nitrification ukuguqulwa kwe-ammonium ibe yi-nitrite. I-Nitrification enhlabathini yenziwa ngamagciwane. I-Denitrification yenziwa nangamagciwane futhi iguqula i-nitrate kusuka enhlabathini ibe yi-gaseous nitrogen com amakhilogremu, njenge-N2O, NO, kanye ne-N2.

 22.4 Izifo Zamagciwane Kubantu
Izifo ezibhubhisayo kanye nezinhlupho bezilokhu ziphakathi kwethu kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo. Kunemibhalo mayelana nezifo zamagciwane kusukela ngo-3000 BC. Izifo ezithathelwanayo zisalokhu ziphakathi kwezimbangela eziphambili zokufa emhlabeni jikelele. Izifo ezikhulayo yilezo ezanda ngokushesha ngokwehla noma ngokwezindawo. Zingaba izifo ezintsha noma eziphinde zivele (ezake zalawulwa ngaphambili). Izifo eziningi ezivelayo ezithinta abantu, njenge-brucellosis, ziyi-zoonoses. I-WHO ithole iqembu lezifo okufanele ziqashwe kabusha: Lezo ezibangelwa amagciwane zifaka phakathi isifo se-bubonic, i-diphtheria, kanye ne-cholera.

 Ama-biofilms abhekwa njengembangela yezifo ezifana nokutheleleka kwamagciwane ezigulini ezine-cystic fibrosis, isifo se-Legionnaires, kanye ne-otitis media. Akhiqiza i-plaque yamazinyo; ahlala ama-catheter, ama-prostheses, amadivayisi e-transcutaneous, kanye nawamathambo; futhi athelele amalensi okuxhumana, amanxeba avulekile, kanye nezicubu ezishisiwe. Ama-biofilms akhiqiza nezifo ezitholakala ekudleni ngoba ahlala ezindaweni zokudla nemishini yokucubungula ukudla. Ama-biofilms amelana nezindlela eziningi ezisetshenziswa ukulawula ukukhula kwamagciwane. Ukusetshenziswa ngokweqile kwama-antibiotic kuholele enkingeni enkulu yomhlaba wonke, njengoba izinhlobo zamagciwane ezimelana nawo ziye zakhethwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Uhlobo oluyingozi kakhulu, i-Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) engamelana ne-methicillin, luye lwabangela umonakalo muva nje. Izifo ezitholakala ekudleni zivela ekusetshenzisweni kokudla okungcolile, amagciwane abangela izifo, amagciwane, noma ama-parasite angcolisa ukudla.

 22.5 Ama-Prokaryotes Anenzuzo
Ama-pathogen ayiphesenti elincane kakhulu lawo wonke ama-prokaryotes. Eqinisweni, impilo yethu ibingeke ibe khona ngaphandle kwama-prokaryotes. I-nitrogen ngokuvamile iyisici esivimbela kakhulu ezintweni eziphilayo zomhlaba; i-nitrogen esemkhathini, ichibi elikhulu kunawo wonke le-nitrogen etholakalayo, ayitholakali kuma-eukaryotes. I-nitrogen ingalungiswa,” noma iguqulwe ibe yi-ammonia (NH3) kungaba ngokwebhayoloji noma ngokwe-abiotic. Ukulungiswa kwe-nitrogen yezinto eziphilayo (BNF) kwenziwa kuphela ngama-prokaryotes. Ngemuva kwe-photosynthesis, i-BNF iyinqubo yesibili ebaluleke kakhulu yezinto eziphilayo eMhlabeni. Umthombo obaluleke kakhulu we-BNF ukusebenzisana kwe-symbiotic phakathi kwamagciwane enhlabathi nezitshalo ze-legume.

 Ukulungiswa kwe-microbial bioremediation ukusetshenziswa kwe-metabolism yamagciwane ukususa ukungcola. Ukulungiswa kwe-bioremediation kusetshenziswe ukususa amakhemikhali ezolimo aphuma enhlabathini aye emanzini angaphansi komhlaba kanye nangaphansi komhlaba. Izinsimbi ezinobuthi nama-oxide, njenge-selenium ne-arsenic com amakhilogremu, nazo zingasuswa ngokulungiswa kwe-bioremediation. Mhlawumbe esinye sezibonelo eziwusizo kakhulu nezithakazelisayo zokusetshenziswa kwama-prokaryotes ngezinjongo zokulungiswa kwe-bioremediation ukuhlanzwa kokuchitheka kukawoyela.

 Ukuphila komuntu kungenzeka kuphela ngenxa yesenzo samagciwane, kokubili lawo asemvelweni kanye nalezo zinhlobo ezisibiza ngekhaya. Ngaphakathi, asisiza ekugayeni ukudla kwethu, akhiqize izakhamzimba ezibalulekile kithi, asivikele kusuka kumagciwane abangela izifo, futhi kusize ekuqeqesheni amasosha ethu omzimba ukuthi asebenze kahle

question52: Chaza ubudlelwano phakathi komkhathi wasendulo woMhlaba kanye nokuvela kwezinye zezinhlobo zokuphila zokuqala eMhlabeni ngokukhetha okunembile kakhulu kwezincazelo ezinikeziwe. Sebenzisa amagama athi anaerobic kanye ne-phototrophic ngendlela efanele, futhi ubonise ngokunembile umphumela we-cyanobacteria emoyeni.
answer52: Eminyakeni eyizigidigidi ezimbili yokuqala yokuba khona koMhlaba, umkhathi wawungenawo umoya-mpilo wama-molecule. Ngakho-ke, izinto eziphilayo zokuqala zazingenawo umoya-mpilo. Izinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisa i-phototrophic zavela zingakapheli iminyaka eyizigidigidi eyodwa kusukela uMhlaba wadalwa. Kulezi zinto eziphilayo kwavela i-cyanobacteria, ekhiqiza umoya-mpilo njengomkhiqizo we-photosynthesis, okwaholela ekufakweni komoya-mpilo emkhathi.
distractor52a: Izinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisa i-phototrophic zavela eminyakeni eyizigidigidi ezimbili yokuqala yokuba khona koMhlaba. Izinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisa i-Anaerobic zavela eminyakeni eyizigidigidi eyodwa kusukela uMhlaba wadalwa. Kulezi zinto eziphilayo kwavela i-cyanobacteria, ekhiqiza umoya-mpilo njengomkhiqizo we-photosynthesis, okwaholela ekufakweni komoya-mpilo emoyeni.

Ama-Cyanobacteria avele eminyakeni eyizigidigidi eyodwa kusukela uMhlaba wadalwa. Kulokhu kwavela izinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisa i-phototrophic, ezikhiqiza umoya-mpilo njengomkhiqizo we-photosynthesis, okwaholela ekufakweni komoya-mpilo emkhathi.
distractor52c: Eminyakeni eyizigidigidi ezimbili yokuqala yokuba khona koMhlaba, umkhathi wawungenawo umoya-mpilo wama-molecule. Ngakho-ke, izinto eziphilayo zokuqala zazingenawo umoya-mpilo. Phakathi neminyaka eyizigidigidi eyodwa yokwakheka koMhlaba, kwavela ama-cyanobacteria, akhiqiza umoya-mpilo njengomkhiqizo we-photosynthesis, okwaholela ekugcwalisweni komoya-mpilo komkhathi. Kulezi zinto eziphilayo kwavela izinto eziphilayo ezisebenzisa i-phototrophic.
question53: Yisiphi kulezi zitatimende esiyincazelo engcono kakhulu yokusetshenziswa okungenzeka kwama-extremophiles?

question54: Uma unikezwe isampula yemvelo, chaza kafushane izindlela ezingabona kangcono ukuba khona kwe-prokaryote engakhuliswa kuleyo sampula, bese ukhulisa i-DNA ye-prokaryotic.

question55: Ososayensi bakholelwa ukuthi izinto eziphilayo zokuqala eMhlabeni kwakuyizidalwa eziphila isikhathi eside. Xoxa ngalesi simangalo ngobufakazi obufanele balokho ososayensi abakwaziyo ngendawo yasekuqaleni yoMhlaba.
answer55: Indawo yokuqala yomhlaba yayigcwele izindawo ezibucayi kakhulu ezinomoya-mpilo omncane emkhathini, kungekho ozone yokuvikela ubuso boMhlaba emisebeni yokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo, ukuphazamiseka okukhulu kwezwe kanye nomsebenzi wezintaba-mlilo. answer56: Inodonga lweseli oluhlanganisa ulwelwesi lweseli, i-cytoplasm, ama-ribosome kanye nesifunda se-nucleoid esinezinto zofuzo. Ingase ibe ne-capsule evikelayo, i-flagellum, i-pili kanye nama-plasmid

question57: Chaza isitatimende sokuthi kokubili i-Archaea ne-Bacteria zinezakhiwo ezifanayo eziyisisekelo, kodwa lezi zakhiwo zakhiwe ngezingxenye zamakhemikhali ezahlukene
answer57: Amaseli ajwayelekile ku-Archaea kanye ne-Bacteria aqukethe udonga lweseli, ulwelwesi lweseli, indawo ye-nucleoid, ama-ribosome, futhi ngokuvamile i-capsule, i-flagellum, kanye ne-pili. question58: Izigaba ezintathu eziyisisekelo ze-prokaryotic yi-cocci, i-spirilli, ne-bacilli. Chaza futhi uqhathanise izici eziyisisekelo zesakhiwo sesigaba ngasinye ngokukhetha isifinyezo esinembile kakhulu
answer58: La maqembu amathathu e-prokaryote anezici ezifanayo eziyisisekelo zesakhiwo. Ngokuvamile anezindonga zamaseli ezimboze ulwelwesi lwamaseli, i-cytoplasm, ama-ribosome, kanye nesifunda se-nucleoid esinama-chromosome. Angase abe ne-capsule evikelayo, i-flagellum, i-pili, kanye nama-plasmid
distractor58a: La maqembu amathathu e-prokaryote anezici ezifanayo eziyisisekelo zesakhiwo. Ngokuvamile anezindonga zamaseli ezimboze ulwelwesi lwenuzi, i-cytoplasm, i-ribosomes, i-mitochondria, kanye nesifunda se-nucleoid esinezinto zofuzo. Angase abe ne-capsule evikelayo, i-flagellum, i-pili, kanye ne-plasmids.
distractor58b: I-Cocci ne-spirilli zinezici ezifanayo eziyisisekelo zesakhiwo. Ngokuvamile zinezindonga zamaseli ezimboze ulwelwesi lwamaseli, i-flagellum yokuhamba, kanye ne-pili yokunamathela. Ama-bacilli anomumo wenduku futhi aqukethe ama-ribosome kanye nesifunda se-nucleoid esinezinto zofuzo.
distractor58c: I-Bacilli ne-spirilli zinezici ezifanayo eziyisisekelo zesakhiwo. Ngokuvamile zinezindonga zamaseli ezimboze ulwelwesi lwenuzi, i-flagellum yokuhamba, kanye ne-pili yokunamathela. Ama-Cocci ayindilinga futhi aqukethe ama-ribosome kanye nesifunda se-nucleoid esinezinto zofuzo.
question59: Yisiphi isakhamzimba esikhulu ocabanga ukuthi sibaluleke kakhulu? Qinisekisa isimangalo sakho ngokunikeza ubufakazi obunembile bokusisekela
answer59: I-Carbon, ngoba iyadingeka futhi iyisakhi esiyinhloko sawo wonke ama-macromolecule. Iphinde ibhekele u-50% wokwakheka okuphelele kweseli
distractor59a: I-Carbon, ngoba imelela u-12% wesisindo esomile seseli elijwayelekile futhi iyinxenye yawo wonke ama-macromolecule
distractor59b: I-oksijini, ngoba iyadingeka futhi iyisakhi esiyinhloko sawo wonke ama-macromolecule. Iphinde ibhekele u-50% wokwakheka okuphelele kweseli
distractor59c: I-nitrogen, ngoba iyadingeka futhi iyisakhi esiyinhloko sawo wonke ama-macromolecule. Iphinde ihlanganise u-50% wokwakheka okuphelele kweseli
question60: Ibhaktheriya idinga i-amino acid ethile kuphela njengesakhi sezakhi eziphilayo futhi ihlala endaweni engenakukhanya nhlobo. Iyiphi indlela yokudla okunempilo (amandla amahhala kanye nekhabhoni) eyisebenzisayo? Xoxa ngempendulo yakho
answer60: I-Chemoheterotroph, njengoba kumele ithembele emithonjeni yamakhemikhali yamandla ehlala endaweni engenakukhanya kanye ne-heterotroph uma isebenzisa i-organic com amakhilogremu njengomthombo wayo wekhabhoni.
distractor60a: I-Chemoorganotroph, njengoba kumele ithembele emithonjeni yamakhemikhali yamandla ehlala endaweni engenakukhanya kanye ne-organotroph uma isebenzisa i-organic com amakhilogremu njengomthombo wayo wekhabhoni.
distractor60b: I-Chemolitoautotroph, njengoba kumele ithembele emithonjeni yamandla yamakhemikhali ehlala endaweni engenakukhanya kanye ne-autotroph uma isebenzisa i-organic com amakhilogremu njengomthombo wayo wekhabhoni.
distractor60c: I-Chemoheterotroph, njengoba kumele ithembele emithonjeni yamakhemikhali yamandla ehlala endaweni engenakukhanya kanye ne-heterotroph uma isebenzisa i-organic com amakhilogremu njengomthombo wayo wekhabhoni.
question61: Uma ucabanga ukuthi ungahlanganisa yonke i-com equkethe i-nitrogen edingekayo uma une-nitrogen, yini okungadingeka uyifake ekudleni kwakho uma ungalungisa i-nitrogen njengamanye ama-prokaryotes?
answer61: Ukudla kwami kungafaka izithelo noma imifino, amanzi kanye nomoya njengoba i-nitrogen esemoyeni ingamuncwa kalula
distractor61a: Ukudla kwami kungafaka izithelo noma imifino namanzi njengoba i-nitrogen ikhona enanini elikhulu emanzini
distractor61b: Ukudla kwami kungafaka izithelo noma imifino, ushizi, inyama, amanzi, nomoya njengoba i-nitrogen esemoyeni ingamuncwa kalula
distractor61c: Ukudla kwami kungafaka ushizi noma inyama, amanzi, nomoya njengoba i-nitrogen esemoyeni ingamuncwa kalula
question62: Yiziphi ezibaluleke kakhulu: izakhamzimba ezinkulu noma izakhamzimba ezincane? Yisiphi isizathu esichaza ukuthi kungani?
answer62: Akukho okubaluleke kakhulu njengoba zombili izinhlobo zezakhamzimba zidingeka kakhulu ekwakheni nasekusebenzeni kwamaseli e-prokaryotic.
distractor62a: Azibalulekile zombili, njengoba amaseli angasinda futhi enze imisebenzi ebalulekile ngaphandle kwanoma yiluphi uhlobo lwezakhamzimba.
distractor62b: Ama-micronutrients, noma ngabe adingeka ngamanani amancane; ngaphandle kwawo amaseli awakwazi ukusinda futhi enze izinqubo zokusebenza
distractor62c: Ama-macronutrients, njengoba edingeka ngamanani amakhulu ngamaseli futhi ngaleyo ndlela abaluleke kakhulu kune-micronutrients
question63:
Bheka Umfanekiso 22.30. I-Botulism isifo esingaba yingozi esithwalwa ukudla. Sibangelwa ubuthi obuvela kubhaktheriya i-Clostridium botulinum (C. botulinum). Leli bhaktheriya likhiqiza ama-spores, okunzima ukuwabhubhisa. Igrafu ikhombisa isikhathi isampula edinga ukushiswa ngaso ngokusekelwe ekushiseni. Qaphela ukuthi isikali sesikhathi siyisilinganiso selogi: Ilogi 1 iyimizuzu eyi-10, ilogi 2 iyimizuzu eyi-100 kanti ilogi 3 iyimizuzu eyi-1,000.

 Yikuphi ukwelashwa okungabulala ama-spores ngempumelelo futhi kuphephe?
question64: Ingabe izifo ezibangelwa ukudla ezihlobene nama-biofilms zishintshile ngokuhamba kwesikhathi? Chaza
answer64: Yebo, izinqubo ezingcono zokubulala inzalo kanye nokufaka amathini ziye zanciphisa ukwanda kwe-botulism. Amacala amaningi ezifo ezibangelwa ukudla manje ahlobene nokukhiqizwa kokudla okukhulu.
distractor64a: Yebo, izinqubo ezingcono zokubulala inzalo kanye nokufaka amathini ziye zanciphisa ukwanda kwe-botulism. Amacala amaningi okugula okubangelwa ukudla manje ahlobene nokukhiqizwa kokudla okuncane.
distractor64b: Cha, izinqubo ezingcono zokubulala inzalo kanye nokufaka amathini ziye zanciphisa ukwanda kwe-botulism. Amacala amaningi okugula okubangelwa ukudla manje ahlobene nokukhiqizwa kokudla okuncane.
distractor64c: Cha, izinqubo ezingcono zokubulala inzalo kanye nokufaka amathini ziye zandisa ukwanda kwe-botulism. Amacala amaningi ezifo ezibangelwa ukudla manje ahlobene nokukhiqizwa kokudla okukhulu.
question65:
Bheka uMfanekiso 22.24 kanye noMfanekiso 22.30.1. I-Botulism iyisifo esibulalayo esithwalwa ukudla. Sibangelwa ubuthi obuvela kubhaktheriya i-Clostridium botulinum (C. botulinum). Leli bhaktheriya likhiqiza ama-spores, okunzima ukuwabhubhisa. Igrafu ikhombisa ukuthi ukushisa kuthinta kanjani ama-spores e-C. botulinum. Ama-spores ashiswa ku-75°C futhi agcinwe kulelo zinga lokushisa.

 Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kule grafu
answer65: Ukuze ama-spores amaningi afe, izinga lokushisa elingu-75°C kumele ligcinwe isikhathi esingaphezu kwamahora amabili.
distractor65a: Ukushisa kufikela ku-75°C kubulala ama-spores e-C. botulinum cishe ngokushesha
distractor65b: Ukugcina ama-spores ku-75°C imizuzu eyi-10 kubulala iningi lama-spores
distractor65c: Ukushisa kufikela ku-75°C akunamthelela omkhulu kakhulu kuma-spores e-C. botulinum
question66: Yayiyini iNhlupho yase-Athene? Qhathanisa izifinyezo ezingezansi bese ukhetha esichaza kahle lesi sifo futhi sihlonze kahle imiphumela yamanje ehlobene naso
answer66: Isifo i-Plague of Athens kwakuyisifo okukholelwa ukuthi sibangelwa yi-Salmonella entericaserovar typhi esabulala ingxenye eyodwa kwezine yamasosha ase-Athene ngo-430 BC. Leli gciwane libanga amacala aphakathi kwezigidi ezingu-16 nezingu-33 zomkhuhlane we-typhoid namuhla, okuholela ekufeni kwabantu abangaphezu kuka-200,000 minyaka yonke.
distractor66a: Isifo i-Plague of Athens kwakuyisifo okwakukholelwa ukuthi sibangelwe yi-Yersinia pestis esabulala ingxenye eyodwa kwezine yamasosha ase-Athene ngo-430 BC. Leli gciwane libanga amacala aphakathi kwezigidi eziyi-10 neziyi-15 zomkhuhlane we-typhoid namuhla, okuholela ekufeni kwabantu abangaphezu kuka-10,000 minyaka yonke.
distractor66b: Isifo i-Plague of Athens kwakuyisifo okukholakala ukuthi sibangelwa yi-Salmonella entericaserovar typhi esabulala ingxenye eyodwa kwezine yamasosha ase-Athene ngo-430 BC. Leli gciwane libanga amacala aphakathi kwezigidi ezi-5 neziyi-10 zomkhuhlane we-typhoid namuhla, okuholela ekufeni kwabantu abangaphezu kuka-20,000 minyaka yonke.
distractor66c: Isifo i-Plague of Athens kwakuyisifo okwakukholelwa ukuthi sibangelwe yi-Yersinia pestis esabulala ingxenye eyodwa kwezine yamasosha ase-Athene ngo-430 BC. Leli gciwane libanga amacala aphakathi kwezigidi ezingu-16 nezingu-33 zomkhuhlane we-typhoid namuhla, okuholela ekufeni kwabantu abangaphezu kuka-200,000 minyaka yonke.
question67: Thola imiphumela emithathu ezuzisayo yokulungiswa kwe-nitrogen ehambisanayo
answer67: Izitshalo ziyazuza ekutholakaleni kwe-nitrogen engapheli; inhlabathi iyazuza ekuvundisweni ngokwemvelo; kanti amabhaktheriya ayazuza ekusebenziseni i-photosynthates ezivela ezitshalweni
distractor67a: Izitshalo ziyazuza ekutholakaleni kwe-nitrogen engapheli; inhlabathi iyazuza ekuvundisweni ngokwemvelo; kanti amabhaktheriya ayazuza ekusebenziseni i-potassium ezitshalweni
distractor67b: Izitshalo ziyazuza ngokutholakala okulinganiselwe kwe-nitrogen; inhlabathi iyazuza ngokuvundiswa ngokwemvelo, kanti amabhaktheriya ayazuza ngokusebenzisa ama-photosynthate avela ezitshalweni
distractor67c: Izitshalo ziyazuza ekutholakaleni okungenamkhawulo kwekhabhoni; inhlabathi iyazuza ekuvundisweni ngokwemvelo; kanti amabhaktheriya ayazuza ekusebenziseni i-photosynthates ezivela ezitshalweni
question68:
Bheka uMfanekiso 22.31. Isithombe sibonisa imiphumela yocwaningo olucwaninge amabhaktheriya ahlukahlukene ngekhono lawo lokususa i-mercury, i-cadmium kanye ne-lead endaweni ethile ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.

 Yenza isimangalo mayelana nokususwa kwe-mercury yilawa mabhaktheriya?
answer68: Amabhaktheriya asusa i-mercury aqeda inqubo ezinsukwini ezingu-3-4
distractor68a: Wonke amabhaktheriya aboniswe lapha angasusa i-mercury endaweni ezungezile
distractor68b: Amabhaktheriya asusa i-mercury aqeda inqubo ezinsukwini ezingu-7-8
distractor68c: Amagciwane ambalwa kuphela aboniswe lapha angasusa i-mercury endaweni ezungezile
question69: Bheka uMfanekiso 22.28. Cabanga ngezithombe ezivela ekuchithekeni kukawoyela e-Exxon Valdez e-Alaska ngo-1989. Yenza icala lokuthi impumelelo yokulungiswa kabusha kokuchitheka kukawoyela incike kuphi.
answer69: Impumelelo incike ohlotsheni lwamafutha amakhilogremu, ukuba khona kwama-prokaryotes ancibilikisa uwoyela ngokwemvelo olwandle, kanye nokushisa.
distractor69a: Impumelelo incike ekubeni khona kwe-hydrocarbon chain enephunga elimnandi nelinamagatsha amaningi kuphela amakhilogremu, kanye nokushisa.
distractor69b: Impumelelo incike ekubeni khona kwe-hydrocarbon chain engashintshi kakhulu futhi enuka kamnandi futhi enamagatsha amaningi amakhilogremu, kanye nokushisa.
distractor69c: Impumelelo incike ohlotsheni lwamafutha amakhilogremu, ukuba khona kwama-prokaryotes ancibilikisa amafutha ngokwemvelo olwandle, kanye nohlobo lomzimba wamanzi.
question70: Kungani ubudlelwano phakathi kwezolimo ezisimeme kanye nezilungisi ze-nitrogen bubizwa ngokuthi ubudlelwano bokubambisana?
answer70: Ngenxa ye-rhizobia, okuyizinto ezilungisa i-nitrogen, izitshalo ziyazuza ekutholakaleni kwe-nitrogen okungapheli; inhlabathi iyazuza ekuvundisweni ngokwemvelo kanti amabhaktheriya ayazuza ekusebenziseni i-photosynthates ezivela ezitshalweni.
distractor70a: Ngenxa ye-agrobacterium engabalungisi be-nitrogen, izitshalo ziyazuza ekutholakaleni kwe-nitrogen okungapheli; inhlabathi iyazuza ekuvundisweni ngokwemvelo kanti amabhaktheriya ayazuza ekusebenziseni i-photosynthates ezivela ezitshalweni.
distractor70b: Ngenxa ye-rhizobia, okuyizinto ezilungisa i-nitrogen, izitshalo ziyazuza ekutholakaleni kwe-nitrogen okungapheli; inhlabathi iyazuza ekuvundisweni ngokwemvelo kanti amabhaktheriya ayazuza ekusebenziseni i-potassium ezitshalweni.
distractor70c: Ngenxa ye-rhizobia, okuyizinto ezilungisa i-nitrogen, izitshalo ziyazuza ekutholakaleni okulinganiselwe kwe-nitrogen; inhlabathi iyazuza ekuvundisweni ngokwemvelo kanti amabhaktheriya ayazuza ekusebenziseni i-potassium ezitshalweni.
question71:
Bheka uMfanekiso 22.32. Lezi zithombe ezimbili ziyizimpawu ezihlukile zesenzakalo esifanayo. Esithombeni sokudla, izimo eziyindilinga zingama-bacteria abanjwe ndawonye yi-polysaccharide matrix. Isithombe kwesobunxele yindlela isakhiwo esibheka ngayo ukwakheka okuphansi.

 Yini eboniswa lapha?
question72: UStanley Miller noHarold Urey benze izivivinyo ezabonisa ukuthi ama-com amaningana e-organic amakhilogremu angakhiwa ngokuzenzekelayo ngokulingisa izimo zomkhathi wokuqala woMhlaba. Lapho uMiller no-Urey bephinda izivivinyo zabo ngaphandle kokukhipha ugesi, akukho ma-com e-organic amakhilogremu atholakala. Yenza isimangalo sokucabanga ukuthi yini engase ichaze lo mphumela. Hlela isimangalo sakho ngaphakathi komongo wezimo zoMhlaba wokuqala.
answer72: Umbani, noma uhlobo oluthile lwamandla, luyadingeka ukuze ama-molecule angaphili emoyeni asebenzisane. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi kwakukhona umthombo wamandla ofanayo eMhlabeni wakuqala owakhuthaza ukusebenzisana kanye nentuthuko.
distractor72a: Ukuntuleka kwe-organic com amakhilogremu ngaphandle kwezinhlansi kubonisa ukuthi izingxenye eziyinkimbinkimbi zezinto eziphilayo zakhiwa yizingxenye eziyinkimbinkimbi zezinto eziphilayo ezitholwa imisebe yelanga.
distractor72b: Ukuhlolwa kokuqala kokuhlolwa kumele ukuthi kwenziwe ngendlela engafanele
distractor72c: Ama-molecule e-Abiotic angakhula abe ama-molecule e-organic kuphela lapho kukhona umoya-mpilo, ngakho-ke umoya-mpilo kufanele wengezwe
question73:
Bheka uMfanekiso 22.33. Le grafu ikhombisa izinga lokukhula kwezinhlobo ezinhlanu zamabhaktheriya emazingeni okushisa ahlukene.

 Amakholoni ahlukene alawa mabhaktheriya agcinwa ku-45°C isikhathi eside. Yimaphi amabhaktheriya ongalindela ukuthi achume emazingeni okushisa anjalo?
answer73: I-Thermoanaerobacterium AK17 kanye ne-thermoanaerobakter AK15 zizokhula. Ezinye ngeke zikhule.
distractor73b: I-Thermoanaerobacterium AK17, i-Clostridium AK1 kanye ne-E. coli CCSC zizokhula. Ezinye ngeke zikhule.
distractor73c: I-Clostridium AK1, i-E. coli CCSC kanye ne-Paenibacillus VH01017 zizokhula. Ezinye ngeke zikhule.
question74: Yiluphi uhlobo lwamaseli alandelayo oluboniswa yiSithombe 22.10?
question75: Bonisa ukuqonda kwakho umehluko phakathi kwama-prokaryotes nama-eukaryotes ngokukhetha inketho echaza kahle futhi eqhathanisa umsebenzi kanye nokuba khona kwama-organelles eseli phakathi kwamaqembu amabili.
answer75: Ama-Ribosome ayizindawo zokwenziwa kwamaprotheni atholakala kumaseli e-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic. Udonga lweseli luyingqimba evikelayo, evame kakhulu kumaseli e-prokaryotic nakwamanye ama-eukaryotic. I-DNA ye-Chromosomal, izinto zofuzo zeseli, ikhona esifundeni se-nucleoid kuma-prokaryotes ngenkathi ivalelwe ku-nucleus kuma-eukaryotic.
distractor75a: Ama-Ribosome ayizindawo zokwenziwa kwamaprotheni atholakala kumaseli e-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic. Udonga lweseli luyingqimba evikelayo etholakala kwamanye amaseli e-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic. I-DNA ye-Chromosomal iwuhlobo lwezakhi zofuzo lweseli, oluvalelwe ku-nucleus kuma-prokaryotes ngenkathi lukhona esifundeni se-nucleoid kuma-eukaryotes.
distractor75b: Ama-Ribosome ayizindawo zokukhiqizwa kwe-ATP ezitholakala kumaseli e-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic. Udonga lweseli luyingqimba evikelayo, evame ukutholakala kumaseli e-prokaryotic nakwamanye ama-eukaryotic. I-DNA ye-Chromosomal ikhona esifundeni se-nucleoid kuma-eukaryotic kanye nama-prokaryotes. Yizinto zofuzo zeseli
distractor75c: Ama-Ribosome ayizindawo zokwenziwa kwamaprotheni atholakala kumaseli e-prokaryotic kanye ne-eukaryotic. Udonga lweseli luyingqimba evikelayo, evame ukutholakala kumaseli e-prokaryotic kodwa hhayi kuma-eukaryotes. I-DNA ye-Chromosomal, izinto zofuzo zeseli, ikhona ku-nucleus kuma-prokaryotes, kuyilapho ivalwe endaweni ye-nucleoid kuma-eukaryotes.
question76: Ibhaktheriya elingeyona i-pathogenic lithola ukumelana nama-antibiotic. Bonisa ukuqonda kwakho ngalo mbono ngokunquma ukuthi yiziphi izimo ezilandelayo ezichaza ukuthi lolu hlobo lungaba kanjani ingozi empilweni yabantu, kungamanga.
answer76: Izakhi zofuzo zokumelana nama-antibiotic zidluliselwa kusuka kubhaktheriya okungenazo izifo kuya kubhaktheriya obangela izifo nge-binary fission
distractor76a: Izakhi zofuzo zokumelana nama-antibiotic zidluliselwa kusuka kubhaktheriya okungenazo izifo kuya kubhaktheriya obangela izifo ngokudluliselwa
distractor76b: Izakhi zofuzo zokumelana nama-antibiotic zidluliselwa kusuka kubhaktheriya ongeyona i-pathogenic ziye kubhaktheriya obangela izifo ngokuguqulwa
distractor76c: Izakhi zofuzo zokumelana nama-antibiotic zidluliselwa kusuka kubhaktheriya okungenazo izifo kuya kubhaktheriya obangela izifo ngokuhlangana
question77: Esimweni esishintsha ngokushesha, yiliphi iqembu le-prokaryotic ongacabanga ukuthi lizophumelela kakhulu, elihlanganisa abantu abakwaziyo ukuhlanganisa, noma elingakwenzi lokho? Sekela impendulo yakho ngesizathu esifanele.
answer77: Iqembu labantu elihlanganisa abantu abakwaziyo ukuhlangana lingaphumelela kakhulu ngoba amanye amalungu angakha amaseli aphinde ahlangane anezinhlanganisela ezintsha zezakhi zofuzo ezizuzisayo endaweni entsha.
distractor77a: Iqembu labantu elihlanganisa abantu abakwaziyo ukuhlangana lingaphumelela kakhulu ngoba wonke amalungu alo azokwakha amaseli aphinde ahlangane anezinhlanganisela ezintsha zezakhi zofuzo ezizuzisayo endaweni entsha.
distractor77b: Iqembu labantu elihlanganisa abantu abangakwazi ukuhlangana lingaphumelela kakhulu ngoba amalungu ahlanganayo angakha amaseli amasha ahlanganayo anezinhlanganisela zezakhi zofuzo ezibulalayo endaweni entsha.
distractor77c: Isibalo sabantu esihlanganisa nabantu abangakwazi ukuhlangana singaba nempumelelo enkulu ngoba ukuhlangana kuzoholela ekwandeni kokuhlukahluka kwezakhi zofuzo zesibalo se-prokaryotic, okuzoba yingozi kubantu abasha.
question78: Bheka uMfanekiso 22.34. Buyekeza umdwebo, ofingqa imiphumela yokuhlolwa kusetshenziswa amalungiselelo ahlukene e-E. coli akhuliswe noma ngabe kukhona noma kungekho i-ampicillin yama-antibiotic. Khomba ipuleti noma amapuleti lapho kukhula khona amabhaktheriya amelana ne-ampicillin kuphela.
question79: Bheka uMfanekiso 22.34. Hlola umdwebo, ofingqa okutholakele kokuhlolwa nge-E.coli. Sebenzisa ukuqonda kwakho kokuhlolwa kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwezakhi zofuzo zamagciwane ukuchaza ukuthi kungani kunamakholoni ambalwa epuletini IV kunasepuletini III.
answer79: Wonke amaseli e-E.coli awazange aguqulwe ngempumelelo ku-plate IV
distractor79a: I-nutrient agar medium yavimbela ukukhula kwamagciwane athile epuletini IV
distractor79b: Wonke amaseli e-E.coli aguqulwe ngempumelelo ku-plate IV
distractor79c: Amabhaktheriya ayesesitsheni sesi-III ayemelana ngokwemvelo ne-ampicillin
question80: Bheka uMfanekiso 22.35. Cabanga ngobunikazi bezakhiwo ezibhalwe ilebula ngaphakathi kweseli. Nquma ukuthi yiziphi izakhiwo ezikuvumela ukuthi ubone iseli njenge-prokaryote ngendlela efanele
question81: Kutholakala uhlobo lwebhaktheriya oluyi-methanogen. Yenza isimangalo uphakamisa umbuzo wocwaningo ozowuphendula Uma ubufuna ukwakhela kulokhu okutholiwe ukuze uqonde kangcono ukuvela kwezindlela ezihlobene nekhono lokubamba, ukugcina, nokusebenzisa amandla amahhala kuma-prokaryotes. Khetha umbuzo ofanele kakhulu kulowo ongezansi
answer81: Ingabe izindlela ze-metabolic zavela ngokwehlukana ku-Bacteria kanye ne-Archaea?
distractor81a: Ingabe zonke izinto ezibangela i-methanogen kufanele zibhekwe njenge-Archaea ku-phylogeny yokuziphendukela kwemvelo?
distractor81b: Ingabe ama-methanogens avele ahlala ezindaweni eziphakathi nendawo kanye nezimbi kakhulu?
distractor81c: Ingabe izinhlobo zamabhaktheriya e-methanogenic nazo zavela njenge-anaerobe eqinile?
question82:
Bheka uMfanekiso 22.36. Igrafu ikhombisa inani lokufakwa kwe-nitrogen yibhaktheriya ehlala ezimpandeni zesitshalo sikamoba futhi eduze naso emazingeni ahlukene omoya-mpilo.

 Ngokusekelwe kumugqa we-Fixed N ku-Bacteria, yenza umbono ngaleli bhaktheriya
question83: Yimaphi amagama ahlobene nokuguquguquka kokudla okunempilo kanye nokuguqulwa kwe-metabolic okuhambisana kahle nezinto eziphilayo ezichazwe?
question84: Ekuhlolweni, abacwaningi batshala izithombo zezitshalo enhlabathini lapho kwanezelwa khona uhlobo olulodwa lwezinhlobo ezimbili zamabhaktheriya. Iqembu lokulawula lalingenawo amabhaktheriya afakwe enhlabathini. Ukumuncwa kwe-potassium yezakhamzimba kwezithombo kwanda kakhulu enhlabathini nge-Strin 1 futhi kwehla kakhulu enhlabathini nge-Strin 2. Ngokusekelwe kulokhu okutholakele, dweba kokubili iziphetho eziqondile nezibanzi mayelana nobudlelwano phakathi kwamabhaktheriya, izithombo, kanye nezakhamzimba ezitholakalayo.
answer84: Ibhaktheriya i-Strin 1 yandisa ukutholakala kwe-potassium enhlabathini, futhi lesi sakhi sasizodingeka futhi sisetshenziswa yizithombo enhlabathini. Ibhaktheriya i-Strin 2 yanciphisa ukutholakala kwe-potassium enhlabathini.
distractor84a: Ibhaktheriya i-Strain 2 yandisa ukutholakala kwe-potassium enhlabathini, futhi lesi sakhi sasizodingeka futhi sisetshenziswa yizithombo enhlabathini. Ibhaktheriya i-Strain 1 yanciphisa ukutholakala kwe-potassium enhlabathini.
distractor84b: Inhlabathi enebhaktheriya le-Strin 1 kumele ukuthi yayine-potassium eningi uma iqhathaniswa nenhlabathi enebhaktheriya le-Strin 2. Izithombo zathola i-potassium eningi eNhlabathini 1 kunakweyesi-2 ngenxa yalo mehluko.
distractor84c: Ibhaktheriya i-Strin 1 yehlisa ukutholakala kwe-potassium enhlabathini, futhi lesi sakhi sasizodingeka futhi sisetshenziswa yizithombo enhlabathini. Ibhaktheriya i-Strin 2 yandisa ukutholakala kwe-potassium enhlabathini.

question86:
Bheka Umfanekiso 22.38. Umkhuhlane we-Dengue yisifo esibangelwa yigciwane esithwalwa abantu ngomiyane. Ukuqubuka komkhuhlane we-Dengue kwabikwa ngo-1635 nango-1699. EMpini Yezwe II (1939-1945), umkhuhlane we-Dengue, owasakazeka phakathi kwamasosha, wawuyisongo esikhulu ePacific eshisayo. Ngemva kuka-1945, lesi sifo savinjelwa kakhulu. Igrafu ikhombisa amacala aziwayo omkhuhlane we-Dengue kusukela ngo-1955.

 Yini engashiwo ngomkhuhlane we-Dengue ngokusekelwe kulolu lwazi?
question87: Esimweni socwaningo olucatshangelwayo, ososayensi bathola ama-endospores amabhaktheriya odakeni phansi kwexhaphozi eliye langcoliswa yinto engcolile iminyaka engu-25. Udaka lwexhaphozi lwafakwa ezingqimbeni zonyaka. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ubudala bama-endospores bungalinganiswa ngokukhomba ungqimba lwe-silt lapho kutholakala khona ama-endospores. Ku-Flask A, abacwaningi babeka ama-endospores aneminyaka engu-20 ubudala kanye nendawo yokukhula kanye nento engcolile. Ku-Flask B, abacwaningi babeka ama-endospores aneminyaka engu-100 ubudala kanye nendawo yokukhula kanye nento engcolile. Ake sithi abacwaningi babheka ama-flask isikhashana, baqhubeka nokugcwalisa indawo yokukhula kanye nento engcolile njengoba kudingeka. Qagela imiphumela engaba khona ongayilindela ekukhuleni kwama-flask ngemva kwesikhathi esibekiwe.
answer87: Ukukhula kwe-Flask A kuzoqhubeka kudlula okwe-Flask B
distractor87a: Ukukhula kwe-Flask B kuzoqhubeka kudlula okwe-Flask A
distractor87b: Umehluko ekukhuleni phakathi kwala maflaski amabili uzogcina unciphile
distractor87c: Ekugcineni, kuzoba nokukhula okuncane noma okungekho nhlobo ebhodleleni ngalinye
question88:
Bheka uMfanekiso 22.39. Igrafu ikhombisa inani lamacala kanye nenani lokufa okubangelwa izinhlobo ezahlukene zamagciwane amelana namagciwane. Igrafu encane engxenyeni engezansi kwesokudla i-zoomed ngokubuka idatha engxenyeni engezansi kwesobunxele.

 Funda idatha ye-CRPA (i-Pseudomonas aeruginosa engamelana ne-carbapenem) kanye ne-3GCRKP (isizukulwane sesithathu se-cephalosporin-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae). Amabhamuza alawa amabili ahlangana kakhulu. Ngokusekelwe kudatha, yenza isimangalo ngala magciwane.
answer88: Ukutheleleka kwe-3GCRKP kuvame kakhulu futhi kubangela ukufa okuncane uma kuqhathaniswa ne-CRPA
distractor88a: Ukutheleleka kwe-3GCRKP kuvame kakhulu futhi kubangela ukufa okuningi uma kuqhathaniswa ne-CRPA
distractor88b: Ukutheleleka kwe-3GCRKP akuvamile futhi kubangela ukufa okuncane kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa ne-CRPA
distractor88c: Ukutheleleka kwe-3GCRKP akuvamile futhi kubangela ukufa okuncane uma kuqhathaniswa ne-CRPA
question89:
Bheka Umfanekiso 22.40. Le grafu ikhombisa ukumelana kwama-antibiotic ku-penicillin emazweni ahlukene. I-x-axis ikhombisa ukusetshenziswa kwe-penicillin ekwelapheni iziguli ezingalaliswa esibhedlela (iziguli ezelashwayo futhi zithunyelwe ekhaya; iziguli ezingalaliswanga esibhedlela).

 Uma uqaphela ukuthi i-penicillin ingenye yemithi eminingi yama-antibiotic, yenza umbono mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwama-antibiotic emazweni abonwe kugrafu.
answer89: IFrance isebenzisa inani elikhulu lama-antibiotic ekwelapheni iziguli ezingalaliswa esibhedlela futhi ingazuza ekushintsheni kwenqubomgomo
distractor89a: INetherlands isebenzisa ama-antibiotic amancane kakhulu ekwelapheni iziguli ezingalaliswa esibhedlela futhi ingaba yizwe eliyisibonelo kulokhu.
distractor89b: I-Italy isebenzisa ama-antibiotic ekwelashweni kwangaphandle kakhulu kunokujwayelekile, kodwa inokumelana okuncane kunalokho obekulindelekile. Kungenza izwe eliyisibonelo
distractor89c: Akukho lwazi olwanele lokwenza umbono mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwama-antibiotic kugrafu
question90:
Bheka Umfanekiso 22.41. Le grafu ikhombisa ukumelana kwama-antibiotic ne-penicillin emazweni ahlukene. I-x-axis ikhombisa ukusetshenziswa kwe-penicillin ekwelapheni iziguli ezingalaliswa esibhedlela (iziguli ezelashwayo futhi ezithunyelwa ekhaya; iziguli ezingalaliswanga esibhedlela).

 Yenza isimangalo mayelana nokumelana ne-penicillin ngokusekelwe kule grafu
answer90: Ukumelana ne-penillicin kuyanda emazweni ayisebenzisela ukwelapha iziguli ezingalaliswa esibhedlela
distractor90a: Ukumelana ne-penicillin akuhlobene nokusetshenziswa kwayo ekwelapheni iziguli ezingalaliswa esibhedlela
distractor90b: Ukumelana ne-penillicin kuyehla emazweni ayisebenzisela ukwelapha iziguli ezingalaliswa esibhedlela
distractor90c: Ukumelana ne-penicillin kunganda noma kunciphe emazweni ayisebenzisela ukwelapha iziguli ezingalaliswa esibhedlela, ngokusekelwe kwezinye izici.
question91:
Bheka uMfanekiso 22.42. Igrafu ikhombisa umkhiqizo wamasimu ommbila ngokusekelwe ekunikezelweni kwawo kwe-nitrogen.

 Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kule grafu
answer91: Amasimu anemithombo engaphezu kweyodwa ye-nitrogen avame ukukhiqiza kakhulu
distractor91a: Umthombo we-nitrogen odumile kakhulu ukutshala ubhontshisi
distractor91b: Amasimu anomanyolo we-nitrogen wokwenziwa avame ukukhiqiza kakhulu
distractor91c: Cishe wonke amasimu asebenzisa umquba njengomthombo oyingxenye we-nitrogen
question92:
Bheka uMfanekiso 22.43. Imifino ixhumana namagciwane enhlabathi futhi yakha amaqhubu aqinisa i-nitrogen. Igrafu ikhombisa ukutshalwa kwemifino kanye nokusetshenziswa komanyolo we-nitrogen wokwenziwa.

 Yenza isimangalo ngokusekelwe kule grafu
answer92: Ukusebenzisa umanyolo wokwenziwa kanye nokutshala ubhontshisi kunamazinga afanayo okusebenza kahle ekuhlinzekeni i-nitrogen
distractor92a: Ukusebenzisa umanyolo wokwenziwa kusebenza kahle ekuhlinzekeni i-nitrogen uma kuqhathaniswa nokutshala ubhontshisi
distractor92b: Ukutshala ubhontshisi kusebenza kahle kakhulu ekuhlinzekeni i-nitrogen uma kuqhathaniswa nokusebenzisa umanyolo wokwenziwa
distractor92c: Akunakwenzeka ukwenza isimangalo ngokutshala ubhontshisi nokusebenzisa umanyolo wokwenziwa ngokusekelwe kugrafu
question93: Izinhlobo zamabhaktheriya ezingaphezu kwe-100 zihlala ebusweni bomzimba womuntu. Amabhaktheriya amboza izingxenye zesikhumba somuntu ngamaqoqo afinyelela ku-8 million cells ngesentimitha lesikwele. Ikakhulukazi, izindlala ze-sebaceous zomuntu zisekela ukukhula kwebhaktheriya i-Propionibacterium acnes, esebenzisa uwoyela ovela ezindlaleni ekudleni. Izinhlobo ezimbili ze-P. acnes zihlotshaniswa nokukhula kwezinduna esikhumbeni somuntu, kodwa ezinye izinhlobo zihlotshaniswa nesikhumba esinempilo. Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu ne-P. acnes?
answer93: Kwezinye izimo kuba yinto evamile kanti kwezinye kuba yizinambuzane
distractor93a: Kwezinye izimo kuba yinto ehambisanayo kanti kwezinye kuba yinto ehambisanayo
